it: Un anemone che, in realtà, non è affatto porcello. Gli studiosi gli hanno appioppato un nome osceno solo per l'aspetto, e da allora soffre della cattiva fama. Vuole bene al suo pesce pagliaccio, l'unico che lo capisca per quello che è e che gli stia accanto.

jp: ドスケベイソギンチャク
元々知能の高い海洋生物だったが、科学技術を発達させて地上侵略に乗り出した。頭がよく性格も明るいが、自分が楽しければそれでいいというクズ。面白半分で集団暴行やドラッグに興じる。
jp_grezzo: "元々知能の高い海洋生物だったが、科学技術を発達させて地上侵略に乗り出した。頭がよく性格も明るいが、自分が楽しければそれでいいというクズ。面白半分で集団暴行やドラッグに興じる。"
en: They were the originally intelligent marine creatures, developed science and technology and embarked on an invasion of the surface. He is intelligent and has a bright personality, but he is a scum who is only happy if he is having fun. He enjoys group assaults and drugs for the fun of it.
en_grezzo: "They were the originally intelligent marine creatures, developed science and technology and embarked on an invasion of the surface. He is intelligent and has a bright personality, but he is a scum who is only happy if he is having fun. He enjoys group assaults and drugs for the fun of it."
it: In origine era una creatura marina di alta intelligenza, poi ha sviluppato scienza e tecnica e si è messo a invadere la terraferma. Ha testa e carattere allegro, ma è un rifiuto che bada solo a divertirsi: si dà a pestaggi di gruppo e a droghe per puro spasso.

jp: ドルフィンソルジャー
嫌われ者のイカ。他者をバカにしては冗談ですませようとするが、自分がバカにされると激昂する。煽りあいでメス牡蠣に返り討ちにされたので捨て台詞を残して海から逃げてきた。
jp_grezzo: "嫌われ者のイカ。他者をバカにしては冗談ですませようとするが、自分がバカにされると激昂する。煽りあいでメス牡蠣に返り討ちにされたので捨て台詞を残して海から逃げてきた。"
en: Disliked squid. He tries to make fun of others and joke about it, but becomes enraged when he is made fun of. He was turned back by a female oyster in an agitated fight and fled from the sea, leaving behind a message of rejection.
en_grezzo: "Disliked squid. He tries to make fun of others and joke about it, but becomes enraged when he is made fun of. He was turned back by a female oyster in an agitated fight and fled from the sea, leaving behind a message of rejection."
it: Un calamaro che nessuno sopporta. Sfotte gli altri e poi se la cava dicendo che scherzava, ma se sfottono lui va su tutte le furie. In una gara di sfottò l'ha spuntata un'ostrica femmina, e allora è scappato dal mare lasciando l'ultima parola, come si fa quando si perde.

jp: ルードゥス地下をアジトとしている、あなたと血の繋がっていない姉。姉波動に目覚めており、その研究と布教に腐心している。理解度の低いあなたに対して不満を感じつつも、いつでもあなたの帰りを待ってくれている。
jp_grezzo: "ルードゥス地下をアジトとしている、あなたと血の繋がっていない姉。姉波動に目覚めており、その研究と布教に腐心している。理解度の低いあなたに対して不満を感じつつも、いつでもあなたの帰りを待ってくれている。"
en: She is an older sister who is not blood related to you, and uses a basement in Ludus as her base of operations. She has awakened to the Sistergy waves and devotes her life to their study and propagation. Although she is frustrated with your lack of understanding, she is always waiting for your return.
en_grezzo: "She is an older sister who is not blood related to you, and uses a basement in Ludus as her base of operations. She has awakened to the Sistergy waves and devotes her life to their study and propagation. Although she is frustrated with your lack of understanding, she is always waiting for your return."
it: La sorella maggiore che non ha il tuo sangue, e che tiene la sua base nei sotterranei di Ludus. Si è risvegliata all'Onda Sororale e si spende tutta per studiarla e diffonderla. Le dispiace che tu capisca così poco, ma aspetta sempre che tu torni.

jp: 修道姉『シスターシスター』
冥界原産のアルラウネ。インフェルノフラワーをライバル視しており、生息地を広げることに熱心。立派なおしべで敵を貫いたり、濃厚な花粉をぶっかけようとする。地獄を味わいたくなければ近寄らないほうがよい。
jp_grezzo: "冥界原産のアルラウネ。インフェルノフラワーをライバル視しており、生息地を広げることに熱心。立派なおしべで敵を貫いたり、濃厚な花粉をぶっかけようとする。地獄を味わいたくなければ近寄らないほうがよい。"
en: A species of arlaune that is native to the underworld. It sees the inferno flower as its rival and is eager to expand its habitat. It tries to pierce its enemies with its magnificent stamen or spray them with thick pollen. It is best to stay away from them if you don't want a taste of Hell.
en_grezzo: "A species of arlaune that is native to the underworld. It sees the inferno flower as its rival and is eager to expand its habitat. It tries to pierce its enemies with its magnificent stamen or spray them with thick pollen. It is best to stay away from them if you don't want a taste of Hell."
it: Un'alraune originaria dell'Oltretomba. Considera il fiore infernale una rivale e si dà da fare per allargare il proprio territorio. Infilza i nemici con lo stame maestoso, oppure cerca di rovesciare loro addosso un polline denso. Meglio non avvicinarsi, se non si vuole assaggiare l'inferno.

jp: ブタクサ野郎の大型亜種。花粉の威力が上がっており、インド象に吹き付けると鼻が胴体より大きく腫れ上がってしまうほどである。結構な量の強烈花粉をまき散らしているが、罪は全て杉になすりつけている。
jp_grezzo: "ブタクサ野郎の大型亜種。花粉の威力が上がっており、インド象に吹き付けると鼻が胴体より大きく腫れ上がってしまうほどである。結構な量の強烈花粉をまき散らしているが、罪は全て杉になすりつけている。"
en: A large subspecies of hogweeder. The pollen has become so powerful that when it is sprayed on an Indian elephant, the elephant's nose swells up to a size larger than its body. It is spreading a considerable amount of strong pollen, but it blames the cedar trees for all its sins.
en_grezzo: "A large subspecies of hogweeder. The pollen has become so powerful that when it is sprayed on an Indian elephant, the elephant's nose swells up to a size larger than its body. It is spreading a considerable amount of strong pollen, but it blames the cedar trees for all its sins."
it: La sottospecie di taglia grande dell'ambrosia molesta. Il polline ha guadagnato potenza: soffiato addosso a un elefante indiano, gli gonfia la proboscide fino a farla più grossa del corpo. Ne sparge in giro una quantità notevole, ma della colpa incarica sempre i cedri.

jp: 自分にとって邪魔になる動植物を、安全な位置から一方的に花粉で攻撃して追い払う嫌われ者。強烈花粉を撒いていることはあまり知られていないが、それをいいことに全部杉のせいにして杉と人間の対立を煽って楽しんでいる。
jp_grezzo: "自分にとって邪魔になる動植物を、安全な位置から一方的に花粉で攻撃して追い払う嫌われ者。強烈花粉を撒いていることはあまり知られていないが、それをいいことに全部杉のせいにして杉と人間の対立を煽って楽しんでいる。"
en: He is a hated species of plant that unilaterally attacks and drives away other plants and animals that get in his way with pollen from a safe distance. He is not well known for spreading his strong pollen, but he takes advantage of this and blames it all on the cedars, and enjoys stirring up conflict between cedars and humans.
en_grezzo: "He is a hated species of plant that unilaterally attacks and drives away other plants and animals that get in his way with pollen from a safe distance. He is not well known for spreading his strong pollen, but he takes advantage of this and blames it all on the cedars, and enjoys stirring up conflict between cedars and humans."
it: Un individuo detestato, che dalla distanza di sicurezza attacca a senso unico col polline le piante e gli animali che gli danno fastidio, finché non se ne vanno. Che sia lui a spargere il polline forte non si sa granché, e lui ne approfitta per dare la colpa ai cedri e si diverte a soffiare sulla lite fra i cedri e gli uomini.

jp: 花が発達したマンドレイクの一種。人類とコミュニケーションを取るため、めしべが人型になったらしい。綺麗好きで秘密好きな性格なので、定期的に洗ったり質問したりしてあげると喜ぶ。
jp_grezzo: "花が発達したマンドレイクの一種。人類とコミュニケーションを取るため、めしべが人型になったらしい。綺麗好きで秘密好きな性格なので、定期的に洗ったり質問したりしてあげると喜ぶ。"
en: A type of mandrake with well-developed flowers. It is said that its pistils became humanoid in order to communicate with humans. They like to be clean and secretive, so they are happy if you wash them regularly and ask them questions.
en_grezzo: "A type of mandrake with well-developed flowers. It is said that its pistils became humanoid in order to communicate with humans. They like to be clean and secretive, so they are happy if you wash them regularly and ask them questions."
it: Una specie di mandragora dal fiore molto sviluppato. Pare che il pistillo abbia preso forma umana per poter comunicare con il genere umano. Ama la pulizia e ama i segreti: se la si lava di tanto in tanto e le si fanno domande, è contenta.

jp: 古代より植林・搾取されてきた恨みから、人類を強烈花粉で苦しめて報復している。かつて杉山を焼き払いに向かった冒険者がいたが、寄ってたかって穴という穴に花粉を詰められ、変死体として発見された。
jp_grezzo: "古代より植林・搾取されてきた恨みから、人類を強烈花粉で苦しめて報復している。かつて杉山を焼き払いに向かった冒険者がいたが、寄ってたかって穴という穴に花粉を詰められ、変死体として発見された。"
en: Because of their resentment over being planted and exploited since ancient times, they retaliate by tormenting the human race with an intense pollen. In the past, a band of adventurers went to burn down a cedar mountain, but they were later found dead with pollen stuffed into every bodily cavity.
en_grezzo: "Because of their resentment over being planted and exploited since ancient times, they retaliate by tormenting the human race with an intense pollen. In the past, a band of adventurers went to burn down a cedar mountain, but they were later found dead with pollen stuffed into every bodily cavity."
it: Piantati e sfruttati fin dall'antichità, si vendicano del rancore tormentando il genere umano con un polline violentissimo. Un tempo certi avventurieri partirono per dare fuoco a un monte di cedri: gli alberi si strinsero attorno a loro tutti insieme e li riempirono di polline in ogni orifizio, e li ritrovarono cadaveri.

jp: ヒノキの怪物。古いものほど邪悪とされている。こいつの丸太を素材にして人形を作ると、善意を平気で裏切るし忠告も聞かないクズが誕生する。嫌いなものは勉強と努力。性格が悪いが頭も悪いので、ズル賢い系クズの恰好の餌食だ。
jp_grezzo: "ヒノキの怪物。古いものほど邪悪とされている。こいつの丸太を素材にして人形を作ると、善意を平気で裏切るし忠告も聞かないクズが誕生する。嫌いなものは勉強と努力。性格が悪いが頭も悪いので、ズル賢い系クズの恰好の餌食だ。"
en: A cypress (hinoki) monster. The older he is, the more evil he is considered to be. If you make a doll from his log, you will create a piece of junk that will betray your good intentions without a care and will not listen to your advice. He hates study and hard work. He has a rotten character, but he also has a rotten brain, so he is easy prey for devious crooks.
en_grezzo: "A cypress (hinoki) monster. The older he is, the more evil he is considered to be. If you make a doll from his log, you will create a piece of junk that will betray your good intentions without a care and will not listen to your advice. He hates study and hard work. He has a rotten character, but he also has a rotten brain, so he is easy prey for devious crooks."
it: Il mostro del cipresso. Più è vecchio, più lo si ritiene malvagio. Chi ricava un burattino dal suo tronco ottiene un rifiuto che tradisce la buona fede senza batter ciglio e che non ascolta consigli. Detesta lo studio e la fatica. Ha un pessimo carattere, ma anche poca testa, ed è quindi la preda ideale dei furfanti scaltri.

jp: 魔神の力を宿した下級神。頭部から精神を蝕む怪光を放つ。精神攻撃が主なため、知能の低い相手は苦手。１つの身体に２つの女性人格が同居しているが、特に喧嘩もせず仲良くやっているようだ。
jp_grezzo: "魔神の力を宿した下級神。頭部から精神を蝕む怪光を放つ。精神攻撃が主なため、知能の低い相手は苦手。１つの身体に２つの女性人格が同居しているが、特に喧嘩もせず仲良くやっているようだ。"
en: A lesser god that possesses the power of an evil spirit. From its head, it emits a monstrous light that eats away at the spirit. Although she has two female personalities living together in one body, they seem to get along well without any particular quarrels.
en_grezzo: "A lesser god that possesses the power of an evil spirit. From its head, it emits a monstrous light that eats away at the spirit. Although she has two female personalities living together in one body, they seem to get along well without any particular quarrels."
it: Una divinità minore in cui abita la forza del dio oscuro. Dalla testa emette una luce mostruosa che corrode la mente. Attacca soprattutto lo spirito, quindi con gli avversari poco intelligenti fa fatica. In un corpo solo convivono due personalità femminili, ma pare che vadano d'accordo e non litighino affatto.

jp: 魔神の力を宿した下級神。胴体から魔力の熱線を発射し敵を焼き払う。力押しで来る相手を削り殺すのが得意だが、精神攻撃が苦手。身体が青いのに高熱攻撃するのはイメージ違いだろうか？と悩んでいる。
jp_grezzo: "魔神の力を宿した下級神。胴体から魔力の熱線を発射し敵を焼き払う。力押しで来る相手を削り殺すのが得意だが、精神攻撃が苦手。身体が青いのに高熱攻撃するのはイメージ違いだろうか？と悩んでいる。"
en: A lesser god that possesses the power of an evil spirit. He fires a heat ray of magical power from his torso to burn away his enemies. He is good at cutting down opponents who come at him with force, but he is not proficient in spiritual attacks. Is it wrong for him to attack with high heat when his body is blue? He is troubled by this.
en_grezzo: "A lesser god that possesses the power of an evil spirit. He fires a heat ray of magical power from his torso to burn away his enemies. He is good at cutting down opponents who come at him with force, but he is not proficient in spiritual attacks. Is it wrong for him to attack with high heat when his body is blue? He is troubled by this."
it: Una divinità minore in cui abita la forza del dio oscuro. Dal torso spara un raggio termico di potere magico e incenerisce i nemici. È bravo a consumare chi gli viene addosso di forza, ma con gli attacchi allo spirito fa fatica. Lo tormenta un dubbio: avere il corpo azzurro e attaccare col calore non stonerà un po'?

jp: 魔神の力を宿した下級神。シンプルに暴力を得意とするが、場合によっては酸の嵐も吐いたりする。知能が低く、ほとんど本能で動いている。見た目は蟹っぽいが身体構造は全く別物である。
jp_grezzo: "魔神の力を宿した下級神。シンプルに暴力を得意とするが、場合によっては酸の嵐も吐いたりする。知能が低く、ほとんど本能で動いている。見た目は蟹っぽいが身体構造は全く別物である。"
en: A lesser god that possesses the power of an evil spirit. He excels at simple violence, but in some cases he can also spit acid storms. He has low intelligence and operates almost entirely on instinct. Although he takes the appearance of crab, his physical structure is of a completely different type.
en_grezzo: "A lesser god that possesses the power of an evil spirit. He excels at simple violence, but in some cases he can also spit acid storms. He has low intelligence and operates almost entirely on instinct. Although he takes the appearance of crab, his physical structure is of a completely different type."
it: Una divinità minore in cui abita la forza del dio oscuro. È bravo nella violenza pura e semplice, ma all'occorrenza sputa anche tempeste d'acido. Ha poca intelligenza e va quasi solo d'istinto. All'aspetto sembra un granchio, ma la struttura del corpo è tutt'altra cosa.

jp: 人間になりたくて神を信仰してきたツインテール。願いが漠然としすぎていて中途半端な人型になってしまった。当初は尻尾が頭についていることに違和感を抱いていたが、これはこれで便利だと気づいて今は満足している。
jp_grezzo: "人間になりたくて神を信仰してきたツインテール。願いが漠然としすぎていて中途半端な人型になってしまった。当初は尻尾が頭についていることに違和感を抱いていたが、これはこれで便利だと気づいて今は満足している。"
en: A twin-tailed girl who, wanting to become human, began to believe in God. Her wish was too vague and she ended up with a half-baked human form. At first she was uncomfortable with the tail on her head, but upon realizing that it could be of some use, she is now happy with it.
en_grezzo: "A twin-tailed girl who, wanting to become human, began to believe in God. Her wish was too vague and she ended up with a half-baked human form. At first she was uncomfortable with the tail on her head, but upon realizing that it could be of some use, she is now happy with it."
it: Una bestia a due code che, per diventare umana, si è messa a pregare le divinità. Il desiderio era troppo vago, e ne è uscita una forma umana lasciata a metà. All'inizio le pareva strano avere le code attaccate alla testa, ma poi ha scoperto che così sono comode, e adesso è contenta.

jp: ロングツインテールの『トーカ』
jp_grezzo: "ロングツインテールの『トーカ』"

jp: 元々は人類を敵性体から守るための汎用人型防衛兵器。光の巨人に憧れた当時の人類がオーバーテクノロジーを結集して生み出した。それゆえにあんまり制御が効かず、結局闇堕ちして暴走している。
jp_grezzo: "元々は人類を敵性体から守るための汎用人型防衛兵器。光の巨人に憧れた当時の人類がオーバーテクノロジーを結集して生み出した。それゆえにあんまり制御が効かず、結局闇堕ちして暴走している。"
en: Originally, it was a general-purpose humanoid defense weapon designed to protect humanity from hostile entities. It was created by the humans of the time, who admired the Titan of Light, by combining together several super-technologies. That's why it's so hard to control, ultimately falling to the side of darkness, and it is now on a violent rampage.
en_grezzo: "Originally, it was a general-purpose humanoid defense weapon designed to protect humanity from hostile entities. It was created by the humans of the time, who admired the Titan of Light, by combining together several super-technologies. That's why it's so hard to control, ultimately falling to the side of darkness, and it is now on a violent rampage."
it: In origine era un'arma difensiva umanoide polivalente, fatta per proteggere il genere umano dalle entità ostili. Gli uomini di allora, che ammiravano il gigante di luce, la crearono mettendo insieme tecnologie troppo avanzate per loro. Proprio per questo si controlla poco, ed è finita per cadere nell'oscurità e scatenarsi.

jp: 名前は、黒い者という意味。かつて炎で世界を焼き尽くしたと豪語する巨人。しかし戦争の混乱に乗じて世界樹に放火したのを、大袈裟に言っているだけという説もある。
jp_grezzo: "名前は、黒い者という意味。かつて炎で世界を焼き尽くしたと豪語する巨人。しかし戦争の混乱に乗じて世界樹に放火したのを、大袈裟に言っているだけという説もある。"
en: His name means \"The Black One\". He is a giant who claims to have burned down the entire world with flames. However, there is a theory that all he actually did was set fire to the world tree, while using the confusion of the Great War to push his exaggerated stories.
en_grezzo: "His name means \"The Black One\". He is a giant who claims to have burned down the entire world with flames. However, there is a theory that all he actually did was set fire to the world tree, while using the confusion of the Great War to push his exaggerated stories."
it: Il nome significa il Nero. È un gigante che si vanta di avere incenerito il mondo intero con le fiamme. C'è però chi sostiene che, approfittando della confusione della guerra, abbia soltanto dato fuoco all'albero del mondo, e che il resto sia esagerazione sua.

jp: 怪力が自慢の巨人。喧嘩を売ってきたインド象をわしづかみにして１０マイルぶん投げたという記録もある。先祖は神に殺されない特異体質を備えていたが、代を重ねるうちに喪失してしまった。
jp_grezzo: "怪力が自慢の巨人。喧嘩を売ってきたインド象をわしづかみにして１０マイルぶん投げたという記録もある。先祖は神に殺されない特異体質を備えていたが、代を重ねるうちに喪失してしまった。"
en: A giant who boasts of his monstrous strength. There is a record of him grabbing an Indian elephant that was trying to fight him and throwing it ten miles. His ancestors had a unique constitution that prevented them from being killed by the gods, but they lost it over the generations.
en_grezzo: "A giant who boasts of his monstrous strength. There is a record of him grabbing an Indian elephant that was trying to fight him and throwing it ten miles. His ancestors had a unique constitution that prevented them from being killed by the gods, but they lost it over the generations."
it: Un gigante che va fiero della sua forza mostruosa. Risulta agli atti che afferrò un elefante indiano venuto a cercar rissa e lo scagliò per dieci miglia. I suoi antenati avevano una costituzione particolare che impediva alle divinità di ucciderli, ma di generazione in generazione l'hanno perduta.

jp: 巨人族のご令嬢。成長期で爆発的に背が伸びるが、それまでは人里に紛れて暮らすこともある。小さくて可愛いものが好きで病的に固執するが、力加減を間違えてうっかり殺してしまうことも多い。都合が悪くなるとなぜかハトの鳴き真似で誤魔化そうとする。
jp_grezzo: "巨人族のご令嬢。成長期で爆発的に背が伸びるが、それまでは人里に紛れて暮らすこともある。小さくて可愛いものが好きで病的に固執するが、力加減を間違えてうっかり殺してしまうことも多い。都合が悪くなるとなぜかハトの鳴き真似で誤魔化そうとする。"
en: The young lady of the giant race. Her height grows explosively during her formative years, but until then, she can slip into human civilization unnoticed. She loves small, cute things and is morbidly obsessed with them, but often kills them by mistake. When the going gets tough, she tries to cover it up by imitating the cries of pigeons.
en_grezzo: "The young lady of the giant race. Her height grows explosively during her formative years, but until then, she can slip into human civilization unnoticed. She loves small, cute things and is morbidly obsessed with them, but often kills them by mistake. When the going gets tough, she tries to cover it up by imitating the cries of pigeons."
it: La signorina della stirpe dei giganti. Nell'età dello sviluppo cresce di statura in modo esplosivo, ma prima di allora può anche vivere mescolata fra gli uomini. Ama le cose piccole e carine di un'ossessione morbosa, e spesso, sbagliando la forza, le uccide senza volerlo. Quando la faccenda si mette male, chissà perché, prova a cavarsela imitando il verso del piccione.

jp: 長い年月を経て魔力を吸収した水晶が変化した。美貌には自信があり、男女問わず魅了しようとする。吸収した魔力の質や量に応じて誕生時の色が決まるが、どの個体も自分の色が一番綺麗だと思っているらしい。
jp_grezzo: "長い年月を経て魔力を吸収した水晶が変化した。美貌には自信があり、男女問わず魅了しようとする。吸収した魔力の質や量に応じて誕生時の色が決まるが、どの個体も自分の色が一番綺麗だと思っているらしい。"
en: A crystal that absorbs magical power transforms into a crystalian after many years. She is confident in her beauty and tries to attract both men and women. The color of the crystal at birth is determined by the quality and quantity of magic power absorbed, but every individual crystalian seems to think that their own color is the most beautiful.
en_grezzo: "A crystal that absorbs magical power transforms into a crystalian after many years. She is confident in her beauty and tries to attract both men and women. The color of the crystal at birth is determined by the quality and quantity of magic power absorbed, but every individual crystalian seems to think that their own color is the most beautiful."
it: Un cristallo che, assorbendo potere magico per lunghissimi anni, si è trasformato. Ha fiducia nella propria bellezza e cerca di ammaliare uomini e donne senza distinzione. Il colore che ha alla nascita dipende dalla qualità e dalla quantità del potere assorbito, ma pare che ogni esemplare consideri il proprio il più bello di tutti.

jp: 電気を得てより強い磁力を発現した。同族の中では伯爵級より上の公爵級と呼ばれている。十分な電気がないと今の地位を保てないので、電気を求めて街を襲うことも。
jp_grezzo: "電気を得てより強い磁力を発現した。同族の中では伯爵級より上の公爵級と呼ばれている。十分な電気がないと今の地位を保てないので、電気を求めて街を襲うことも。"
en: A mag count that has absorbed electricity and developed a stronger magnetic force. Among his peers, he is called a duke, which is higher than a count. He can't maintain his current standing without sufficient electrical power, so he sometimes attacks cities in search of power sources.
en_grezzo: "A mag count that has absorbed electricity and developed a stronger magnetic force. Among his peers, he is called a duke, which is higher than a count. He can't maintain his current standing without sufficient electrical power, so he sometimes attacks cities in search of power sources."
it: Il conte magnetico che, ottenuta l'elettricità, ha sviluppato una forza magnetica più forte. Fra i suoi simili lo dicono di grado ducale, che sta sopra a quello comitale. Senza elettricità a sufficienza la posizione non la tiene, e allora capita che assalti le città per procurarsela.

jp: 磁力を自在に操れるようになった岩の怪物。砂鉄をいっぱい集められる奴ほど偉い、という価値観が同族の中では一般的であり、その中でもこいつは伯爵級とされている。
jp_grezzo: "磁力を自在に操れるようになった岩の怪物。砂鉄をいっぱい集められる奴ほど偉い、という価値観が同族の中では一般的であり、その中でもこいつは伯爵級とされている。"
en: A rock monster that can manipulate magnetic forces at will. Among those of his kind, it is said that the one who can collect the most iron sand is the greatest, and they are granted the title of Count.
en_grezzo: "A rock monster that can manipulate magnetic forces at will. Among those of his kind, it is said that the one who can collect the most iron sand is the greatest, and they are granted the title of Count."
it: Un mostro di roccia che è arrivato a manovrare a piacere la forza magnetica. Fra i suoi simili vale il principio che conta di più chi riesce a raccogliere più sabbia ferrosa, e in quella scala questo qui è di grado comitale.

jp: まだ飛べないツバメのヒナ。やかましい上に糞をまき散らす。幸せな顔で仕事にのめり込む父の姿を見てドン引きしており、将来は働かずにヒモになりたいと思っている。
jp_grezzo: "まだ飛べないツバメのヒナ。やかましい上に糞をまき散らす。幸せな顔で仕事にのめり込む父の姿を見てドン引きしており、将来は働かずにヒモになりたいと思っている。"
en: A swallow chick who can't fly yet. He is a nasty bird and spreads feces around. He is disgusted to see his father so absorbed in his work with a happy face, and wants to leech off of him instead of working in the future.
en_grezzo: "A swallow chick who can't fly yet. He is a nasty bird and spreads feces around. He is disgusted to see his father so absorbed in his work with a happy face, and wants to leech off of him instead of working in the future."
it: Un rondinotto che ancora non vola. È chiassoso e per giunta sparge escrementi in giro. Vedere il padre che si tuffa nel lavoro con quella faccia felice lo disgusta, e da grande vorrebbe non lavorare e farsi mantenere.

jp: 魔女王蜂から産まれた働き蜂。ダンスが好きで、餌場を見つけると踊って姉妹に知らせる。重度の甘党だが、集めた蜜はつまみ食いせずにちゃんと我慢して持って帰る。
jp_grezzo: "魔女王蜂から産まれた働き蜂。ダンスが好きで、餌場を見つけると踊って姉妹に知らせる。重度の甘党だが、集めた蜜はつまみ食いせずにちゃんと我慢して持って帰る。"
en: A worker bee born from a queen bee. She likes to dance, and when she finds a place to feed, she dances to let her sisters know. She has a serious sweet tooth, but she doesn't snack on the honey she collects and brings it home with her.
en_grezzo: "A worker bee born from a queen bee. She likes to dance, and when she finds a place to feed, she dances to let her sisters know. She has a serious sweet tooth, but she doesn't snack on the honey she collects and brings it home with her."
it: Un'ape operaia nata dall'ape stregina. Le piace ballare, e quando trova un posto dove mangiare balla per avvisare le sorelle. È golosissima, ma il miele che raccoglie non lo assaggia: si trattiene e lo porta a casa tutto.

jp: ノルンの血の繋がらない妹。どこから生えてきたかも分からない妹にノルンは当初大変困惑したし、なんなら今でもちょっと距離を置いている。戦闘能力はからっきしだが、持ち前の明るさで一生懸命ガイドする。
jp_grezzo: "ノルンの血の繋がらない妹。どこから生えてきたかも分からない妹にノルンは当初大変困惑したし、なんなら今でもちょっと距離を置いている。戦闘能力はからっきしだが、持ち前の明るさで一生懸命ガイドする。"
en: Norn's sister, who's not related by blood. At first, Norn was very confused by her sister, since he didn't know where she came from, and even now he keeps her at a distance. She's not much of a fighter, but she does her best to guide people with her natural cheerfulness.
en_grezzo: "Norn's sister, who's not related by blood. At first, Norn was very confused by her sister, since he didn't know where she came from, and even now he keeps her at a distance. She's not much of a fighter, but she does her best to guide people with her natural cheerfulness."
it: La sorella minore di Norne, che non ne ha il sangue. All'inizio questa sorella spuntata da chissà dove ha messo Norne in grande imbarazzo, e un po' di distanza resta ancora oggi. In combattimento non vale nulla, ma fa del suo meglio per guidare la gente con quel buonumore che si ritrova.

jp: 新人ガイドの『ヨノルン』
幸福であることに囚われたツバメ。金持ちを身ぐるみ剥いで貧しい者たちに金品を渡すのが仕事。自分は幸福なのだと自身に言い聞かせ、妻を失った悲しみを育児と仕事に溺れて紛らわせている。
jp_grezzo: "幸福であることに囚われたツバメ。金持ちを身ぐるみ剥いで貧しい者たちに金品を渡すのが仕事。自分は幸福なのだと自身に言い聞かせ、妻を失った悲しみを育児と仕事に溺れて紛らわせている。"
en: A swallow who is a slave to his own happiness. His job is to strip rich people of their clothes and give their money to the poor. He convinces himself that he is happy, and drowns his sorrows over the loss of his wife in his childrearing and work.
en_grezzo: "A swallow who is a slave to his own happiness. His job is to strip rich people of their clothes and give their money to the poor. He convinces himself that he is happy, and drowns his sorrows over the loss of his wife in his childrearing and work."
it: Una rondine prigioniera del proprio essere felice. Il suo mestiere è spogliare i ricchi di tutto quello che hanno e passarne il denaro ai poveri. Si ripete che è felice, e annega nel lavoro e nella cura dei figli il dolore per la moglie perduta.

jp: 蜂蜜酒の製造会社を経営している未亡蜂。唾液には特殊な魔力が混ざっており、集まった蜜をたちまち加工してしまう。性格はおだやかだが、子供の教育には結構キビしい。
jp_grezzo: "蜂蜜酒の製造会社を経営している未亡蜂。唾液には特殊な魔力が混ざっており、集まった蜜をたちまち加工してしまう。性格はおだやかだが、子供の教育には結構キビしい。"
en: A widowed bee who runs a company that produces honey wine. Her saliva contains a special magical power that allows her to quickly process the honey she collects. She has a gentle personality, but is very strict when it comes to how she raises her children.
en_grezzo: "A widowed bee who runs a company that produces honey wine. Her saliva contains a special magical power that allows her to quickly process the honey she collects. She has a gentle personality, but is very strict when it comes to how she raises her children."
it: Un'ape vedova che manda avanti un'azienda di idromele. Nella saliva ha un potere magico speciale che lavora in un attimo il miele raccolto. Ha un carattere pacato, ma sull'educazione dei figli è piuttosto severa.

jp: 家々を渡り歩いて小馬鹿にする少女。笑って住み着いている間は幸運を呼び、去ると同時に不幸になると言われている。正体は子供の霊。大人をおちょくりすぎて殺され床下に埋められたらしい。今でも気を惹きたくてつい意地悪してしまうのだとか。
jp_grezzo: "家々を渡り歩いて小馬鹿にする少女。笑って住み着いている間は幸運を呼び、去ると同時に不幸になると言われている。正体は子供の霊。大人をおちょくりすぎて殺され床下に埋められたらしい。今でも気を惹きたくてつい意地悪してしまうのだとか。"
en: A girl who walks from house to house making a fool of herself. It is said that she brings good luck as long as she smiles and lives there, and misfortune as soon as she leaves. She is actually a child spirit. It is said that she was killed and buried under the floor for taunting adults too much. Even now, it's been said that she tries to attract people's attention by being mean to them.
en_grezzo: "A girl who walks from house to house making a fool of herself. It is said that she brings good luck as long as she smiles and lives there, and misfortune as soon as she leaves. She is actually a child spirit. It is said that she was killed and buried under the floor for taunting adults too much. Even now, it's been said that she tries to attract people's attention by being mean to them."
it: Una bambina che va di casa in casa a prendere in giro chi ci abita. Si dice che finché ride e resta lì porti fortuna, e che appena se ne va arrivi la sciagura. In verità è lo spirito di una bambina: pare che a furia di sbeffeggiare i grandi l'abbiano uccisa e sepolta sotto il pavimento. Ancora oggi fa dispetti solo perché vorrebbe attenzione.

jp: 別名、メンヘラクソヤモリ。再生能力の高さを活かして、気軽にリストカットしている。自分を受け入れてくれた家を何より愛し、強力な吸盤で壁に張り付いてじっくりネットリと見張るようになる。
jp_grezzo: "別名、メンヘラクソヤモリ。再生能力の高さを活かして、気軽にリストカットしている。自分を受け入れてくれた家を何より愛し、強力な吸盤で壁に張り付いてじっくりネットリと見張るようになる。"
en: Also known as Menhera's Gecko. He takes advantage of his regenerative abilities to leisurely cut his wrists. He loves the household that took him in more than anything else, and sticks to the wall with his powerful suction cups to keep a focused and watchful eye on it.
en_grezzo: "Also known as Menhera's Gecko. He takes advantage of his regenerative abilities to leisurely cut his wrists. He loves the household that took him in more than anything else, and sticks to the wall with his powerful suction cups to keep a focused and watchful eye on it."
it: Detto anche il geco molesto dall'umore instabile. Sfrutta la sua grande capacità di rigenerarsi e si taglia i polsi con leggerezza. Ama sopra ogni cosa la casa che l'ha accolto, e finisce per attaccarsi al muro con le ventose potenti e sorvegliarla con una calma appiccicosa.

jp: トラックに撥ねられた拍子に異世界からやってきた猫。理屈は不明だが、ＭＰを消費せずに詠唱できるチート体質になった。同族から妙に評価されているが、それは無自覚に支配の魔法を放っているせいである。
jp_grezzo: "トラックに撥ねられた拍子に異世界からやってきた猫。理屈は不明だが、ＭＰを消費せずに詠唱できるチート体質になった。同族から妙に評価されているが、それは無自覚に支配の魔法を放っているせいである。"
en: A cat that came from another world after being hit by a truck. For some unknown reason, he has gained the innate powers of cheating and can recite magic without consuming MP. He is held in unusually high regard by his own kind, but that is because he is unconsciously casting domination magic on them all.
en_grezzo: "A cat that came from another world after being hit by a truck. For some unknown reason, he has gained the innate powers of cheating and can recite magic without consuming MP. He is held in unusually high regard by his own kind, but that is because he is unconsciously casting domination magic on them all."
it: Un gatto arrivato da un altro mondo nell'istante in cui un camion l'ha investito. Non si sa per quale ragione, ma ha acquisito una costituzione da baro e recita gli incantesimi senza consumare MP. I suoi simili lo stimano stranamente, ma è perché lancia magie di dominio senza nemmeno accorgersene.
il ghebardo di un altro mondo

jp: 走るのがめちゃくちゃ速い動物として古代から称えられてきた猫。近年の研究の結果、ただのチートだったことが判明して大炎上した。
jp_grezzo: "走るのがめちゃくちゃ速い動物として古代から称えられてきた猫。近年の研究の結果、ただのチートだったことが判明して大炎上した。"
en: A cat who has been celebrated since ancient times as an animal that can run extremely fast. As a result of recent research, it turned out that his abilities were merely the result of cheating, causing a huge firestorm of backlash.
en_grezzo: "A cat who has been celebrated since ancient times as an animal that can run extremely fast. As a result of recent research, it turned out that his abilities were merely the result of cheating, causing a huge firestorm of backlash."
it: Un gatto celebrato fin dall'antichità come l'animale che corre più veloce di tutti. Ricerche recenti hanno stabilito che era soltanto un imbroglio, e ne è nato un putiferio.

jp: かつては百発百中の魔弾の射手として恐れられた。いい気になって長年サボってしまい、ブランクにより腕前がカス同然に低下。過去の栄光を取り戻すため、チートに手を染めることを選んだ正真正銘のカス。
jp_grezzo: "かつては百発百中の魔弾の射手として恐れられた。いい気になって長年サボってしまい、ブランクにより腕前がカス同然に低下。過去の栄光を取り戻すため、チートに手を染めることを選んだ正真正銘のカス。"
en: He was once feared as a magic bullet archer who could hit a hundred targets with a hundred shots. However, after many years of slacking off, his skills have degraded to the level of a scum. In order to regain his past glory, he chose to turn to cheating.
en_grezzo: "He was once feared as a magic bullet archer who could hit a hundred targets with a hundred shots. However, after many years of slacking off, his skills have degraded to the level of a scum. In order to regain his past glory, he chose to turn to cheating."
it: Un tempo lo temevano come il tiratore dal proiettile magico che fa cento colpi su cento. Poi si è montato la testa, ha oziato per anni, e la lunga pausa gli ha ridotto la mira a una schifezza. Per riprendersi la gloria di un tempo ha scelto di darsi all'imbroglio: una schifezza vera e propria.

jp: 努力せずに戦場で生き残るため、壁に潜るチート能力を手にした。しかし堪え性のない性格なのでついつい壁から飛び出しがち。ついでのように空中浮遊もする。
jp_grezzo: "努力せずに戦場で生き残るため、壁に潜るチート能力を手にした。しかし堪え性のない性格なのでついつい壁から飛び出しがち。ついでのように空中浮遊もする。"
en: In order to survive on the battlefield without effort, he has acquired the cheat ability to hide behind walls. However, he has an unbearable personality and tends to jump out of walls. He also floats in the air as a bonus.
en_grezzo: "In order to survive on the battlefield without effort, he has acquired the cheat ability to hide behind walls. However, he has an unbearable personality and tends to jump out of walls. He also floats in the air as a bonus."
it: Per sopravvivere sul campo di battaglia senza fare fatica si è procurato il trucco di infilarsi dentro i muri. Ma non ha pazienza, e finisce sempre per saltarne fuori. E già che c'è, fluttua anche a mezz'aria.

jp: とても性格の悪い魔物。冥宮を作り出し、本来別の所に行くべき魂を騙して引きずり込んでいる犯人。抵抗のできない相手にとことん嫌がらせをしてニヤニヤしている。
jp_grezzo: "とても性格の悪い魔物。冥宮を作り出し、本来別の所に行くべき魂を騙して引きずり込んでいる犯人。抵抗のできない相手にとことん嫌がらせをしてニヤニヤしている。"
en: A demon with a very bad personality. He is the culprit behind the creation of the Underworld Palace, tricking and dragging in souls that should be going elsewhere. He harasses those who can't resist and smirks at them to no end.
en_grezzo: "A demon with a very bad personality. He is the culprit behind the creation of the Underworld Palace, tricking and dragging in souls that should be going elsewhere. He harasses those who can't resist and smirks at them to no end."
it: Un demone dal carattere pessimo. È lui il colpevole: ha creato il Palazzo Infero e ci trascina dentro con l'inganno le anime che dovrebbero andare altrove. Perseguita fino in fondo chi non può opporsi, e intanto ghigna.

jp: 死者の霧散した魔力から発生した、霧状の化け物。じめじめした場所が好きだが、風に吹き飛ばされてしまうので居場所は選べない。
jp_grezzo: "死者の霧散した魔力から発生した、霧状の化け物。じめじめした場所が好きだが、風に吹き飛ばされてしまうので居場所は選べない。"
en: A fog-like monster that arises from the foggy magic of the dead. It likes damp places, but cannot choose where to stay because it is blown away by the wind.
en_grezzo: "A fog-like monster that arises from the foggy magic of the dead. It likes damp places, but cannot choose where to stay because it is blown away by the wind."
it: Un mostro fatto di nebbia, nato dal potere magico disperso dei morti. Predilige i luoghi umidi, ma il vento se lo porta via e il posto dove stare non può sceglierlo.

jp: 生者に追い縋る巨大な霊。恐るべき執念と力で害をなす存在だが、本当は誰かに救ってほしくて必死に縋りついているだけなのだ。
jp_grezzo: "生者に追い縋る巨大な霊。恐るべき執念と力で害をなす存在だが、本当は誰かに救ってほしくて必死に縋りついているだけなのだ。"
en: A giant spirit that clings to the living. They are harmful with their terrifying obsession and power, but in reality they are just desperately clinging to people because they want someone to save them.
en_grezzo: "A giant spirit that clings to the living. They are harmful with their terrifying obsession and power, but in reality they are just desperately clinging to people because they want someone to save them."
it: Uno spirito enorme che si aggrappa ai vivi. Fa danno con un'ostinazione e una forza spaventose, ma in verità sta solo aggrappandosi con tutte le forze perché vorrebbe che qualcuno lo salvasse.

jp: 特に何もない普通の家庭の子供だった。無知で無垢で無邪気。それゆえに邪悪な魔物に騙されて冥宮に迷い込んでしまう。
jp_grezzo: "特に何もない普通の家庭の子供だった。無知で無垢で無邪気。それゆえに邪悪な魔物に騙されて冥宮に迷い込んでしまう。"
en: He was a child of a normal family, where nothing particularly went wrong. He is ignorant, pure, and innocent. That's why he's an easy target for deception by demons and often gets lost in the underworld.
en_grezzo: "He was a child of a normal family, where nothing particularly went wrong. He is ignorant, pure, and innocent. That's why he's an easy target for deception by demons and often gets lost in the underworld."
it: Era il bambino di una famiglia normale, senza niente di particolare. Ignorante, puro, innocente. E proprio per questo i mostri malvagi lo ingannano e lo fanno smarrire nel Palazzo Infero.

jp: 亜竜最強の座に君臨しているモンスター。凄まじいブレスを吐き、星をも砕くと形容されるほどにパワフルだが、仲間を次々に呼ぶ。最強であろうと己の力に慢心しないことが大事だと、理解しているのだ。
jp_grezzo: "亜竜最強の座に君臨しているモンスター。凄まじいブレスを吐き、星をも砕くと形容されるほどにパワフルだが、仲間を次々に呼ぶ。最強であろうと己の力に慢心しないことが大事だと、理解しているのだ。"
en: A monster that reigns as the strongest of the sub-dragons. He spits out a tremendous breath and is so powerful that he is said to shatter stars, but he also calls upon each one of his allies. He understands that it is important not to be too proud of his power, even if he is the strongest.
en_grezzo: "A monster that reigns as the strongest of the sub-dragons. He spits out a tremendous breath and is so powerful that he is said to shatter stars, but he also calls upon each one of his allies. He understands that it is important not to be too proud of his power, even if he is the strongest."
it: Il mostro che siede sul trono di draco più forte. Sputa un soffio tremendo ed è potente al punto che lo si dice capace di frantumare le stelle, eppure chiama i compagni uno dopo l'altro: ha capito che, per quanto si sia i più forti, non bisogna montarsi la testa.

jp: 電撃を操る翼竜。自力で発電することはできないので、定期的に雷雲の中で充電している。充電しすぎると身体が焦げたり爆発したりするので命懸けらしい。
jp_grezzo: "電撃を操る翼竜。自力で発電することはできないので、定期的に雷雲の中で充電している。充電しすぎると身体が焦げたり爆発したりするので命懸けらしい。"
en: A pterosaur that can control electricity. It can't generate electricity on its own, so it periodically recharges itself by flying through thunderclouds. It is said that it risks his life because his body will be burnt or explode if it overcharges.
en_grezzo: "A pterosaur that can control electricity. It can't generate electricity on its own, so it periodically recharges itself by flying through thunderclouds. It is said that it risks his life because his body will be burnt or explode if it overcharges."
it: Uno pterosauro che manovra le scariche elettriche. Da solo non produce corrente, e allora si ricarica periodicamente dentro le nubi temporalesche. Se si carica troppo il corpo gli si brucia o gli esplode: pare che ci rischi la vita.

jp: 蛇のような体、竜の頭、蝙蝠の翼を持つ亜竜。性格は凶暴で好戦的。細長いので狭い場所にも入り込んでくる。ただし一度絡まってしまうと自力ではどうにもならず、死を待つばかりとなる。
jp_grezzo: "蛇のような体、竜の頭、蝙蝠の翼を持つ亜竜。性格は凶暴で好戦的。細長いので狭い場所にも入り込んでくる。ただし一度絡まってしまうと自力ではどうにもならず、死を待つばかりとなる。"
en: A sub-dragon with the body of a snake, the head of a dragon, and the wings of a bat. It has a ferocious and belligerent personality. It is long and slender, so it can get into narrow spaces. However, once it gets entangled, it becomes unable to help itself and has no choice but to await death.
en_grezzo: "A sub-dragon with the body of a snake, the head of a dragon, and the wings of a bat. It has a ferocious and belligerent personality. It is long and slender, so it can get into narrow spaces. However, once it gets entangled, it becomes unable to help itself and has no choice but to await death."
it: Un draco con il corpo di serpente, la testa di drago e le ali di pipistrello. Ha un carattere feroce e attaccabrighe. È lungo e sottile, quindi si infila anche negli spazi stretti; ma una volta che si aggroviglia non se ne cava più da solo, e non gli resta che aspettare la morte.

jp: ネズミと共生している珍しい翼竜。運搬能力には自信があるが、気が弱く戦闘が苦手。上空からこいつが獲物を探し、大量のネズミを投下。食べ残しをありがたく頂く。
jp_grezzo: "ネズミと共生している珍しい翼竜。運搬能力には自信があるが、気が弱く戦闘が苦手。上空からこいつが獲物を探し、大量のネズミを投下。食べ残しをありがたく頂く。"
en: A rare pterosaur that coexists with rats. It is confident in its carrying ability, but is weak and not good at fighting. It searches for its prey from above and drops a large number of rats, then gratefully consumes what's left over.
en_grezzo: "A rare pterosaur that coexists with rats. It is confident in its carrying ability, but is weak and not good at fighting. It searches for its prey from above and drops a large number of rats, then gratefully consumes what's left over."
it: Un raro pterosauro che vive in simbiosi con i ratti. Ha fiducia nella propria capacità di trasporto, ma è di animo debole e combattere non fa per lui. Cerca la preda dall'alto e le lascia cadere addosso una valanga di ratti; poi ringrazia e si prende gli avanzi.

jp: 三つの手からなる邪悪な怪物。こいつと格闘家の攻防を見た吟遊詩人が、その様子を再現して各地で伝えた。後にそれが遊戯となり、この怪物の名前からジャンケンと命名されたという説がある。
jp_grezzo: "三つの手からなる邪悪な怪物。こいつと格闘家の攻防を見た吟遊詩人が、その様子を再現して各地で伝えた。後にそれが遊戯となり、この怪物の名前からジャンケンと命名されたという説がある。"
en: An evil monster with three hands. A bard who saw a fight between this monster and a fighter recreated the scene and passed it around from place to place. Some have said that it later became a game, and was named rock-paper-scissors after the monster.
en_grezzo: "An evil monster with three hands. A bard who saw a fight between this monster and a fighter recreated the scene and passed it around from place to place. Some have said that it later became a game, and was named rock-paper-scissors after the monster."
it: Un mostro malvagio fatto di tre mani. Un menestrello che vide lo scontro fra lui e un lottatore ne rifece la scena e la portò in giro di paese in paese. C'è chi dice che più tardi sia diventata un gioco, e che la morra abbia preso il nome da questo mostro.

jp: 力を求めすぎた者の成れの果て。タチの悪い悪魔によって呪いの力を掴まされ、モンスターと成り果てたらしい。手だけになってしまったが本人は割と満足している。
jp_grezzo: "力を求めすぎた者の成れの果て。タチの悪い悪魔によって呪いの力を掴まされ、モンスターと成り果てたらしい。手だけになってしまったが本人は割と満足している。"
en: An incarnation of fateful end of those who seek too much power. It seems that he was given the power of the curse by a demon and became a monster. He has only his hands, but he's rather happy with them.
en_grezzo: "An incarnation of fateful end of those who seek too much power. It seems that he was given the power of the curse by a demon and became a monster. He has only his hands, but he's rather happy with them."
it: Quel che resta di chi ha cercato troppo la forza. Pare che un demone di pessima specie gli abbia messo in mano il potere della maledizione, e che così sia diventato un mostro. Gli sono rimaste soltanto le mani, ma lui è abbastanza soddisfatto.

jp: あまりに悪さをし過ぎた猫の神が手を切り取られ、そこから生まれた。別名ゴッド猫パンチ。でかい肉球は触り心地抜群。いくら忙しくてもこの手を借りてくるのは大変である。
jp_grezzo: "あまりに悪さをし過ぎた猫の神が手を切り取られ、そこから生まれた。別名ゴッド猫パンチ。でかい肉球は触り心地抜群。いくら忙しくてもこの手を借りてくるのは大変である。"
en: A cat god who misbehaved too much had his hand cut off, and this what became of it. Also known as the God Cat Punch. The big paw is very soft to the touch. No matter how busy you are, it's going to be tricky having this hand on deck.
en_grezzo: "A cat god who misbehaved too much had his hand cut off, and this what became of it. Also known as the God Cat Punch. The big paw is very soft to the touch. No matter how busy you are, it's going to be tricky having this hand on deck."
it: Un dio gatto che aveva fatto troppe malefatte si vide tagliare la zampa, e da lì è nato. Detto anche il Divino Pugno di Gatto. I polpastrelli enormi sono meravigliosi da toccare. Ma per quanto si abbia da fare, farsi prestare questa zampa è un'impresa.

jp: 巨大な手の妖怪が人間に憧れて擬態した姿。普段はお洒落して気分よく散歩しているが、獲物を見つけると食欲のほうが勝ってしまう。下半身で鷲掴みにして手のひらにある巨大な口で捕食する。
jp_grezzo: "巨大な手の妖怪が人間に憧れて擬態した姿。普段はお洒落して気分よく散歩しているが、獲物を見つけると食欲のほうが勝ってしまう。下半身で鷲掴みにして手のひらにある巨大な口で捕食する。"
en: A giant hand demon that mimics humans out of admiration for them. It is usually dressed up and goes for a walk when in a good mood, but when it finds prey, its appetite wins out. It grabs the prey with its lower body and preys on it with the huge mouth in the palm of its hand.
en_grezzo: "A giant hand demon that mimics humans out of admiration for them. It is usually dressed up and goes for a walk when in a good mood, but when it finds prey, its appetite wins out. It grabs the prey with its lower body and preys on it with the huge mouth in the palm of its hand."
it: Un demone dalla mano gigantesca che, per ammirazione verso gli uomini, ne ha preso le sembianze. Di solito si fa bella e passeggia di buon umore, ma quando trova una preda l'appetito ha la meglio: la ghermisce con la parte inferiore del corpo e la divora con la bocca enorme che ha nel palmo.
la cortigiana dalla bocca in mano

jp: 不気味な白い手の集合体。その魔力のこもった手招きに抗うのは難しい。生きる者を恐ろしい力で掴んで根本へ引きずり込もうとする。なんでも根元が地獄に繋がっているのだとか。
jp_grezzo: "不気味な白い手の集合体。その魔力のこもった手招きに抗うのは難しい。生きる者を恐ろしい力で掴んで根本へ引きずり込もうとする。なんでも根元が地獄に繋がっているのだとか。"
en: A collection of eerie white hands. It is difficult to resist their magical beckoning. It grabs the living with its terrifying power and tries to drag them to the root. It is said that its root is connected to hell.
en_grezzo: "A collection of eerie white hands. It is difficult to resist their magical beckoning. It grabs the living with its terrifying power and tries to drag them to the root. It is said that its root is connected to hell."
it: Un ammasso di mani bianche inquietanti. Al loro cenno, carico di potere magico, è difficile resistere. Afferrano i vivi con una forza spaventosa e cercano di trascinarli giù verso la radice. Pare che quella radice arrivi fino all'inferno.

jp: 謎の語り手。本を通して可能性の世界をつなげる能力を持つ。ロストイルヴァ出身だと自称しているが、誰も彼女のことを知らない。おそらく彼女自身も他の世界から来たのだろう。
jp_grezzo: "謎の語り手。本を通して可能性の世界をつなげる能力を持つ。ロストイルヴァ出身だと自称しているが、誰も彼女のことを知らない。おそらく彼女自身も他の世界から来たのだろう。"
en: A mysterious storyteller. She has the ability to connect the world of possibilities through books. She claims to be from Lost Irva, but no one knows who she is. Perhaps she herself is from another world.
en_grezzo: "A mysterious storyteller. She has the ability to connect the world of possibilities through books. She claims to be from Lost Irva, but no one knows who she is. Perhaps she herself is from another world."
it: Una narratrice misteriosa. Ha il potere di collegare fra loro i mondi possibili attraverso i libri. Dice di venire da Irva Perduta, ma nessuno la conosce. Con ogni probabilità viene anche lei da un altro mondo.

jp: ストーリーテラーの『アイメ』
jp_grezzo: "ストーリーテラーの『アイメ』"

jp: 神のシステム。人類を監視しカルマを記録する。ただし神視点の基準は割と謎。悪事を見つけても、自分が襲われない限りは基本見ているだけで止めない。「神様はみておるぞ！」と悪事をたしなめる表現があるが、こいつが見ているということである。
jp_grezzo: "神のシステム。人類を監視しカルマを記録する。ただし神視点の基準は割と謎。悪事を見つけても、自分が襲われない限りは基本見ているだけで止めない。「神様はみておるぞ！」と悪事をたしなめる表現があるが、こいつが見ているということである。"
en: Gods' system. They monitor humanity and record their karma. However the standard of Gods' morality is a mystery. Even if they find something wrong they basically just watch and won't stop it unless they are attacked themselves.
en_grezzo: "Gods' system. They monitor humanity and record their karma. However the standard of Gods' morality is a mystery. Even if they find something wrong they basically just watch and won't stop it unless they are attacked themselves."
it: Il sistema delle divinità. Sorveglia il genere umano e ne registra il karma. Il criterio con cui le divinità giudicano, però, è piuttosto oscuro: anche quando scopre una malefatta, di regola si limita a guardare e non interviene, salvo che sia lui a essere aggredito. Quando si rimprovera un cattivo dicendo che le divinità guardano, è proprio lui che guarda.

jp: 全てを見通す知恵や、癒し・修復・再生のシンボル。ホルス神は神々の大戦で敗れており、再生できないよう左目もろとも念入りに粉みじんにされた。しかし左目の無数の欠片が個別に再生し、この魔物が生まれたという。
jp_grezzo: "全てを見通す知恵や、癒し・修復・再生のシンボル。ホルス神は神々の大戦で敗れており、再生できないよう左目もろとも念入りに粉みじんにされた。しかし左目の無数の欠片が個別に再生し、この魔物が生まれたという。"
en: It is a symbol of all-seeing wisdom and healing restoration and renewal. The god Horus was defeated in the Great War of the Gods and his left eye was carefully pulverized so that he could not regenerate. However countless pieces of his left eye regenerated individually and this demon was born.
en_grezzo: "It is a symbol of all-seeing wisdom and healing restoration and renewal. The god Horus was defeated in the Great War of the Gods and his left eye was carefully pulverized so that he could not regenerate. However countless pieces of his left eye regenerated individually and this demon was born."
it: È il simbolo della sapienza che vede ogni cosa, e insieme della guarigione, della riparazione e della rinascita. Il dio Horus fu sconfitto nella grande guerra delle divinità, e perché non potesse rinascere lo ridussero in polvere con cura, l'occhio sinistro compreso. Ma gli innumerevoli frammenti dell'occhio sinistro rinacquero ognuno per conto suo, e così nacque questo mostro.

jp: 不気味な目を大量に持つ怪物。目が多いのでこの名前がつけられたが、実際に調べてみると目の個数は百ではないし、個体差もある。全身に急所がついているようなものなので図体の割に打たれ弱い。
jp_grezzo: "不気味な目を大量に持つ怪物。目が多いのでこの名前がつけられたが、実際に調べてみると目の個数は百ではないし、個体差もある。全身に急所がついているようなものなので図体の割に打たれ弱い。"
en: A monster with a large amount of creepy eyes. It was given this name because it has many eyes but it was found that the number of eyes is not a hundred and there are individual differences. It seems like they have sharp points all over their body so their is not easy to be hit considering his size.
en_grezzo: "A monster with a large amount of creepy eyes. It was given this name because it has many eyes but it was found that the number of eyes is not a hundred and there are individual differences. It seems like they have sharp points all over their body so their is not easy to be hit considering his size."
it: Un mostro con una gran quantità di occhi inquietanti. Il nome gli viene dal numero di occhi, ma a contarli davvero non sono cento, e per giunta variano da individuo a individuo. È come se avesse punti deboli su tutto il corpo, e per la mole che ha incassa poco.

jp: 生化学文明紀に、神の監視システムを真似て作られた。当時でもタブーな技術だったらしい。空間認識能力は高いが不完全な失敗作。自分を産み出した身勝手な人類に対して激しい憎悪を抱いている。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明紀に、神の監視システムを真似て作られた。当時でもタブーな技術だったらしい。空間認識能力は高いが不完全な失敗作。自分を産み出した身勝手な人類に対して激しい憎悪を抱いている。"
en: It was created in the Biochemical Civilization to imitate God's surveillance system. Apparently it was a taboo technique even back then. It's a flop with high but incomplete spatial awareness. It has a fierce hatred for the selfish humanity that gave birth to him.
en_grezzo: "It was created in the Biochemical Civilization to imitate God's surveillance system. Apparently it was a taboo technique even back then. It's a flop with high but incomplete spatial awareness. It has a fierce hatred for the selfish humanity that gave birth to him."
it: Fu costruito nell'era della civiltà biochimica, imitando il sistema di sorveglianza delle divinità. Pare che già allora fosse una tecnica proibita. Ha una buona percezione dello spazio, ma è un fallimento lasciato a metà. Verso il genere umano che l'ha messo al mondo per capriccio prova un odio feroce.

jp: 神経や筋肉を束ねて人に擬態した目モンスター。ヒトツメ小僧と呼ばれる妖怪が起源であると思われがちだが、名前に反して種的な繋がりはない。決して友好的なモンスターではないが、大きな目がキュートだと褒めてあげると結構デレる。
jp_grezzo: "神経や筋肉を束ねて人に擬態した目モンスター。ヒトツメ小僧と呼ばれる妖怪が起源であると思われがちだが、名前に反して種的な繋がりはない。決して友好的なモンスターではないが、大きな目がキュートだと褒めてあげると結構デレる。"
en: An eye monster that mimics a person by binding nerves and muscles together. It is often thought to have originated from a yokai called Hitotsume Kozo but contrary to the name there is no species connection. It's not a friendly monster but if you compliment its cute big eye it'll blush quite a bit.
en_grezzo: "An eye monster that mimics a person by binding nerves and muscles together. It is often thought to have originated from a yokai called Hitotsume Kozo but contrary to the name there is no species connection. It's not a friendly monster but if you compliment its cute big eye it'll blush quite a bit."
it: Un mostro-occhio che si finge persona legando insieme nervi e muscoli. Si crede spesso che discenda dallo spiritello chiamato Hitotsume Kozo, ma malgrado il nome non c'è nessun legame di specie. Amichevole non lo è affatto; però, se le si dice che ha un occhione carino, si ammorbidisce parecchio.

jp: 大戦時の罪を赦され、本来の力を取り戻したテスカトリポカ。煙の軍勢を率い、夜に紛れて現れては消え、敵を翻弄する。
jp_grezzo: "大戦時の罪を赦され、本来の力を取り戻したテスカトリポカ。煙の軍勢を率い、夜に紛れて現れては消え、敵を翻弄する。"
en: Tezcatlipoca has been forgiven for his sins during the Great War and regained his original power. He leads an army of smoke appearing and disappearing under the cover of night and plays with the enemy.
en_grezzo: "Tezcatlipoca has been forgiven for his sins during the Great War and regained his original power. He leads an army of smoke appearing and disappearing under the cover of night and plays with the enemy."
it: Tezcatlipoca, perdonato per le colpe della grande guerra, ha riavuto la sua forza originaria. Guida un esercito di fumo, appare e scompare confondendosi con la notte, e si prende gioco del nemico.

jp: 混沌の息子を名乗る神。他の神を全て滅ぼし、名実ともに唯一神として君臨しようとしている傲慢なやつ。最終目標は、世界を造り変えて完全な悪が充満する世にすること。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の息子を名乗る神。他の神を全て滅ぼし、名実ともに唯一神として君臨しようとしている傲慢なやつ。最終目標は、世界を造り変えて完全な悪が充満する世にすること。"
en: A god who calls himself the son of chaos. The arrogant one who wants to destroy all the other gods and reign as the only god in name and reality. His ultimate goal is to reshape the world into a world full of perfect evil.
en_grezzo: "A god who calls himself the son of chaos. The arrogant one who wants to destroy all the other gods and reign as the only god in name and reality. His ultimate goal is to reshape the world into a world full of perfect evil."
it: Un dio che si proclama figlio del caos. Un arrogante che vuole annientare tutte le altre divinità e regnare come dio unico di nome e di fatto. Il suo scopo ultimo è rifare il mondo perché sia colmo di male perfetto.

jp: 偽りの造物主【ヤルダバオート】
jp_grezzo: "偽りの造物主【ヤルダバオート】"

jp: 混沌の意志から解放されたオルフェ。かつて混沌に挑み、一人だけ生き残らされた英雄。守るべきものも愛するものも亡くしたが、誇りは失っていない。肉体が変質し、不老になっている。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の意志から解放されたオルフェ。かつて混沌に挑み、一人だけ生き残らされた英雄。守るべきものも愛するものも亡くしたが、誇りは失っていない。肉体が変質し、不老になっている。"
en: Orphe is freed from the will of chaos. A hero who once defied chaos and the only one left alive. He has lost everything he had to protect and everything he loved but he has not lost his pride. His body has been transformed and he has become ageless.
en_grezzo: "Orphe is freed from the will of chaos. A hero who once defied chaos and the only one left alive. He has lost everything he had to protect and everything he loved but he has not lost his pride. His body has been transformed and he has become ageless."
it: Orphe liberato dalla volontà del caos. È l'eroe che un tempo sfidò il caos e che, solo fra tutti, fu lasciato in vita. Ha perduto ciò che doveva proteggere e ciò che amava, ma non l'orgoglio. Il suo corpo si è trasformato e non invecchia più.

jp: 今まではあくまで歪められたオルフェの意志がベースとなっていたが、本来の肉体に近づいたことで混沌の意志と力が極限にまで強まった。ねじ伏せた黒の剣を手に、目的を果たそうと暗躍する。
jp_grezzo: "今まではあくまで歪められたオルフェの意志がベースとなっていたが、本来の肉体に近づいたことで混沌の意志と力が極限にまで強まった。ねじ伏せた黒の剣を手に、目的を果たそうと暗躍する。"
en: Up until now it was based on Orphe's distorted will but as he approached his original body his will and power of chaos was strengthened to the extreme. With a twisted black sword in his hand he strives to achieve his goal.
en_grezzo: "Up until now it was based on Orphe's distorted will but as he approached his original body his will and power of chaos was strengthened to the extreme. With a twisted black sword in his hand he strives to achieve his goal."
it: Finora la base era stata la volontà di Orphe, per quanto piegata; ma via via che si avvicinava al corpo di un tempo, la volontà e la forza del caos si sono rafforzate all'estremo. Con in pugno la spada nera che ha domato, trama nell'ombra per arrivare al suo scopo.

jp: ソピアーの兄姉たちの集合体。深淵より流出したアイオンという神族。超永遠世界から、イルヴァおよびガイアス・ヴィスに移住してきた。超永遠世界の理を使って時間のありように干渉し、止まった時の中でも行動可能。そのため時間神としても扱われる。
jp_grezzo: "ソピアーの兄姉たちの集合体。深淵より流出したアイオンという神族。超永遠世界から、イルヴァおよびガイアス・ヴィスに移住してきた。超永遠世界の理を使って時間のありように干渉し、止まった時の中でも行動可能。そのため時間神としても扱われる。"
en: A collection of Sophia's brothers and sisters. Aion a race of gods who have flowed out of the abyss. They migrated to Irva and Gaius Vis from the Trans-Eternal World. They can interfere with the existence of time using the logic of the Trans-Eternal World and can act even when it is stopped. Therefore they are also treated as time gods.
en_grezzo: "A collection of Sophia's brothers and sisters. Aion a race of gods who have flowed out of the abyss. They migrated to Irva and Gaius Vis from the Trans-Eternal World. They can interfere with the existence of time using the logic of the Trans-Eternal World and can act even when it is stopped. Therefore they are also treated as time gods."
it: L'insieme dei fratelli e delle sorelle maggiori di Sophia. Sono gli Aion, la stirpe divina defluita dall'abisso. Dal mondo oltre l'eterno sono emigrati a Irva e a Gaius Vis. Con le leggi di quel mondo interferiscono sul modo d'essere del tempo, e possono agire anche dentro il tempo fermo: per questo li si considera anche divinità del tempo.

jp: 強力な神々の中の帝王を自称する。戦争に負けることもたまにあったが、それでも雷を象徴する強力無比な英雄神として信仰されていた。大戦時にはゼウスやトール相手に激しい電撃合戦を繰り広げたという。
jp_grezzo: "強力な神々の中の帝王を自称する。戦争に負けることもたまにあったが、それでも雷を象徴する強力無比な英雄神として信仰されていた。大戦時にはゼウスやトール相手に激しい電撃合戦を繰り広げたという。"
en: He is a self-proclaimed emperor among the mighty gods. Although he occasionally lost wars he was still believed to be a powerful and matchless heroic god symbolizing lightning. During the Great War he fought a fierce blitzkrieg against Zeus and Thor.
en_grezzo: "He is a self-proclaimed emperor among the mighty gods. Although he occasionally lost wars he was still believed to be a powerful and matchless heroic god symbolizing lightning. During the Great War he fought a fierce blitzkrieg against Zeus and Thor."
it: Si proclama imperatore fra le divinità potenti. Qualche guerra l'ha anche persa, ma lo si venerava lo stesso come dio eroico e senza pari, simbolo del fulmine. Nella grande guerra, si dice, ingaggiò furiose battaglie di scariche elettriche contro Zeus e Thor.

jp: インドラの兄弟神。かつてはインドラに並ぶ実力を持っていた。全身から高熱を発しているせいで、生まれた時にも母親に放り投げられたという。 綺麗な金髪が自慢らしい。
jp_grezzo: "インドラの兄弟神。かつてはインドラに並ぶ実力を持っていた。全身から高熱を発しているせいで、生まれた時にも母親に放り投げられたという。 綺麗な金髪が自慢らしい。"
en: Indra's brother god. In the past he was as powerful as Indra. It is said that he was abandoned by his mother at birth due to an intense heat emanating from his entire body. Apparently he boasts of his beautiful blonde hair.
en_grezzo: "Indra's brother god. In the past he was as powerful as Indra. It is said that he was abandoned by his mother at birth due to an intense heat emanating from his entire body. Apparently he boasts of his beautiful blonde hair."
it: Il dio fratello di Indra. Un tempo aveva una forza pari alla sua. Siccome emana calore intenso da tutto il corpo, si racconta che perfino sua madre, appena nato, lo scagliò via. Pare che vada fiero dei suoi bei capelli biondi.

jp: 素早さを誇る風神。かつてはインドラに並ぶ神だったが、ルルウィに力を奪われた上に八つ裂きにされてしまい、その欠片は魔物となってしまった。
jp_grezzo: "素早さを誇る風神。かつてはインドラに並ぶ神だったが、ルルウィに力を奪われた上に八つ裂きにされてしまい、その欠片は魔物となってしまった。"
en: A wind god who boasts of his quickness. He was once a god on par with Indra but when Lulwy stripped him of his power and tore him to pieces the pieces became demons.
en_grezzo: "A wind god who boasts of his quickness. He was once a god on par with Indra but when Lulwy stripped him of his power and tore him to pieces the pieces became demons."
it: Il dio del vento, fiero della propria rapidità. Un tempo stava alla pari con Indra, ma Lulwy gli tolse la forza e per giunta lo fece a pezzi, e quei pezzi sono diventati mostri.

jp: 自分の頭を切り落として焼く荒行を重ね、神仏に負けない特性を得た。神々の大戦前は、特性をフル活用してヴィシュヌやインドラ相手に戦争を仕掛け、なかなかいい勝負をしていた。大戦時に神仏ではない悪魔に敗れ、魔物と化した。
jp_grezzo: "自分の頭を切り落として焼く荒行を重ね、神仏に負けない特性を得た。神々の大戦前は、特性をフル活用してヴィシュヌやインドラ相手に戦争を仕掛け、なかなかいい勝負をしていた。大戦時に神仏ではない悪魔に敗れ、魔物と化した。"
en: He cut off his own head and burned it which gave him a trait that rivals that of the gods. Before the Great War of the Gods he made full use of his characteristics to wage war against Vishnu and Indra and he fought reasonably well. During the Great War he was defeated by a demon that was neither a god nor a spirit and turned into a demon.
en_grezzo: "He cut off his own head and burned it which gave him a trait that rivals that of the gods. Before the Great War of the Gods he made full use of his characteristics to wage war against Vishnu and Indra and he fought reasonably well. During the Great War he was defeated by a demon that was neither a god nor a spirit and turned into a demon."
it: A furia di ripetere l'ascesi feroce di tagliarsi la testa e bruciarla, ottenne una qualità che non cede né a divinità né a spiriti. Prima della grande guerra delle divinità la sfruttò a fondo per muovere guerra a Vishnu e a Indra, e se la cavò piuttosto bene. Nella grande guerra fu sconfitto da un demone che non era né divinità né spirito, e si trasformò in mostro.

jp: 破壊神シヴァの息子。里子に出されていたが、再会時にシヴァの妻に知らずに求婚してしまい戦争になった。神々の大戦時には和解して共に戦ったが、途中でお父さんが犬になってしまうという予想外の事態に動転し、その隙を突かれ敗北した。
jp_grezzo: "破壊神シヴァの息子。里子に出されていたが、再会時にシヴァの妻に知らずに求婚してしまい戦争になった。神々の大戦時には和解して共に戦ったが、途中でお父さんが犬になってしまうという予想外の事態に動転し、その隙を突かれ敗北した。"
en: Son of the god of destruction Siva. He was sent to foster care but when they were reunited he unknowingly courted Siva's wife which led to war. They reconciled and fought together during the Great War of the Gods but he was caught off guard and defeated when his father turned into a dog in the midst of it.
en_grezzo: "Son of the god of destruction Siva. He was sent to foster care but when they were reunited he unknowingly courted Siva's wife which led to war. They reconciled and fought together during the Great War of the Gods but he was caught off guard and defeated when his father turned into a dog in the midst of it."
it: Il figlio di Shiva, il dio della distruzione. Era stato dato a balia, e quando si ritrovarono chiese in sposa, senza saperlo, la moglie di Shiva: ne venne una guerra. Nella grande guerra delle divinità si riconciliarono e combatterono insieme, ma a metà scontro suo padre si trasformò in cane; sconvolto da quell'imprevisto, si scoprì e fu battuto.

jp: 深海に眠る神が産んでいるという眷属。無数に産み落とされているが、小さく弱いため魚の餌や漁師のおつまみになりがち。奇跡的に生き残って成長した個体は、高い知性と魔力を持つ存在になるという。
jp_grezzo: "深海に眠る神が産んでいるという眷属。無数に産み落とされているが、小さく弱いため魚の餌や漁師のおつまみになりがち。奇跡的に生き残って成長した個体は、高い知性と魔力を持つ存在になるという。"
en: It is said to be born of a god who sleeps in the deep sea. They are produced in countless numbers but because they are small and weak they tend to be used as bait for fish and as a snack for fishermen. It is said that an individual that miraculously survives and grows up will become a being with high intelligence and magical powers.
en_grezzo: "It is said to be born of a god who sleeps in the deep sea. They are produced in countless numbers but because they are small and weak they tend to be used as bait for fish and as a snack for fishermen. It is said that an individual that miraculously survives and grows up will become a being with high intelligence and magical powers."
it: Una schiera che, si dice, genera il dio addormentato negli abissi marini. Ne nascono a migliaia, ma sono piccole e deboli, e finiscono spesso come esca per i pesci o stuzzichino per i pescatori. L'esemplare che per miracolo sopravvive e cresce diventa, dicono, un essere di grande intelligenza e grande potere magico.

jp: 神の欠片と放射性物質を取り込んで突然変異したきのこ。きのこたちから崇められる存在。その体は甘いお菓子のような感じで美味しいが、中毒性と幻覚性があるので危険。
jp_grezzo: "神の欠片と放射性物質を取り込んで突然変異したきのこ。きのこたちから崇められる存在。その体は甘いお菓子のような感じで美味しいが、中毒性と幻覚性があるので危険。"
en: A mushroom that has mutated by taking in a piece of a god and radioactive material. They are revered by the mushrooms. Its body feels and tastes like a sweet treat but it is dangerous because it is addictive and hallucinogenic.
en_grezzo: "A mushroom that has mutated by taking in a piece of a god and radioactive material. They are revered by the mushrooms. Its body feels and tastes like a sweet treat but it is dangerous because it is addictive and hallucinogenic."
it: Un fungo mutato per aver assorbito una scheggia di divinità e del materiale radioattivo. I funghi la venerano. Il suo corpo pare un dolce ed è buono da mangiare, ma dà assuefazione e allucinazioni: è pericoloso.

jp: 水分を蓄えて巨大化したお化けキノコ。怪光線や毒素を発射して暴れるほか、人を騙して菌糸を寄生させてくる。高熱が弱点。死体には毒も寄生能力もないので安心していい。
jp_grezzo: "水分を蓄えて巨大化したお化けキノコ。怪光線や毒素を発射して暴れるほか、人を騙して菌糸を寄生させてくる。高熱が弱点。死体には毒も寄生能力もないので安心していい。"
en: A haunted mushroom that has become a gigantic entity by storing water. In addition to emitting strange beams of light and toxins they also trick people into becoming infested with mycelium. High temperature is a weakness. You can rest assured that the corpse has no poisons or parasitic abilities.
en_grezzo: "A haunted mushroom that has become a gigantic entity by storing water. In addition to emitting strange beams of light and toxins they also trick people into becoming infested with mycelium. High temperature is a weakness. You can rest assured that the corpse has no poisons or parasitic abilities."
it: Un fungo mostruoso ingigantito a forza di accumulare acqua. Oltre a scatenarsi sparando raggi strani e tossine, inganna la gente e le fa attecchire addosso il micelio. Il punto debole è il calore forte. Sul cadavere non restano né veleno né capacità di parassitare, quindi si può stare tranquilli.

jp: 武装きのこ集団を率いるリーダータイプのきのこ。エネルギー兵器で武装しているがかなり貧弱。こいつに勝てないようでは、この先生きのこれないだろう。
jp_grezzo: "武装きのこ集団を率いるリーダータイプのきのこ。エネルギー兵器で武装しているがかなり貧弱。こいつに勝てないようでは、この先生きのこれないだろう。"
en: A leader-type mushroom that leads a group of armed mushrooms. They are armed with energy weapons but quite feeble. If we can't beat it we won't live long.
en_grezzo: "A leader-type mushroom that leads a group of armed mushrooms. They are armed with energy weapons but quite feeble. If we can't beat it we won't live long."
it: Un fungo del tipo comandante, che guida un drappello di funghi armati. È armato di armi a energia, ma è piuttosto gracile. Chi non riesce a batterlo, da qui in avanti, ha poco da fungere.

jp: 水分の多い場所を特に好むきのこ。水しぶきを噴射したり霧で撹乱したりして外敵から身を守る。群生している場合は特に危険なので注意。そのままだと水っぽくてあまり美味しくない。
jp_grezzo: "水分の多い場所を特に好むきのこ。水しぶきを噴射したり霧で撹乱したりして外敵から身を守る。群生している場合は特に危険なので注意。そのままだと水っぽくてあまり美味しくない。"
en: This mushroom is particularly fond of places with high moisture content. They protect themselves from external enemies by spraying water or disorient them with fog. It is especially dangerous if it is growing in clusters. As it is it's watery and not very tasty.
en_grezzo: "This mushroom is particularly fond of places with high moisture content. They protect themselves from external enemies by spraying water or disorient them with fog. It is especially dangerous if it is growing in clusters. As it is it's watery and not very tasty."
it: Un fungo che predilige i posti pieni d'acqua. Si difende dai nemici spruzzando getti d'acqua o confondendoli con la nebbia. Quando cresce in colonie è particolarmente pericoloso: attenzione. Così com'è sa d'acqua e non è granché buono.

jp: 様々なきのこの集合体。その正体はきのこの菌糸に操られた、別の生物の死体である。栄養を求め、鋭い牙で生きとし生けるものに食らいつくケダモノ。
jp_grezzo: "様々なきのこの集合体。その正体はきのこの菌糸に操られた、別の生物の死体である。栄養を求め、鋭い牙で生きとし生けるものに食らいつくケダモノ。"
en: A collection of various mushrooms. It is the corpse of another creature controlled by mushroom mycelium. A beast that seeks nourishment and devours all living things with its sharp fangs.
en_grezzo: "A collection of various mushrooms. It is the corpse of another creature controlled by mushroom mycelium. A beast that seeks nourishment and devours all living things with its sharp fangs."
it: Un insieme di funghi di ogni sorta. In verità è il cadavere di un'altra creatura, manovrato dal micelio dei funghi. Una belva che cerca nutrimento e azzanna con le zanne aguzze tutto ciò che vive.

jp: 小さな胞子をマシンガンのごとく連射する能力を持つ。原始的なきのことは違い、足が発達しているため移動も得意。これらの特性は、たけのことと戦うために獲得したものだと考えられている。
jp_grezzo: "小さな胞子をマシンガンのごとく連射する能力を持つ。原始的なきのことは違い、足が発達しているため移動も得意。これらの特性は、たけのことと戦うために獲得したものだと考えられている。"
en: It has the ability to fire a series of small spores like a machine gun. Unlike primitive mushrooms they have well-developed legs and are good at moving around. It is believed that these traits were acquired to fight against the bamboo.
en_grezzo: "It has the ability to fire a series of small spores like a machine gun. Unlike primitive mushrooms they have well-developed legs and are good at moving around. It is believed that these traits were acquired to fight against the bamboo."
it: Ha la capacità di sparare a raffica spore minute, come una mitragliatrice. A differenza dei funghi primitivi ha le zampe ben sviluppate ed è bravo anche a spostarsi. Si ritiene che queste qualità le abbia acquisite per combattere i germogli di bambù.

jp: 谷の奥地に雑貨店を構える商人。休息を求める旅人や冒険家には割と人気らしい。店を持つまで苦労したこともあって店への愛着が強く、自分の命よりも大事にしている。
jp_grezzo: "谷の奥地に雑貨店を構える商人。休息を求める旅人や冒険家には割と人気らしい。店を持つまで苦労したこともあって店への愛着が強く、自分の命よりも大事にしている。"
en: A merchant who owns a general store in the depths of the valley. It is said to be rather popular among travelers and adventurers who are looking for respite. He struggled to get his own store so he has a strong attachment to it and values it more than his own life.
en_grezzo: "A merchant who owns a general store in the depths of the valley. It is said to be rather popular among travelers and adventurers who are looking for respite. He struggled to get his own store so he has a strong attachment to it and values it more than his own life."
it: Un mercante che tiene una merceria in fondo alla valle. Pare che fra i viandanti e gli avventurieri in cerca di riposo abbia un discreto successo. Ha faticato parecchio prima di avere un negozio suo, e per questo ci è affezionatissimo: lo tiene più caro della propria vita.

jp: 銀色の流体金属で構成された殺人兵器。本人はオシャレなチョイ悪くらいのつもりなのだが、そのエグい見た目と所業のせいで、陛下と呼ばれ恐れられている。歯を打ち鳴らしてケタケタ笑うのが癖。
jp_grezzo: "銀色の流体金属で構成された殺人兵器。本人はオシャレなチョイ悪くらいのつもりなのだが、そのエグい見た目と所業のせいで、陛下と呼ばれ恐れられている。歯を打ち鳴らしてケタケタ笑うのが癖。"
en: A killing weapon made up of silvery fluid metal. Although he thinks he's a stylish little badass he's called Majesty due to his ugly appearance and actions. He has a habit of grumbling and grinning.
en_grezzo: "A killing weapon made up of silvery fluid metal. Although he thinks he's a stylish little badass he's called Majesty due to his ugly appearance and actions. He has a habit of grumbling and grinning."
it: Un'arma da assassinio fatta di metallo fluido color argento. Lei si crede appena un po' elegante e un po' cattiva, ma per l'aspetto raccapricciante e per quello che combina la chiamano maestà e ne hanno paura. Ha il vizio di battere i denti e sghignazzare.

jp: 長い年月を生き抜いた古いベル。大量の金属を取り込んだ結果かなり大きくなった。身体が重いのであまり動こうとしない。若い者を毛嫌いしており、溶解液を噴きつけて腐食させようとする老害。
jp_grezzo: "長い年月を生き抜いた古いベル。大量の金属を取り込んだ結果かなり大きくなった。身体が重いのであまり動こうとしない。若い者を毛嫌いしており、溶解液を噴きつけて腐食させようとする老害。"
en: An old bell that has survived many years. It's gotten quite large as a result of taking in a lot of metal. Its body is so heavy that it doesn't try to move much. The old thing hates the new and tries to corrode them by spraying them with a dissolving fluid.
en_grezzo: "An old bell that has survived many years. It's gotten quite large as a result of taking in a lot of metal. Its body is so heavy that it doesn't try to move much. The old thing hates the new and tries to corrode them by spraying them with a dissolving fluid."
it: Una vecchia campana che ha attraversato lunghissimi anni. A forza di inglobare metallo è diventata piuttosto grande. Ha il corpo pesante e non prova nemmeno a muoversi. Detesta i giovani e cerca di corroderli spruzzandoli di liquido solvente: una rovina di vecchia.

jp: 伝説素材で作られた小型人形。自我を持ち、想像力を具現化して飛行も可能。武装を纏って戦い、創造した主君に勝利をもたらすことを使命とする。主君と死別した個体は野良になり、契約して気を供給してくれる新たな主君を探す。
jp_grezzo: "伝説素材で作られた小型人形。自我を持ち、想像力を具現化して飛行も可能。武装を纏って戦い、創造した主君に勝利をもたらすことを使命とする。主君と死別した個体は野良になり、契約して気を供給してくれる新たな主君を探す。"
en: A small doll made of legendary materials. It has an ego embodies the imagination and is capable of flight. It is their mission to fight in arms and bring victory to their creator lord. After the death of the master the individual becomes a stray and contracts to find a new master who will supply them with energy.
en_grezzo: "A small doll made of legendary materials. It has an ego embodies the imagination and is capable of flight. It is their mission to fight in arms and bring victory to their creator lord. After the death of the master the individual becomes a stray and contracts to find a new master who will supply them with energy."
it: Un pupazzo di piccola taglia fatto di materiali leggendari. Ha un io suo, dà corpo all'immaginazione e sa anche volare. Combatte rivestita di armi, e la sua missione è portare la vittoria al signore che l'ha creata. L'esemplare che perde il proprio signore diventa randagio e cerca un signore nuovo con cui stringere un patto e da cui ricevere energia.

jp: 人型の携帯端末。自律金属細胞と共生し、再生・増殖・進化するようになった。製造会社のシェア拡大のため本能的に戦い続けているが、会社はとっくの昔に文明とともに滅んでいる。進化の過程で空中戦に適応し、翼状の大型飛行ユニットを装備した。
jp_grezzo: "人型の携帯端末。自律金属細胞と共生し、再生・増殖・進化するようになった。製造会社のシェア拡大のため本能的に戦い続けているが、会社はとっくの昔に文明とともに滅んでいる。進化の過程で空中戦に適応し、翼状の大型飛行ユニットを装備した。"
en: A human-shaped mobile terminal. It began to renew multiply and evolve in a symbiotic manner with autonomous metal cells. The manufacturing company instinctively fought to increase its market share but the company has long since perished with its civilization. In the course of its evolution it adapted to aerial combat and armed itself with a large wing-like flying unit.
en_grezzo: "A human-shaped mobile terminal. It began to renew multiply and evolve in a symbiotic manner with autonomous metal cells. The manufacturing company instinctively fought to increase its market share but the company has long since perished with its civilization. In the course of its evolution it adapted to aerial combat and armed itself with a large wing-like flying unit."
it: Un terminale portatile dalla forma umana. In simbiosi con cellule metalliche autonome, ha imparato a rigenerarsi, a moltiplicarsi e a evolversi. Continua a combattere d'istinto per allargare la quota di mercato della ditta che l'ha prodotto, ma quella ditta è finita da un pezzo insieme alla sua civiltà. Evolvendosi si è adattato al combattimento aereo e si è dotato di una grande unità di volo a forma d'ala.

jp: デスクトップバーディ
人型の携帯端末。自律金属細胞と共生し、再生・増殖・進化するようになった。製造会社のシェア拡大のため本能的に戦い続けているが、会社はとっくの昔に文明とともに滅んでいる。進化の過程で水中戦に適応し、魚状の水中機動ユニットを装備した。
jp_grezzo: "人型の携帯端末。自律金属細胞と共生し、再生・増殖・進化するようになった。製造会社のシェア拡大のため本能的に戦い続けているが、会社はとっくの昔に文明とともに滅んでいる。進化の過程で水中戦に適応し、魚状の水中機動ユニットを装備した。"
en: A human-shaped mobile terminal. It began to renew multiply and evolve in a symbiotic manner with autonomous metal cells. The manufacturing company instinctively fought to increase its market share but the company has long ago perished with its civilization. In the course of its evolution it adapted to underwater warfare and was equipped with a fish-like underwater mobility unit.
en_grezzo: "A human-shaped mobile terminal. It began to renew multiply and evolve in a symbiotic manner with autonomous metal cells. The manufacturing company instinctively fought to increase its market share but the company has long ago perished with its civilization. In the course of its evolution it adapted to underwater warfare and was equipped with a fish-like underwater mobility unit."
it: Un terminale portatile dalla forma umana. In simbiosi con cellule metalliche autonome, ha imparato a rigenerarsi, a moltiplicarsi e a evolversi. Continua a combattere d'istinto per allargare la quota di mercato della ditta che l'ha prodotto, ma quella ditta è finita da un pezzo insieme alla sua civiltà. Evolvendosi si è adattato al combattimento subacqueo e si è dotato di un'unità di manovra subacquea a forma di pesce.

jp: デスクトップネービー
誰も知らないくらい昔から、白い猫と一緒に洞窟に住んでいる。話しかけても意味深なことしか言わないので詳細不明。多くの者は気味の悪い痴呆老人だと思っているが、仙人説も根強い。
jp_grezzo: "誰も知らないくらい昔から、白い猫と一緒に洞窟に住んでいる。話しかけても意味深なことしか言わないので詳細不明。多くの者は気味の悪い痴呆老人だと思っているが、仙人説も根強い。"
en: For as long as anyone knows he has lived in a cave with a white cat. When talking to him he only speaks gibberish so the details are unknown. Many people think he's a creepy old man with dementia but the theory that he's a sage persists.
en_grezzo: "For as long as anyone knows he has lived in a cave with a white cat. When talking to him he only speaks gibberish so the details are unknown. Many people think he's a creepy old man with dementia but the theory that he's a sage persists."
it: Da un tempo così lontano che nessuno lo ricorda vive in una grotta insieme a un gatto bianco. A chi gli rivolge la parola risponde solo con frasi enigmatiche, e di lui non si sa altro. I più lo credono un vecchio rimbambito e inquietante, ma l'idea che sia un eremita sapiente è dura a morire.

jp: 忘却の女神の化身が成長した姿。膨大な量の記憶を喰らった個体が、健常な人間に憑りつくことでこの形態になる。廃忘獣を召喚する能力を持つため危険。
jp_grezzo: "忘却の女神の化身が成長した姿。膨大な量の記憶を喰らった個体が、健常な人間に憑りつくことでこの形態になる。廃忘獣を召喚する能力を持つため危険。"
en: An incarnation of the Goddess of Oblivion as a mature self. An individual that has eaten a huge amount of memories becomes this form by possessing a healthy human being. It is dangerous because of its ability to summon the Ruined Oblivion.
en_grezzo: "An incarnation of the Goddess of Oblivion as a mature self. An individual that has eaten a huge amount of memories becomes this form by possessing a healthy human being. It is dangerous because of its ability to summon the Ruined Oblivion."
it: La forma adulta dell'incarnazione della dea dell'oblio. Un esemplare che ha divorato una quantità enorme di ricordi assume questa forma impossessandosi di un essere umano sano. È pericolosa perché sa evocare le bestie dell'oblio.

jp: 神秘的なものが大好きな女性。子供の頃に妖精を目撃したのがきっかけらしい。以前はよく休暇をとってラスキリスを訪れていた。
jp_grezzo: "神秘的なものが大好きな女性。子供の頃に妖精を目撃したのがきっかけらしい。以前はよく休暇をとってラスキリスを訪れていた。"
en: A woman who loves mystical things. Apparently she witnessed a fairy when she was a child. In the past she often vacationed and visited Raskilis.
en_grezzo: "A woman who loves mystical things. Apparently she witnessed a fairy when she was a child. In the past she often vacationed and visited Raskilis."
it: Una donna che ama tutto ciò che è misterioso. Pare che sia cominciato da quando, bambina, vide una fata. Un tempo prendeva spesso le ferie per andare a Raskilis.

jp: 花を愛する少女。ラスキリスにある雑貨店で焼き立てのパンを食べてから花摘みにいそしむのが彼女の日課だった。花には結構詳しいようで、薬効や毒性まで把握している。
jp_grezzo: "花を愛する少女。ラスキリスにある雑貨店で焼き立てのパンを食べてから花摘みにいそしむのが彼女の日課だった。花には結構詳しいようで、薬効や毒性まで把握している。"
en: A girl who loves flowers. It was her daily routine to eat freshly baked bread from a general store in Raskilis and then go flower picking. She seems to be quite familiar with flowers and even knows their medicinal and poisonous properties.
en_grezzo: "A girl who loves flowers. It was her daily routine to eat freshly baked bread from a general store in Raskilis and then go flower picking. She seems to be quite familiar with flowers and even knows their medicinal and poisonous properties."
it: Una ragazza che ama i fiori. Mangiare il pane appena sfornato della merceria di Raskilis e poi darsi alla raccolta dei fiori era la sua giornata di sempre. Di fiori se ne intende parecchio: conosce anche le proprietà curative e quelle velenose.

jp: これまで様々な冒険を繰り広げて来た。好奇心に駆られて突っ走るので、痛い目にあうことも多い。しかし何度失敗しても冒険への意欲を全く失わない。一応、相棒のマンソンの忠告は素直に聞く。
jp_grezzo: "これまで様々な冒険を繰り広げて来た。好奇心に駆られて突っ走るので、痛い目にあうことも多い。しかし何度失敗しても冒険への意欲を全く失わない。一応、相棒のマンソンの忠告は素直に聞く。"
en: He has had a lot of adventures so far. He is often hurt because he is driven by curiosity and rushes through. But no matter how many times he fails he never loses his appetite for adventure. For the record he takes the advice of his partner Manson very seriously.
en_grezzo: "He has had a lot of adventures so far. He is often hurt because he is driven by curiosity and rushes through. But no matter how many times he fails he never loses his appetite for adventure. For the record he takes the advice of his partner Manson very seriously."
it: Ne ha vissute di avventure, fino a oggi. Si lancia in avanti spinto dalla curiosità, e spesso ci rimette. Ma per quante volte fallisca non perde un briciolo di voglia di avventura. In compenso i consigli di Manson, il suo compagno, li ascolta di buon grado.

jp: まめな性格で、装備や食料などの準備・管理が得意。相棒のクレイが冒険にのめりこむ姿を心配しながらも、そのまっすぐな所を羨ましく思っている。
jp_grezzo: "まめな性格で、装備や食料などの準備・管理が得意。相棒のクレイが冒険にのめりこむ姿を心配しながらも、そのまっすぐな所を羨ましく思っている。"
en: He is a meticulous person and is good at preparing and managing equipment and food. He worries about his partner Cray as he plunges into adventure but he also envies Cray for his straightforwardness.
