en_grezzo: "He is a meticulous person and is good at preparing and managing equipment and food. He worries about his partner Cray as he plunges into adventure but he also envies Cray for his straightforwardness."
it: Ha un carattere meticoloso ed è bravo a preparare e a tenere in ordine l'equipaggiamento e le provviste. Si preoccupa vedendo il compagno Cray buttarsi a capofitto nelle avventure, e insieme gli invidia quella schiettezza.

jp: 周到な冒険家『マンソン』
オークの最上位種。妖術士の目論見を超えて独自発展した。若干好戦的ではあるが、強く賢く優しい。妖術士の邪悪な命令を断固拒否し、独立して生活している。
jp_grezzo: "オークの最上位種。妖術士の目論見を超えて独自発展した。若干好戦的ではあるが、強く賢く優しい。妖術士の邪悪な命令を断固拒否し、独立して生活している。"
en: The uppermost species of orc. It developed on its own beyond the vision of the sorcerers. They are strong smart and gentle although they are a bit belligerent. They adamantly refuse the evil orders of sorcerers and live independently.
en_grezzo: "The uppermost species of orc. It developed on its own beyond the vision of the sorcerers. They are strong smart and gentle although they are a bit belligerent. They adamantly refuse the evil orders of sorcerers and live independently."
it: La specie più alta degli orchi. Si è sviluppata per conto suo, andando oltre i calcoli degli stregoni. È un po' bellicosa, ma è forte, saggia e gentile. Rifiuta con fermezza gli ordini malvagi degli stregoni e vive per conto proprio.

jp: オークの強化改良種。妖術によって人間と合成することで誕生した。高い知性と強靭な肉体を併せ持つ。大規模な集落を作って社会的に生活している。
jp_grezzo: "オークの強化改良種。妖術によって人間と合成することで誕生した。高い知性と強靭な肉体を併せ持つ。大規模な集落を作って社会的に生活している。"
en: An enhanced and improved species of orc. It was created by merging with humans through sorcery. They possess both high intelligence and a strong body. They make large settlements and live socially.
en_grezzo: "An enhanced and improved species of orc. It was created by merging with humans through sorcery. They possess both high intelligence and a strong body. They make large settlements and live socially."
it: Una specie di orco potenziata e migliorata. È nata dalla fusione con gli uomini per via di stregoneria. Unisce grande intelligenza e corpo tenace. Costruisce insediamenti vasti e vive in società.

jp: 特殊な血統のポーク。幼い頃からさつまいもを食って育った。活動的で、引き締まった質の良い筋肉を持つ。肉はすっきりとした旨みが特徴。
jp_grezzo: "特殊な血統のポーク。幼い頃からさつまいもを食って育った。活動的で、引き締まった質の良い筋肉を持つ。肉はすっきりとした旨みが特徴。"
en: Porc with a special pedigree. From an early age it grew up eating sweet potatoes. Active toned and with good quality muscles. The meat is characterized by a crisp and tasty taste.
en_grezzo: "Porc with a special pedigree. From an early age it grew up eating sweet potatoes. Active toned and with good quality muscles. The meat is characterized by a crisp and tasty taste."
it: Un porc di stirpe particolare. Fin da piccolo è cresciuto mangiando patate dolci. È attivo, e ha muscoli asciutti e di buona qualità. La carne si distingue per un sapore netto e pulito.

jp: 妖術士によって作られたオークの強化改良種。大きく強靭な肉体を持つ。頭はあまり良くないので、まだまだ改良が必要とされている。
jp_grezzo: "妖術士によって作られたオークの強化改良種。大きく強靭な肉体を持つ。頭はあまり良くないので、まだまだ改良が必要とされている。"
en: An enhanced and improved species of orc created by sorcerers. He has a large strong body. His mind is not very bright so he still needs to improve.
en_grezzo: "An enhanced and improved species of orc created by sorcerers. He has a large strong body. His mind is not very bright so he still needs to improve."
it: Una specie di orco potenziata e migliorata, creata dagli stregoni. Ha un corpo grande e tenace. Di testa non è granché, e c'è ancora parecchio da migliorare.

jp: 魂が完全に堕落したオーク。肌が浅黒く目つきも凶悪。見るからに邪悪なため、普通のオークたちからも敬遠されている。
jp_grezzo: "魂が完全に堕落したオーク。肌が浅黒く目つきも凶悪。見るからに邪悪なため、普通のオークたちからも敬遠されている。"
en: An orc with a completely corrupted soul. His skin is dark and his eyes are vicious. He is shunned even by ordinary orcs because of his apparent evil.
en_grezzo: "An orc with a completely corrupted soul. His skin is dark and his eyes are vicious. He is shunned even by ordinary orcs because of his apparent evil."
it: Un orco dall'anima completamente corrotta. Ha la pelle scura e lo sguardo feroce. Si vede a occhio che è malvagio, e per questo perfino gli orchi comuni lo tengono a distanza.

jp: その辺で適当に育ったポークと違い、整えられた環境で育ったエリート。普通のポークのことを見下している。肉は明らかに高級っぽい味がする。
jp_grezzo: "その辺で適当に育ったポークと違い、整えられた環境で育ったエリート。普通のポークのことを見下している。肉は明らかに高級っぽい味がする。"
en: Unlike the porc that grew up in the wild these elites grew up in a well-groomed environment. They look down on the average porc. The meat clearly tasted fancy.
en_grezzo: "Unlike the porc that grew up in the wild these elites grew up in a well-groomed environment. They look down on the average porc. The meat clearly tasted fancy."
it: A differenza dei porc cresciuti alla buona da qualche parte, questo è un esemplare scelto, allevato in un ambiente curato. Guarda dall'alto in basso i porc comuni. La carne ha chiaramente un sapore da prodotto di pregio.

jp: オークとイノシシの間に生まれた。性欲が強く、いつも裸。さらに発情するとオークを襲う習性がある。このためオークからケダモノ扱いされているらしい。肉はさっぱりしていて美味しい。
jp_grezzo: "オークとイノシシの間に生まれた。性欲が強く、いつも裸。さらに発情するとオークを襲う習性がある。このためオークからケダモノ扱いされているらしい。肉はさっぱりしていて美味しい。"
en: They were born to an orc and a boar. They have a strong libido and are always naked. In addition when in heat they have a habit of attacking orcs. For this reason it is said to be treated as a beast by orcs. The meat is refreshing and delicious.
en_grezzo: "They were born to an orc and a boar. They have a strong libido and are always naked. In addition when in heat they have a habit of attacking orcs. For this reason it is said to be treated as a beast by orcs. The meat is refreshing and delicious."
it: È nato da un orco e un cinghiale. Ha un forte appetito sessuale ed è sempre nudo. Per giunta, quando va in calore, ha l'abitudine di assalire gli orchi. Per questo, pare, gli orchi lo trattano da bestia. La carne è leggera e buona.

jp: 釣りだけが人生の楽しみだと語る男。その背中はどこか哀愁を感じさせるが、彼の詳しい過去を知る者はいない。世界が終わるその日まで、釣りをして過ごすのだろう。
jp_grezzo: "釣りだけが人生の楽しみだと語る男。その背中はどこか哀愁を感じさせるが、彼の詳しい過去を知る者はいない。世界が終わるその日まで、釣りをして過ごすのだろう。"
en: The man says that fishing is the only thing he enjoys about life. His past is not known in detail though his background is somehow melancholy. He''ll spend the rest of his days fishing until the day the world ends.
en_grezzo: "The man says that fishing is the only thing he enjoys about life. His past is not known in detail though his background is somehow melancholy. He''ll spend the rest of his days fishing until the day the world ends."
it: Un uomo che dice che la pesca è l'unico piacere della sua vita. La sua schiena ha un che di malinconico, ma nessuno conosce il suo passato nei dettagli. Passerà a pescare anche l'ultimo giorno del mondo.

jp: エーテルウィンドの被害で故郷にいられなくなり、あちこちを転々とした後ザイールに移住した女性。しかしザイールも街として機能しなくなったため、見切りをつけて今度はキャンプ地に移住してきた。
jp_grezzo: "エーテルウィンドの被害で故郷にいられなくなり、あちこちを転々とした後ザイールに移住した女性。しかしザイールも街として機能しなくなったため、見切りをつけて今度はキャンプ地に移住してきた。"
en: A woman who was unable to stay in her hometown due to the devastation of Etherwind and moved to Zaile after drifting from place to place. But when Zaile also ceased to be functional as a city she gave up on it and now moved to a campground.
en_grezzo: "A woman who was unable to stay in her hometown due to the devastation of Etherwind and moved to Zaile after drifting from place to place. But when Zaile also ceased to be functional as a city she gave up on it and now moved to a campground."
it: Il vento d'etere le ha fatto tanti di quei danni che al paese natale non poteva più restare; dopo aver girovagato di qua e di là si è trasferita a Zaile. Ma anche Zaile ha smesso di funzionare come città, e allora ha tagliato corto e si è spostata all'accampamento.

jp: 強靭な足腰が自慢のベテラン冒険者。「蹴り」と「連続攻撃」の組み合わせを得意とする。昔はパルミア周辺で活躍していたが、色々あって田舎暮らしで十分だと考えるようになった。
jp_grezzo: "強靭な足腰が自慢のベテラン冒険者。「蹴り」と「連続攻撃」の組み合わせを得意とする。昔はパルミア周辺で活躍していたが、色々あって田舎暮らしで十分だと考えるようになった。"
en: He is a veteran adventurer who boasts a strong constitution. He specializes in a combination of kicking and continuous attack. He used to be active around Palmia but after a lot of toubles he's come to think that country living is enough for him.
en_grezzo: "He is a veteran adventurer who boasts a strong constitution. He specializes in a combination of kicking and continuous attack. He used to be active around Palmia but after a lot of toubles he's come to think that country living is enough for him."
it: Un avventuriero navigato, fiero delle sue gambe tenaci. È bravo a combinare Calcio e Attacchi continui. Un tempo era attivo dalle parti di Palmia, ma dopo un po' di vicende ha concluso che la vita in campagna gli basta.

jp: 射撃能力をさらに高めたコボルトセイバー。剣のようなツノがさらに発達しているが、それ以上に尻尾が長くなっているのが特徴。長くなりすぎてバランスを崩すこともある辺り、まだ発展途上なのかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "射撃能力をさらに高めたコボルトセイバー。剣のようなツノがさらに発達しているが、それ以上に尻尾が長くなっているのが特徴。長くなりすぎてバランスを崩すこともある辺り、まだ発展途上なのかもしれない。"
en: Kobold Saber with even more shooting power. Its sword-like spine is further developed yet it is characterized by an even longer tail. It may be that it's still in its infancy but it's too long and can be out of balance.
en_grezzo: "Kobold Saber with even more shooting power. Its sword-like spine is further developed yet it is characterized by an even longer tail. It may be that it's still in its infancy but it's too long and can be out of balance."
it: Un coboldo sciabolatore con la capacità di tiro ancora più sviluppata. Il corno a forma di spada è cresciuto ancora, ma quel che si nota di più è la coda diventata lunghissima. E siccome a volte è tanto lunga da fargli perdere l'equilibrio, forse è ancora una specie in mezzo al guado.

jp: 力を求めるあまり邪気に身を委ねたコボルト。黒い鎧と立派なツノを持つ。普通に強いが高速移動、洗脳音波なども使いこなす。
jp_grezzo: "力を求めるあまり邪気に身を委ねたコボルト。黒い鎧と立派なツノを持つ。普通に強いが高速移動、洗脳音波なども使いこなす。"
en: In the pursuit of power kobold surrenders to evil. It has black armor and a respectable horn. They're usually powerful yet they can still move fast and use brainwashing sound waves.
en_grezzo: "In the pursuit of power kobold surrenders to evil. It has black armor and a respectable horn. They're usually powerful yet they can still move fast and use brainwashing sound waves."
it: Un coboldo che, a furia di cercare la forza, si è consegnato al male. Ha un'armatura nera e un corno maestoso. È forte già di suo, ma sa anche muoversi velocissimo e usare onde sonore che lavano il cervello.

jp: 稲妻を浴びてパワーアップした凄いコボルト。身体能力が飛躍的に上がっており、普通のコボルトからは稲妻の化身として恐れられている。
jp_grezzo: "稲妻を浴びてパワーアップした凄いコボルト。身体能力が飛躍的に上がっており、普通のコボルトからは稲妻の化身として恐れられている。"
en: The awesome kobold is powered up with lightning bolts. His physical abilities have increased dramatically and he is feared by ordinary kobolds as the incarnation of lightning.
en_grezzo: "The awesome kobold is powered up with lightning bolts. His physical abilities have increased dramatically and he is feared by ordinary kobolds as the incarnation of lightning."
it: Uno straordinario coboldo potenziato da una scarica di fulmini. Le sue capacità fisiche sono cresciute di colpo, e i coboldi comuni lo temono come l'incarnazione del fulmine.

jp: ライトニングコボルト
剣のような大きいツノが目立つコボルト。ただしこのツノは武器ではなくセンサーとして使う。真に注目すべきところは、特殊な三本のツメ。銃を使うのに適した形状へ進化したらしい。
jp_grezzo: "剣のような大きいツノが目立つコボルト。ただしこのツノは武器ではなくセンサーとして使う。真に注目すべきところは、特殊な三本のツメ。銃を使うのに適した形状へ進化したらしい。"
en: Kobold Saber stands out with their large sword-like horn. However this horn is used as a sensor not a weapon. What is truly remarkable is the special three claws. Apparently it has evolved into a shape suitable for using a gun.
en_grezzo: "Kobold Saber stands out with their large sword-like horn. However this horn is used as a sensor not a weapon. What is truly remarkable is the special three claws. Apparently it has evolved into a shape suitable for using a gun."
it: Un coboldo che si nota per il grande corno a forma di spada. Quel corno, però, non è un'arma: lo usa come sensore. La cosa davvero degna di nota sono i tre artigli speciali, che pare si siano evoluti in una forma adatta a usare un'arma da fuoco.

jp: コボルトの中でも特に強い毒を持つ種類。真っ青な体は見てるぶんには綺麗。全身から毒素を噴出して狩りに利用する習性がある。
jp_grezzo: "コボルトの中でも特に強い毒を持つ種類。真っ青な体は見てるぶんには綺麗。全身から毒素を噴出して狩りに利用する習性がある。"
en: The most poisonous kind of kobolds. The blue body is beautiful enough to see. It has a habit of exuding toxins from its body to be used for hunting.
en_grezzo: "The most poisonous kind of kobolds. The blue body is beautiful enough to see. It has a habit of exuding toxins from its body to be used for hunting."
it: La specie di coboldo con il veleno più forte di tutte. Il corpo azzurro intenso, a guardarlo, è bello. Ha l'abitudine di far uscire tossine da tutto il corpo e di servirsene per cacciare.

jp: コボルトの変種。人間の遺伝子が一部入っているせいか、特有のいかつさがない。コボルト族からは気持ち悪がられ、人間からは人狼と間違えられて駆除される。周りを敵だらけと思い込み常に怯えている。
jp_grezzo: "コボルトの変種。人間の遺伝子が一部入っているせいか、特有のいかつさがない。コボルト族からは気持ち悪がられ、人間からは人狼と間違えられて駆除される。周りを敵だらけと思い込み常に怯えている。"
en: A variant of kobold. Maybe it's because it has some human genes in it but it doesn't have a peculiar ugliness. The kobolds hate it and the humans mistake it for a werewolf and exterminate it. They are always frightened because they think they are surrounded by enemies.
en_grezzo: "A variant of kobold. Maybe it's because it has some human genes in it but it doesn't have a peculiar ugliness. The kobolds hate it and the humans mistake it for a werewolf and exterminate it. They are always frightened because they think they are surrounded by enemies."
it: Una variante del coboldo. Forse perché ha dentro qualche gene umano, le manca la durezza tipica della specie. I coboldi la trovano disgustosa; gli uomini la scambiano per una licantropa e la sterminano. Convinta di essere circondata da nemici, vive in un terrore continuo.

jp: エネルギーを求めて宇宙を彷徨っているバクテリア生命体。有機物でも無機物でも平気で食らって取り込もうとする。大軍でにじり寄ってくるので注意。
jp_grezzo: "エネルギーを求めて宇宙を彷徨っているバクテリア生命体。有機物でも無機物でも平気で食らって取り込もうとする。大軍でにじり寄ってくるので注意。"
en: Bacterial life forms are roaming the universe in search of energy. It will eat both organic and inorganic substances and try to take them in. Be careful as they approach you with a large army.
en_grezzo: "Bacterial life forms are roaming the universe in search of energy. It will eat both organic and inorganic substances and try to take them in. Be careful as they approach you with a large army."
it: Una forma di vita batterica che vaga per l'universo in cerca di energia. Divora e assorbe senza problemi tanto la materia organica quanto quella inorganica. Attenzione, perché avanza a passo lento e in grandi eserciti.

jp: ゴーレムの技術を応用した人形。人形の意思でパーツを魔力変形させることができ、この機構がシームレスな表情変化を実現している。漏れた魔力が作用して髪の毛が少しずつ伸びることもあるが、不気味がらないように。
jp_grezzo: "ゴーレムの技術を応用した人形。人形の意思でパーツを魔力変形させることができ、この機構がシームレスな表情変化を実現している。漏れた魔力が作用して髪の毛が少しずつ伸びることもあるが、不気味がらないように。"
en: This is a doll based on the technology of a golem. The doll's parts can be magically transformed at will and this mechanism allows for seamless facial changes. The leaked magic may act on your hair and cause it to grow a little bit but don't be scared.
en_grezzo: "This is a doll based on the technology of a golem. The doll's parts can be magically transformed at will and this mechanism allows for seamless facial changes. The leaked magic may act on your hair and cause it to grow a little bit but don't be scared."
it: Una bambola costruita applicando la tecnica dei golem. Con la propria volontà può deformare magicamente i pezzi di cui è fatta, e questo meccanismo le permette di cambiare espressione senza stacchi. Può capitare che il potere magico che sfugge le faccia crescere i capelli a poco a poco, ma non c'è da spaventarsi.

jp: 鳩の姿をした調停者。長きに渡る争いの歴史に疲れ果て、全ての生命を根絶することでしか真の平和は実現できないという結論に達した。平和のためなら核弾頭も使うタカ派。
jp_grezzo: "鳩の姿をした調停者。長きに渡る争いの歴史に疲れ果て、全ての生命を根絶することでしか真の平和は実現できないという結論に達した。平和のためなら核弾頭も使うタカ派。"
en: A mediator in the form of a pigeon. Exhausted by a long history of strife they have come to the conclusion that true peace can only be achieved through the eradication of all life. They are hawks who will use nuclear warheads for the sake of peace.
en_grezzo: "A mediator in the form of a pigeon. Exhausted by a long history of strife they have come to the conclusion that true peace can only be achieved through the eradication of all life. They are hawks who will use nuclear warheads for the sake of peace."
it: Un mediatore in forma di colomba. Sfinito da una storia di lotte lunghissima, è arrivato alla conclusione che la vera pace si ottiene solo estirpando ogni forma di vita. È un falco: per la pace userebbe anche le testate nucleari.

jp: 大きな体と発達した筋肉を持つ飛べない鳥。遥か昔その力を恐れた神によって飛べなくされたと本気で主張している。ペンギンやキウイの仲間扱いされると怒るので注意。
jp_grezzo: "大きな体と発達した筋肉を持つ飛べない鳥。遥か昔その力を恐れた神によって飛べなくされたと本気で主張している。ペンギンやキウイの仲間扱いされると怒るので注意。"
en: A flightless bird with a large body and well-developed muscles. They seriously believe that long ago they were made unable to fly by a god who feared their power. Be careful not to offend them by treating them like penguins or kiwis.
en_grezzo: "A flightless bird with a large body and well-developed muscles. They seriously believe that long ago they were made unable to fly by a god who feared their power. Be careful not to offend them by treating them like penguins or kiwis."
it: Un uccello che non vola, con un corpo grande e muscoli ben sviluppati. Sostiene sul serio che in un tempo lontanissimo una divinità, temendo la sua forza, gli tolse il volo. Attenzione a non farlo arrabbiare trattandolo da parente del pinguino o del kiwi.

jp: 森に棲むフクロウの魔物。ただでさえ目と耳が良いのに、首を270度回して多方向をカバーする。その探知力と知能の高さから狙われると非常に危険。
jp_grezzo: "森に棲むフクロウの魔物。ただでさえ目と耳が良いのに、首を270度回して多方向をカバーする。その探知力と知能の高さから狙われると非常に危険。"
en: An owl demon that lives in the forest. Even though he has good eyes and ears he still turns his neck 270 degrees to cover multiple directions. It is very dangerous when targeting from up high with its detection power and intelligence.
en_grezzo: "An owl demon that lives in the forest. Even though he has good eyes and ears he still turns his neck 270 degrees to cover multiple directions. It is very dangerous when targeting from up high with its detection power and intelligence."
it: Un mostro-gufo che vive nel bosco. Ha già occhi e orecchie eccellenti, e per giunta gira il collo di duecentosettanta gradi e copre più direzioni insieme. Per quella capacità di individuare e per l'intelligenza che ha, esserne presi di mira è pericolosissimo.

jp: 姿は可愛いが、本性は邪悪そのもので雪の妖怪の異名を持つ。可愛らしさで獲物を油断させて惨殺し、体内に潜り込んで好物の脂身を貪る。ヨコシマなことを考える際、首をかしげる癖がある。だが可愛い。
jp_grezzo: "姿は可愛いが、本性は邪悪そのもので雪の妖怪の異名を持つ。可愛らしさで獲物を油断させて惨殺し、体内に潜り込んで好物の脂身を貪る。ヨコシマなことを考える際、首をかしげる癖がある。だが可愛い。"
en: Although cute in appearance she is evil in nature and has the nickname of a snow demon. They slaughter their prey by catching them off guard with their cuteness and then burrow into their bodies to gobble up their favorite meat. There is a habit of shaking one's head when thinking about Yokoshima. But it's cute.
en_grezzo: "Although cute in appearance she is evil in nature and has the nickname of a snow demon. They slaughter their prey by catching them off guard with their cuteness and then burrow into their bodies to gobble up their favorite meat. There is a habit of shaking one's head when thinking about Yokoshima. But it's cute."
it: All'aspetto è tenero, ma è il male in persona, e lo chiamano anche lo spiritello della neve. Con quella tenerezza abbassa la guardia della preda, la massacra, poi le si infila dentro e si abbuffa del grasso che tanto gli piace. Quando pensa a qualche perfidia ha il vizio di piegare la testa di lato. Però è tenero.

jp: 人間に弓矢で射られ、子供を殺され自身も矢が貫通して大怪我を負った過去を持つ。復讐のために弓矢の扱いを学び、人間どもを殺して回っている。連れているのは子供を模した人形。
jp_grezzo: "人間に弓矢で射られ、子供を殺され自身も矢が貫通して大怪我を負った過去を持つ。復讐のために弓矢の扱いを学び、人間どもを殺して回っている。連れているのは子供を模した人形。"
en: She was shot by a human with a bow and arrow which killed a child and severely injured herself when the arrow went through her. She' s learned how to handle a bow and arrow for revenge and goes around killing humans. She carries a doll that resembles her child.
en_grezzo: "She was shot by a human with a bow and arrow which killed a child and severely injured herself when the arrow went through her. She' s learned how to handle a bow and arrow for revenge and goes around killing humans. She carries a doll that resembles her child."
it: Ha alle spalle un uomo che l'ha colpita con arco e frecce: il suo piccolo è morto e lei stessa è rimasta ferita gravemente da una freccia che l'ha trapassata. Per vendetta ha imparato a usare arco e frecce, e va in giro ad ammazzare uomini. Quella che si porta dietro è una bambola che imita il suo piccolo.

jp: 元人間のでかいインコ。あまりに働かずグータラしていたため、魔法使いの母親に姿を変えられ家を追い出された。せっかくなので声真似で生計を立てることも考えたが、考えただけで終わった。
jp_grezzo: "元人間のでかいインコ。あまりに働かずグータラしていたため、魔法使いの母親に姿を変えられ家を追い出された。せっかくなので声真似で生計を立てることも考えたが、考えただけで終わった。"
en: A big parakeet that used to be human. Because he didn't work hard enough and was in a rut he was transformed by his wizard mother and kicked out of the house. He thought about making a living by imitating voices but he ended up just thinking about it.
en_grezzo: "A big parakeet that used to be human. Because he didn't work hard enough and was in a rut he was transformed by his wizard mother and kicked out of the house. He thought about making a living by imitating voices but he ended up just thinking about it."
it: Un pappagallo enorme che un tempo era umano. Siccome non lavorava e se ne stava in ozio, sua madre, che era una maga, gli cambiò l'aspetto e lo cacciò di casa. Già che c'era ha anche pensato di campare imitando le voci, ma si è fermato al pensiero.

jp: 長い年月主人に仕え続け、経験を重ねた執事。老いてこそいるが、技の冴えには目を見張るものがある。
jp_grezzo: "長い年月主人に仕え続け、経験を重ねた執事。老いてこそいるが、技の冴えには目を見張るものがある。"
en: A butler who has served his master for many years and has gained experience. He is old but his skill is remarkable.
en_grezzo: "A butler who has served his master for many years and has gained experience. He is old but his skill is remarkable."
it: Un maggiordomo che ha servito il padrone per lunghissimi anni e ne ha accumulato esperienza. Vecchio lo è, ma la sua abilità ha ancora qualcosa che lascia a bocca aperta.

jp: 身分の高い家や裕福な家で働く上級使用人。主人の身の回りの世話をしたり、秘書を兼ねて仕事を支えたりする。わがままな主人に仕えることになると大変不幸。
jp_grezzo: "身分の高い家や裕福な家で働く上級使用人。主人の身の回りの世話をしたり、秘書を兼ねて仕事を支えたりする。わがままな主人に仕えることになると大変不幸。"
en: A senior servant who works in a high-status or wealthy house. He takes care of his master and supports his work by acting as a secretary. He is very unhappy when he has to serve a selfish master.
en_grezzo: "A senior servant who works in a high-status or wealthy house. He takes care of his master and supports his work by acting as a secretary. He is very unhappy when he has to serve a selfish master."
it: Un domestico di rango alto che lavora presso famiglie nobili o ricche. Si occupa della persona del padrone e ne sostiene il lavoro facendogli anche da segretario. Se gli capita un padrone capriccioso, sono guai.

jp: 鞭を巧みに扱うスペシャルな少年。攻撃面はパワーアップしたのだが、性格も攻撃的になってしまった。表に出さないが、自分が攻撃されることを怖がっている。
jp_grezzo: "鞭を巧みに扱うスペシャルな少年。攻撃面はパワーアップしたのだが、性格も攻撃的になってしまった。表に出さないが、自分が攻撃されることを怖がっている。"
en: A special boy who handles the whip expertly. The attacks have improved in power but his personality has also become more aggressive. He doesn't show it but he is afraid that he will be attacked.
en_grezzo: "A special boy who handles the whip expertly. The attacks have improved in power but his personality has also become more aggressive. He doesn't show it but he is afraid that he will be attacked."
it: Un bambino speciale che maneggia la frusta con maestria. In attacco è diventato più potente, ma anche il carattere gli si è fatto aggressivo. Non lo dà a vedere, ma ha paura di essere attaccato lui.

jp: 大人になりきれてない男性全般…なのだが、少年という言葉自体は一応女性に対しても使える。無口で大人しい少女と比べて、やんちゃで騒々しいため、ペットとしては一般的ではない。
jp_grezzo: "大人になりきれてない男性全般…なのだが、少年という言葉自体は一応女性に対しても使える。無口で大人しい少女と比べて、やんちゃで騒々しいため、ペットとしては一般的ではない。"
en: The word boy can also be used as a term to describe a man who is not fully grown up.Compared to the taciturn and docile girl he is mischievous and boisterous making him a less common pet.
en_grezzo: "The word boy can also be used as a term to describe a man who is not fully grown up.Compared to the taciturn and docile girl he is mischievous and boisterous making him a less common pet."
it: In generale un maschio che non è ancora diventato adulto... anche se la parola, a rigore, si può usare pure per una femmina. Rispetto alla bambina, che è silenziosa e tranquilla, è vivace e chiassoso, e per questo come animale da compagnia va meno di moda.

jp: 忘却の女神の化身。運命の流れが途切れた世界に出現し、ありとあらゆる記憶を喰らって増殖する。初期対応が肝心。放っておくと人も世界も本当の意味で死を迎えてしまう。
jp_grezzo: "忘却の女神の化身。運命の流れが途切れた世界に出現し、ありとあらゆる記憶を喰らって増殖する。初期対応が肝心。放っておくと人も世界も本当の意味で死を迎えてしまう。"
en: The Goddess of Oblivion incarnate. They appear in a world where the flow of destiny is interrupted and multiply by eating all sorts of memories. The initial response is crucial. If left alone people and the world will die in the truest sense of the word.
en_grezzo: "The Goddess of Oblivion incarnate. They appear in a world where the flow of destiny is interrupted and multiply by eating all sorts of memories. The initial response is crucial. If left alone people and the world will die in the truest sense of the word."
it: L'incarnazione della dea dell'oblio. Compare nei mondi in cui il flusso del destino si è interrotto, e si moltiplica divorando ogni sorta di ricordi. Quel che conta è intervenire subito: se la si lascia fare, gli uomini e il mondo muoiono nel senso vero della parola.

jp: かつては生き生きと暮らしていた住人だったが、記憶を食いつくされ存在自体が消えかけている。かろうじて残った存在の残滓がアストラル光に照らされて影を作っている状態。
jp_grezzo: "かつては生き生きと暮らしていた住人だったが、記憶を食いつくされ存在自体が消えかけている。かろうじて残った存在の残滓がアストラル光に照らされて影を作っている状態。"
en: The inhabitants were once alive and well but their memories have eaten away and their very existence has faded away. A state where the barely remaining remnants of existence create a shadow in the astral light.
en_grezzo: "The inhabitants were once alive and well but their memories have eaten away and their very existence has faded away. A state where the barely remaining remnants of existence create a shadow in the astral light."
it: Erano abitanti che vivevano pieni di vita, ma i ricordi glieli hanno divorati e la loro stessa esistenza sta svanendo. È lo stato in cui il residuo di esistenza rimasto a stento, illuminato dalla luce astrale, proietta un'ombra.

jp: ガイアス・ヴィスのほうのノースティリスに生息する野生動物。タートルラビットとソックリで、背に亀の甲羅がついている…のだが、合成獣であるあちらと違ってこちらは天然進化の結果。背骨が外骨格として発達したらしい。
jp_grezzo: "ガイアス・ヴィスのほうのノースティリスに生息する野生動物。タートルラビットとソックリで、背に亀の甲羅がついている…のだが、合成獣であるあちらと違ってこちらは天然進化の結果。背骨が外骨格として発達したらしい。"
en: A wild animal that lives in North Tyris towards Gaius Vis. It looks a lot like the Turtle Rabbit with a turtle shell on its back... but unlike the synthetic beast this one is the result of natural evolution. Apparently the spine developed as an external skeleton.
en_grezzo: "A wild animal that lives in North Tyris towards Gaius Vis. It looks a lot like the Turtle Rabbit with a turtle shell on its back... but unlike the synthetic beast this one is the result of natural evolution. Apparently the spine developed as an external skeleton."
it: Un animale selvatico che vive nella Tyris del Nord dalla parte di Gaius Vis. È identico al coniglio tartaruga, con il guscio di tartaruga sulla schiena... ma a differenza di quello, che è una bestia sintetica, questo è il risultato di un'evoluzione naturale: pare che la spina dorsale gli si sia sviluppata come esoscheletro.

jp: ガイアス・ヴィスのほうのノースティリスに生息する野生動物。赤毛が混じっているのが特徴的。赤い目が神秘的だが、特に何の魔力も持たない普通の狐。
jp_grezzo: "ガイアス・ヴィスのほうのノースティリスに生息する野生動物。赤毛が混じっているのが特徴的。赤い目が神秘的だが、特に何の魔力も持たない普通の狐。"
en: A wild animal that lives in North Tyris towards Gaius Vis. It is characterized by a mixture of red hair. An ordinary fox with mysterious red eyes but no magical powers.
en_grezzo: "A wild animal that lives in North Tyris towards Gaius Vis. It is characterized by a mixture of red hair. An ordinary fox with mysterious red eyes but no magical powers."
it: Un animale selvatico che vive nella Tyris del Nord dalla parte di Gaius Vis. La si riconosce dal pelo rosso mescolato al resto. Gli occhi rossi sono misteriosi, ma è una volpe qualunque e di potere magico non ne ha.

jp: ガイアス・ヴィスのほうのノースティリスに生息する野生動物。神経が図太く、人が近づいても逃げない。それゆえに腹を空かせた旅人に狩られたりする。
jp_grezzo: "ガイアス・ヴィスのほうのノースティリスに生息する野生動物。神経が図太く、人が近づいても逃げない。それゆえに腹を空かせた旅人に狩られたりする。"
en: A wild animal that lives in North Tyris towards Gaius Vis. His nerves are thick and he does not run away when people approach him. That's why they're often hunted by hungry travelers.
en_grezzo: "A wild animal that lives in North Tyris towards Gaius Vis. His nerves are thick and he does not run away when people approach him. That's why they're often hunted by hungry travelers."
it: Un animale selvatico che vive nella Tyris del Nord dalla parte di Gaius Vis. Ha i nervi saldi e non scappa nemmeno se qualcuno gli si avvicina. Proprio per questo capita che i viandanti affamati lo caccino.

jp: ガイアス・ヴィスのほうのノースティリスに生息する野生動物。身体はでかいし牙も鋭いが、見た目によらず大人しい。急に近づいてきても慌てて攻撃してはいけない。
jp_grezzo: "ガイアス・ヴィスのほうのノースティリスに生息する野生動物。身体はでかいし牙も鋭いが、見た目によらず大人しい。急に近づいてきても慌てて攻撃してはいけない。"
en: A wild animal that lives in North Tyris towards Gaius Vis. His body is large and his fangs are sharp but he is as calm as he looks. Don't attack in a hurry even if they are suddenly approaching.
en_grezzo: "A wild animal that lives in North Tyris towards Gaius Vis. His body is large and his fangs are sharp but he is as calm as he looks. Don't attack in a hurry even if they are suddenly approaching."
it: Un animale selvatico che vive nella Tyris del Nord dalla parte di Gaius Vis. Ha un corpo grosso e zanne aguzze, ma malgrado l'aspetto è tranquillo. Anche se si avvicina all'improvviso, non bisogna attaccarlo per la fretta.

jp: ガイアス・ヴィスのほうのノースティリスに生息する攻撃的な野生動物。街の外を普通にうろついているので、外出時は認識阻害魔術をかけるのが常識。そんなことは知らないよそ者が何人も食い殺されてきた。
jp_grezzo: "ガイアス・ヴィスのほうのノースティリスに生息する攻撃的な野生動物。街の外を普通にうろついているので、外出時は認識阻害魔術をかけるのが常識。そんなことは知らないよそ者が何人も食い殺されてきた。"
en: This is an aggressive wild animal that lives in North Tyris towards Gaius Vis. It's common sense to cast a cognitive disruption spell when you're out and about since you're hanging around outside the city normally. A number of strangers have been eaten to death who didn't know that.
en_grezzo: "This is an aggressive wild animal that lives in North Tyris towards Gaius Vis. It's common sense to cast a cognitive disruption spell when you're out and about since you're hanging around outside the city normally. A number of strangers have been eaten to death who didn't know that."
it: Un animale selvatico e aggressivo che vive nella Tyris del Nord dalla parte di Gaius Vis. Gironzola tranquillamente fuori dalle città, e per uscire è buonsenso lanciarsi addosso una magia che confonde la percezione. Più di un forestiero che non lo sapeva è finito sbranato.

jp: ガイアス・ヴィスのほうのノースティリスに生息する攻撃的な野生動物。イルヴァのライオンより筋肉質で、体色も黄色い。タイマンでこいつを倒せるようになれば一人前の戦士として認められる。
jp_grezzo: "ガイアス・ヴィスのほうのノースティリスに生息する攻撃的な野生動物。イルヴァのライオンより筋肉質で、体色も黄色い。タイマンでこいつを倒せるようになれば一人前の戦士として認められる。"
en: This is an aggressive wild animal that lives in North Tyris towards Gaius Vis. It is more muscular than the lion of Irva and has a yellow body color. If you can beat this guy in a match you will be recognized as a full-fledged warrior.
en_grezzo: "This is an aggressive wild animal that lives in North Tyris towards Gaius Vis. It is more muscular than the lion of Irva and has a yellow body color. If you can beat this guy in a match you will be recognized as a full-fledged warrior."
it: Un animale selvatico e aggressivo che vive nella Tyris del Nord dalla parte di Gaius Vis. È più muscoloso del leone di Irva e ha il pelo più giallo. Chi arriva ad abbatterlo in un duello a due viene riconosciuto guerriero fatto e finito.

jp: 悪魔に命懸けで立ち向かった天使だったが、捕まって全身改造され悪魔にされてしまった。天使だった頃の意識は失っておらず脱出して故郷に帰還した。仲間たちを無意識に殺してしまった後で自分の悪魔化に気づいて愕然。故郷を離れ、はぐれ悪魔としてひっそりと生きていくことを決めた。
jp_grezzo: "悪魔に命懸けで立ち向かった天使だったが、捕まって全身改造され悪魔にされてしまった。天使だった頃の意識は失っておらず脱出して故郷に帰還した。仲間たちを無意識に殺してしまった後で自分の悪魔化に気づいて愕然。故郷を離れ、はぐれ悪魔としてひっそりと生きていくことを決めた。"
en: She was an angel who risked her life against a demon but she was caught and her whole body was altered and turned into a demon. She had not lost the consciousness she had when she was an angel so she escaped and returned to her homeland. She is horrified to realize her own demonization after she unknowingly killed her friends. She decided to leave her hometown and live quietly as a stray demon.
en_grezzo: "She was an angel who risked her life against a demon but she was caught and her whole body was altered and turned into a demon. She had not lost the consciousness she had when she was an angel so she escaped and returned to her homeland. She is horrified to realize her own demonization after she unknowingly killed her friends. She decided to leave her hometown and live quietly as a stray demon."
it: Era un angelo che affrontò un demone a rischio della vita, ma fu catturata, le rifecero il corpo da cima a fondo e la trasformarono in demone. La coscienza che aveva da angelo non l'aveva perduta: fuggì e tornò in patria. Poi, dopo aver ucciso i compagni senza rendersene conto, si accorse di essere diventata demone e ne restò sconvolta. Ha lasciato la sua terra e ha deciso di vivere in disparte, come demone randagio.

jp: 琥珀眼の悪魔『バイシルフ』
ザイエルン銀行のザイール支店で働いていた。世界規模の異変により銀行が維持できなくなってしまった今でも、預かった金貨を横領せず責任をもって預かっている。
jp_grezzo: "ザイエルン銀行のザイール支店で働いていた。世界規模の異変により銀行が維持できなくなってしまった今でも、預かった金貨を横領せず責任をもって預かっている。"
en: He worked in the Zaile branch of the Zaile Bank. Even now that the bank is unsustainable due to global anomalies it still holds gold coins responsibly without embezzling them.
en_grezzo: "He worked in the Zaile branch of the Zaile Bank. Even now that the bank is unsustainable due to global anomalies it still holds gold coins responsibly without embezzling them."
it: Lavorava alla filiale di Zaile della banca Zaielun. Adesso che uno sconvolgimento su scala mondiale ha reso impossibile mandare avanti la banca, custodisce ancora con senso di responsabilità le monete d'oro che le sono state affidate, senza appropriarsene.

jp: ギルドに寄せられた依頼を斡旋する人。依頼を受ける人間から仲介料を取って運営費に充てていた。現在は依頼自体がなくなってしまったため、依頼用ゲートも維持管理できていない。
jp_grezzo: "ギルドに寄せられた依頼を斡旋する人。依頼を受ける人間から仲介料を取って運営費に充てていた。現在は依頼自体がなくなってしまったため、依頼用ゲートも維持管理できていない。"
en: A person who mediates requests made to the guild. They were taking brokerage fees from the people who would receive the requests and were using them for operating expenses. Now that the request itself is gone the request gate is no longer maintained.
en_grezzo: "A person who mediates requests made to the guild. They were taking brokerage fees from the people who would receive the requests and were using them for operating expenses. Now that the request itself is gone the request gate is no longer maintained."
it: La persona che smista gli incarichi che arrivano alla gilda. Prendeva una commissione da chi accettava l'incarico e la destinava alle spese di gestione. Adesso gli incarichi non ci sono più, e così nemmeno il portale degli incarichi si riesce a tenere in ordine.

jp: 店員であって店主ではない。雇い主のことももう記憶にない。物資の流通が途絶えたため、商品の調達に苦労しているらしい。そんな状態でも皆のために店をやり続けようとしている。
jp_grezzo: "店員であって店主ではない。雇い主のことももう記憶にない。物資の流通が途絶えたため、商品の調達に苦労しているらしい。そんな状態でも皆のために店をやり続けようとしている。"
en: He is a clerk not a shopkeeper. He doesn't even remember his employer anymore. Apparently they are struggling to procure goods because the distribution of goods has been cut off. Even in such a state he tries to keep the shop running for everyone.
en_grezzo: "He is a clerk not a shopkeeper. He doesn't even remember his employer anymore. Apparently they are struggling to procure goods because the distribution of goods has been cut off. Even in such a state he tries to keep the shop running for everyone."
it: È un commesso, non il padrone del negozio. Del suo datore di lavoro non ha più memoria. Siccome la circolazione delle merci si è interrotta, pare che faccia una gran fatica a procurarsi da vendere. Eppure, anche così, cerca di tenere aperto il negozio per tutti.

jp: 恐怖を忘れさせるため今日も生存者に酒をふるまう。活気のなくなった酒場を見ながら、もし自分に客を蘇生させる特殊能力があれば…と空想にひたっている。
jp_grezzo: "恐怖を忘れさせるため今日も生存者に酒をふるまう。活気のなくなった酒場を見ながら、もし自分に客を蘇生させる特殊能力があれば…と空想にひたっている。"
en: To make you forget your fears he still serves alcohol to the survivors to this day. As he looks at the deserted tavern he wonders if he has a special ability to revive customers.
en_grezzo: "To make you forget your fears he still serves alcohol to the survivors to this day. As he looks at the deserted tavern he wonders if he has a special ability to revive customers."
it: Anche oggi offre da bere ai sopravvissuti, perché dimentichino la paura. Guardando la taverna senza più vita, si perde a fantasticare: se avesse il potere speciale di far resuscitare i clienti...

jp: パルミアから送り込まれた調査隊に所属。当初はエーテルの風が与える影響についてラスキリスの谷周辺で調査していた。
jp_grezzo: "パルミアから送り込まれた調査隊に所属。当初はエーテルの風が与える影響についてラスキリスの谷周辺で調査していた。"
en: He belongs to a survey team sent from Palmia. Initially they were investigating the effects of the Etherwinds around the valley of Raskilis.
en_grezzo: "He belongs to a survey team sent from Palmia. Initially they were investigating the effects of the Etherwinds around the valley of Raskilis."
it: Fa parte della squadra d'indagine mandata da Palmia. All'inizio indagava sugli effetti del vento d'etere nei dintorni della valle di Raskilis.

jp: 冒険に魂を燃やす熱い男。ノースティリスを訪れるトラベラーたちに助言する親切さも持ち合わせる。それは滅びゆく世界の中でも変わらない。
jp_grezzo: "冒険に魂を燃やす熱い男。ノースティリスを訪れるトラベラーたちに助言する親切さも持ち合わせる。それは滅びゆく世界の中でも変わらない。"
en: A passionate man with a soul that burns with adventure. He also has the kindness to advise travellers visiting North Tyris. It's the same in a dying world.
en_grezzo: "A passionate man with a soul that burns with adventure. He also has the kindness to advise travellers visiting North Tyris. It's the same in a dying world."
it: Un uomo ardente, che nell'avventura brucia l'anima. Ha anche la gentilezza di dare consigli ai viaggiatori che arrivano nella Tyris del Nord. E questo non cambia nemmeno in un mondo che sta finendo.

jp: 燃える冒険者魂『バート』
ドールでは英雄と称えられる、赤い長髪の有能な軍人。実力で勝ちたい相手がいたのだが、先立たれてしまったので忸怩たる思いを抱えている。特に肩が強いわけではない。
jp_grezzo: "ドールでは英雄と称えられる、赤い長髪の有能な軍人。実力で勝ちたい相手がいたのだが、先立たれてしまったので忸怩たる思いを抱えている。特に肩が強いわけではない。"
en: A talented military man with long red hair who is hailed as a hero in Dole. However he felt ashamed because he had an opponent that he wanted to beat with his own strength. It's not like he has a particularly strong shoulder.
en_grezzo: "A talented military man with long red hair who is hailed as a hero in Dole. However he felt ashamed because he had an opponent that he wanted to beat with his own strength. It's not like he has a particularly strong shoulder."
it: Un militare capace dai lunghi capelli rossi, che a Dole celebrano come un eroe. C'era qualcuno che voleva battere con le proprie forze, ma quello se n'è andato prima, e lui se ne porta dietro il rammarico. Non è che abbia una spalla particolarmente forte.

jp: ドールの紅血『ロイター』
アカシックレコードを守護する天使。世界に歪みが蓄積した時、真の力を解放するらしい。歪みが記録されてしまう前に、強制終了によって巻き戻すのが使命。すべての空間、時間、次元…ありとあらゆる場所に現れ、最後に空を舞う者。
jp_grezzo: "アカシックレコードを守護する天使。世界に歪みが蓄積した時、真の力を解放するらしい。歪みが記録されてしまう前に、強制終了によって巻き戻すのが使命。すべての空間、時間、次元…ありとあらゆる場所に現れ、最後に空を舞う者。"
en: The guardian angel of the Akashic Records. Apparently when distortions accumulate in the world one releases one's true power. The mission is to rewind the distortions by force termination before they are recorded. One who appears in every space time dimension everywhere and finally takes to the skies.
en_grezzo: "The guardian angel of the Akashic Records. Apparently when distortions accumulate in the world one releases one's true power. The mission is to rewind the distortions by force termination before they are recorded. One who appears in every space time dimension everywhere and finally takes to the skies."
it: L'angelo che fa la guardia alla rete akashica. Pare che, quando nel mondo si accumulano le distorsioni, liberi la sua vera potenza. La sua missione è riavvolgere le distorsioni con un arresto forzato prima che vengano registrate. Compare in ogni spazio, in ogni tempo, in ogni dimensione... ed è colui che alla fine danza nel cielo.

jp: 量子生物兵器が放った汚染波動を、わずかに浴びてしまったトリケラトプス。手足や角が少しずつ退化を始めているほか、身体の一部が機械と融合している。もし波動にドップリ浸かっていたらどうなっていたのか、考えるだけでも恐ろしい。
jp_grezzo: "量子生物兵器が放った汚染波動を、わずかに浴びてしまったトリケラトプス。手足や角が少しずつ退化を始めているほか、身体の一部が機械と融合している。もし波動にドップリ浸かっていたらどうなっていたのか、考えるだけでも恐ろしい。"
en: Triceratops has been slightly exposed to the pollution waves unleashed by quantum biological weapons. The limbs and horns are beginning to degenerate slightly and parts of the body are fusing with the machine. Just thinking about what would have happened if I had been immersed in the waves is terrifying.
en_grezzo: "Triceratops has been slightly exposed to the pollution waves unleashed by quantum biological weapons. The limbs and horns are beginning to degenerate slightly and parts of the body are fusing with the machine. Just thinking about what would have happened if I had been immersed in the waves is terrifying."
it: Un triceratopo sfiorato appena dall'onda di contaminazione emessa da un'arma biologica quantistica. Zampe e corna hanno cominciato a regredire un poco alla volta, e una parte del corpo si è fusa con la macchina. A pensare che cosa sarebbe successo se si fosse immerso del tutto in quell'onda, viene paura.

jp: 首の長い恐竜。頭部が避雷針になっており、雷を浴びて蓄電する。図体もでかいが態度もでかく、他の動物のことを完全に見下している。あのキリンさんですら、こいつには頭が上がらないらしい。
jp_grezzo: "首の長い恐竜。頭部が避雷針になっており、雷を浴びて蓄電する。図体もでかいが態度もでかく、他の動物のことを完全に見下している。あのキリンさんですら、こいつには頭が上がらないらしい。"
en: Long-necked dinosaurs. The head is a lightning rod that stores electricity when it is struck by lightning. They have a big figure and a big attitude and they look down on other animals completely. Even the giraffe can't be compared to these creatures.
en_grezzo: "Long-necked dinosaurs. The head is a lightning rod that stores electricity when it is struck by lightning. They have a big figure and a big attitude and they look down on other animals completely. Even the giraffe can't be compared to these creatures."
it: Un dinosauro dal collo lungo. La testa gli fa da parafulmine: prende la folgore e ne accumula la carica. Ha una stazza grande e un'arroganza altrettanto grande, e guarda tutti gli altri animali dall'alto in basso. Pare che perfino la signora giraffa, davanti a lui, non alzi la testa.

jp: 三本角が特徴的な恐竜。旧文明の遺伝子技術で復元されたらしい。身体は大きいが大人しい。乱暴者のティラノサウルスのことが嫌い。
jp_grezzo: "三本角が特徴的な恐竜。旧文明の遺伝子技術で復元されたらしい。身体は大きいが大人しい。乱暴者のティラノサウルスのことが嫌い。"
en: This dinosaur is characterized by three horns. Apparently it was restored with genetic technology from the old civilization. They are large and mature. They hate the unruly tyrannosaurus.
en_grezzo: "This dinosaur is characterized by three horns. Apparently it was restored with genetic technology from the old civilization. They are large and mature. They hate the unruly tyrannosaurus."
it: Un dinosauro che si riconosce dalle tre corna. Pare che sia stato ricostruito con la tecnica genetica della civiltà antica. Ha un corpo grande ma è tranquillo. Detesta il tirannosauro, che è un violento.

jp: 生化学文明に滅亡が迫る中、遺伝子調整で作られた。エーテルを好む性質と再生能力が強化されており、エーテル源の守護者となるはずだった存在。エーテルが好きすぎて独占しようと他生物を殺し始めたり、好きすぎて森を食べようとしたりしたので、失敗作として封印された。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明に滅亡が迫る中、遺伝子調整で作られた。エーテルを好む性質と再生能力が強化されており、エーテル源の守護者となるはずだった存在。エーテルが好きすぎて独占しようと他生物を殺し始めたり、好きすぎて森を食べようとしたりしたので、失敗作として封印された。"
en: It was created by genetic adjustments in the midst of the impending doom of a biochemical civilization. A being with enhanced ether-loving qualities and regenerative abilities and who was supposed to be the guardian of the etheric source. They liked the ether so much that they started killing other creatures to monopolize it and they liked it so much that they tried to eat the entire world so it was sealed as a failure.
en_grezzo: "It was created by genetic adjustments in the midst of the impending doom of a biochemical civilization. A being with enhanced ether-loving qualities and regenerative abilities and who was supposed to be the guardian of the etheric source. They liked the ether so much that they started killing other creatures to monopolize it and they liked it so much that they tried to eat the entire world so it was sealed as a failure."
it: Fu creata per aggiustamento genetico mentre sulla civiltà biochimica incombeva la fine. Le avevano rafforzato l'attrazione per l'etere e la capacità di rigenerarsi, e sarebbe dovuta diventare la guardiana della sorgente d'etere. Ma l'etere le piaceva talmente che si mise a uccidere le altre creature per averlo tutto, e talmente che provò a mangiarsi la foresta: così la sigillarono come esemplare mal riuscito.

jp: 生化学文明の遺跡において、培養漕の中で眠っていた合成恐竜。興味本位で目覚めさせた遺跡荒らしを立派な尻尾で粉砕して逃亡。重力波を出せるがコントロールが不完全で、周囲の物を潰してしまって困っている。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明の遺跡において、培養漕の中で眠っていた合成恐竜。興味本位で目覚めさせた遺跡荒らしを立派な尻尾で粉砕して逃亡。重力波を出せるがコントロールが不完全で、周囲の物を潰してしまって困っている。"
en: A synthetic dinosaur asleep in a culture tank at the site of a biochemical civilization. The vandals who awakened him out of curiosity were crushed by his magnificent tail and he escaped. It can create gravitational waves but its control is incomplete and it has trouble crushing things around it.
en_grezzo: "A synthetic dinosaur asleep in a culture tank at the site of a biochemical civilization. The vandals who awakened him out of curiosity were crushed by his magnificent tail and he escaped. It can create gravitational waves but its control is incomplete and it has trouble crushing things around it."
it: Un dinosauro sintetico che dormiva dentro una vasca di coltura, in un sito della civiltà biochimica. Quando i saccheggiatori di rovine lo svegliarono per curiosità, li polverizzò con la coda maestosa e scappò. Sa emettere onde gravitazionali, ma le controlla male, e si trova in imbarazzo perché schiaccia quello che ha attorno.

jp: 重力谷の『グラヴィード』
大昔、湿林に置き去りにされたクレイゴーレム。捨てられたのは、当時は感情の芽生えたゴーレムが忌避されていたため。そんなことは知らず主人の帰りをずっと待っている。身を守るために湿林の泥を使って武装するうちに、すっかりマッドゴーレムみたいになってしまった。
jp_grezzo: "大昔、湿林に置き去りにされたクレイゴーレム。捨てられたのは、当時は感情の芽生えたゴーレムが忌避されていたため。そんなことは知らず主人の帰りをずっと待っている。身を守るために湿林の泥を使って武装するうちに、すっかりマッドゴーレムみたいになってしまった。"
en: Long ago a clay golem was marooned in a marsh forest. It was discarded because the budding emotional golem was shunned at the time. She doesn't know that and she's been waiting for her master's return. As she armed herself with the dirt of the swamp forest to protect herself she became a kind of mud golem.
en_grezzo: "Long ago a clay golem was marooned in a marsh forest. It was discarded because the budding emotional golem was shunned at the time. She doesn't know that and she's been waiting for her master's return. As she armed herself with the dirt of the swamp forest to protect herself she became a kind of mud golem."
it: Un golem d'argilla abbandonato tanto tempo fa in una palude boscosa. La lasciarono lì perché allora i golem in cui spuntava un sentimento facevano paura. Lei non lo sa, e da allora aspetta che il padrone torni. A furia di armarsi con il fango della palude per difendersi, è finita per somigliare in tutto a un golem di fango.

jp: 湿林の忌み子『ドロシア』
普段は海で大人しく暮らしているが、日の出とともに海から空に昇っていくことがある。古代には桁違いに巨大な個体も存在し、海に横たわると身体が海面からはみだすほどだったという。
jp_grezzo: "普段は海で大人しく暮らしているが、日の出とともに海から空に昇っていくことがある。古代には桁違いに巨大な個体も存在し、海に横たわると身体が海面からはみだすほどだったという。"
en: Normally they live in the ocean as adults but sometimes they ascend from the sea to the sky at sunrise. It is said that in ancient times there were individuals so huge that when they lay in the sea their bodies would protrude from the surface.
en_grezzo: "Normally they live in the ocean as adults but sometimes they ascend from the sea to the sky at sunrise. It is said that in ancient times there were individuals so huge that when they lay in the sea their bodies would protrude from the surface."
it: Di solito vive tranquillo in mare, ma capita che al sorgere del sole salga dall'acqua verso il cielo. Nell'antichità, si dice, ne esistevano esemplari smisuratamente più grandi: quando si distendevano in mare il corpo sporgeva fuori dalla superficie.

jp: ハンバーガーの怪物。料理としての自覚が足りず、「俺たちはヒトに食われるために存在しているわけじゃない！」と怒りのあまりモンスター化した。食われるがままになっている同族やフライドポテトにも憤慨している。
jp_grezzo: "ハンバーガーの怪物。料理としての自覚が足りず、「俺たちはヒトに食われるために存在しているわけじゃない！」と怒りのあまりモンスター化した。食われるがままになっている同族やフライドポテトにも憤慨している。"
en: The burger monster. Lacking self-awareness as a dish We don't exist to be eaten by humans! and angrily turned into a monster. They are resented by their kindred spirits and french fries that are left to be eaten.
en_grezzo: "The burger monster. Lacking self-awareness as a dish We don't exist to be eaten by humans! and angrily turned into a monster. They are resented by their kindred spirits and french fries that are left to be eaten."
it: Il mostro dell'hamburger. Gli manca la coscienza di essere un piatto, e a furia di gridare che loro non esistono per farsi mangiare dagli uomini si è trasformato in mostro per la rabbia. Se la prende anche con i suoi simili e con le patatine fritte, che si lasciano mangiare senza fiatare.

jp: All Options-Implemented、すなわち全オプションを実装されたメルガスト。青いからではない。全装着した場合のバランステストと言う名目で用意されたのだが、増加装甲や本体に謎の可動部が設けられている。あまりにゴテゴテしているため、乗るのには向いてない。
jp_grezzo: "All Options-Implemented、すなわち全オプションを実装されたメルガスト。青いからではない。全装着した場合のバランステストと言う名目で用意されたのだが、増加装甲や本体に謎の可動部が設けられている。あまりにゴテゴテしているため、乗るのには向いてない。"
en: All Options-Implemented i.e. All Options-Implemented Melugast. It's not because it' s blue but it was prepared for a fully equipped balnce test the moving parts were added to the body to increase armor. It is not suitable for riding because it is too lumpy.
en_grezzo: "All Options-Implemented i.e. All Options-Implemented Melugast. It's not because it' s blue but it was prepared for a fully equipped balnce test the moving parts were added to the body to increase armor. It is not suitable for riding because it is too lumpy."
it: All Options-Implemented, cioè il Melugast con tutte le opzioni montate. Non è perché è blu. Fu allestito con la scusa di provare l'equilibrio a pieno carico, ma nella corazza aggiuntiva e nel corpo gli hanno messo parti mobili misteriose. È talmente carico di roba che a montarci sopra non ci si sta comodi.

jp: エウダーナに現れた忘却の女神の化身が捕獲・改造された姿。危険な魔術を応用して、特殊能力の制御と身体能力の向上が行われている。才ある術者なら記憶抹消能力を使わせることもできるが、術者の方も反動で記憶が蝕まれてしまうので危険。
jp_grezzo: "エウダーナに現れた忘却の女神の化身が捕獲・改造された姿。危険な魔術を応用して、特殊能力の制御と身体能力の向上が行われている。才ある術者なら記憶抹消能力を使わせることもできるが、術者の方も反動で記憶が蝕まれてしまうので危険。"
en: A captured and altered incarnation of the Goddess of Oblivion that appeared in Eulderna. Dangerous magic has been applied to control special abilities and improve physical abilities. A skilled magician can use the memory wiping ability but the magician's memory will also be eroded by the reaction.
en_grezzo: "A captured and altered incarnation of the Goddess of Oblivion that appeared in Eulderna. Dangerous magic has been applied to control special abilities and improve physical abilities. A skilled magician can use the memory wiping ability but the magician's memory will also be eroded by the reaction."
it: L'incarnazione della dea dell'oblio comparsa a Eulderna, catturata e rimaneggiata. Applicandole una magia pericolosa le hanno dato il controllo dei poteri speciali e migliorato le capacità fisiche. Un mago capace può anche farle usare il potere di cancellare i ricordi, ma è rischioso: il contraccolpo corrode anche la memoria di chi la comanda.

jp: エンテュメイシスが想像妊娠で作り上げた子供。母親に似ず獅子の上半身と蛇の下半身を持つ怪物。育児放棄された結果、自分で歪んだ世界を創造して引きこもった。その中でずっと支配者を気取っていたのだが、いつの間にか母親の胎内に還っていた。
jp_grezzo: "エンテュメイシスが想像妊娠で作り上げた子供。母親に似ず獅子の上半身と蛇の下半身を持つ怪物。育児放棄された結果、自分で歪んだ世界を創造して引きこもった。その中でずっと支配者を気取っていたのだが、いつの間にか母親の胎内に還っていた。"
en: A child created by Enthumesis with an imaginary pregnancy. A monster with the upper body of a lion and the lower body of a snake not unlike his mother. As a result of being neglected he created his own warped world and withdrew. He'd been pretending to be a ruler all along but before he knew it he'd returned to his mother's womb.
en_grezzo: "A child created by Enthumesis with an imaginary pregnancy. A monster with the upper body of a lion and the lower body of a snake not unlike his mother. As a result of being neglected he created his own warped world and withdrew. He'd been pretending to be a ruler all along but before he knew it he'd returned to his mother's womb."
it: Il figlio che Enthumesis ha messo al mondo con una gravidanza immaginaria. Non somiglia alla madre: è un mostro con la parte superiore di leone e quella inferiore di serpente. Abbandonato a sé stesso, si è creato un mondo storto tutto suo e ci si è chiuso dentro. Lì dentro faceva la parte del sovrano, finché senza accorgersene non è tornato nel ventre della madre.

jp: 戦死者たちの怨念と骸骨が融合して生まれた巨大な骸骨。生者を握りつぶして頭から噛み砕く。小さいが一応胃袋は存在するらしい。
jp_grezzo: "戦死者たちの怨念と骸骨が融合して生まれた巨大な骸骨。生者を握りつぶして頭から噛み砕く。小さいが一応胃袋は存在するらしい。"
en: A giant skeleton born from the fusion of the grudges of the war victims and their remains. It crushes the living and chews the head off. It's small but apparently it has a stomach.
en_grezzo: "A giant skeleton born from the fusion of the grudges of the war victims and their remains. It crushes the living and chews the head off. It's small but apparently it has a stomach."
it: Uno scheletro gigantesco, nato dalla fusione fra il rancore dei caduti in guerra e le loro ossa. Stritola i vivi e li mastica cominciando dalla testa. È piccolo, ma pare che uno stomaco ce l'abbia.

jp: 元々はとある地方で大量発生していた魔獣。多大な犠牲を払ってなんとか根絶できたという。だが討伐隊の活躍を妬んだ外道が、嫌がらせのためだけに骨から復活させてしまった。
jp_grezzo: "元々はとある地方で大量発生していた魔獣。多大な犠牲を払ってなんとか根絶できたという。だが討伐隊の活躍を妬んだ外道が、嫌がらせのためだけに骨から復活させてしまった。"
en: Originally there was a mass outbreak in a certain region. They say they were able to eradicate it at great cost. But a foreigner envious of the exploits of the squad resurrected them from their bones just for the sake of harassment.
en_grezzo: "Originally there was a mass outbreak in a certain region. They say they were able to eradicate it at great cost. But a foreigner envious of the exploits of the squad resurrected them from their bones just for the sake of harassment."
it: In origine era una belva magica che in una certa regione si era diffusa a dismisura. Con enormi sacrifici, dicono, riuscirono a sterminarla. Ma un miserabile invidioso delle imprese della squadra di caccia la fece risorgere dalle ossa, solo per fare un dispetto.

jp: 金のために生き、そして死んだ冒険者の成れの果て。金を奪われるのを恐れて誰も信用しなかったので、その最期は孤独死だった。皆が自分の死体から金を奪ったという妄執に憑りつかれており、奪い返そうと必死。
jp_grezzo: "金のために生き、そして死んだ冒険者の成れの果て。金を奪われるのを恐れて誰も信用しなかったので、その最期は孤独死だった。皆が自分の死体から金を奪ったという妄執に憑りつかれており、奪い返そうと必死。"
en: The end of an adventurer who lived and died for money. He didn't trust anyone for fear of being robbed of his money so his last act was a lonely death. He is obsessed with the delusion that everyone has taken the money from his corpse and is desperate to get it back.
en_grezzo: "The end of an adventurer who lived and died for money. He didn't trust anyone for fear of being robbed of his money so his last act was a lonely death. He is obsessed with the delusion that everyone has taken the money from his corpse and is desperate to get it back."
it: Quel che resta di un avventuriero che ha vissuto ed è morto per il denaro. Per paura che glielo portassero via non si fidava di nessuno, e la fine gli è venuta in solitudine. Ora è ossessionato dall'idea fissa che tutti gli abbiano rubato il denaro dal cadavere, e si affanna a riprenderselo.

jp: 遥か昔にネフィアの調査を行っていた魔術兵。仲間を逃がすために魔物と戦い死亡したが、アンデッドとして蘇った。自分が白骨化したことに気づいておらず、ずっと調査を続けている。
jp_grezzo: "遥か昔にネフィアの調査を行っていた魔術兵。仲間を逃がすために魔物と戦い死亡したが、アンデッドとして蘇った。自分が白骨化したことに気づいておらず、ずっと調査を続けている。"
en: A sorcerer who was conducting an investigation of Nefia long ago. He fought a demon to free his companions and died but was revived as an undead. He is unaware that he has become ossified and continues to do research.
en_grezzo: "A sorcerer who was conducting an investigation of Nefia long ago. He fought a demon to free his companions and died but was revived as an undead. He is unaware that he has become ossified and continues to do research."
it: Un soldato-mago che tantissimo tempo fa indagava su Nefia. Combatté contro un mostro per far scappare i compagni e ci morì, ma è risorto come non morto. Non si è accorto di essere ridotto a ossa, e l'indagine la porta avanti ancora.

jp: 大幅に性能強化された、深紅のリビングアーマー。主にふさわしい強者を求めて彷徨い続けている。いつか全身をルビナスに置換するのが夢らしい。
jp_grezzo: "大幅に性能強化された、深紅のリビングアーマー。主にふさわしい強者を求めて彷徨い続けている。いつか全身をルビナスに置換するのが夢らしい。"
en: Performance has been greatly enhanced crimson living armor. He continues to wander in search of a strong man worthy of the Lord. It seems to be a dream to replace his entire body with Rubinus one day.
en_grezzo: "Performance has been greatly enhanced crimson living armor. He continues to wander in search of a strong man worthy of the Lord. It seems to be a dream to replace his entire body with Rubinus one day."
it: Un'armatura vivente rosso sangue, con le prestazioni potenziate di parecchio. Continua a vagare in cerca di un forte degno di esserle padrone. Pare che il suo sogno sia sostituirsi un giorno tutto il corpo con il rubynus.

jp: 呪いの甲冑が人間に無理矢理憑りついた姿。肉体があるのでパワフルな動きが可能。中の人が色々とダメになると、次の装着者を探し始める。
jp_grezzo: "呪いの甲冑が人間に無理矢理憑りついた姿。肉体があるのでパワフルな動きが可能。中の人が色々とダメになると、次の装着者を探し始める。"
en: The cursed armor has forcefully possessed a human being. It has a body that allows it to move powerfully. When the person inside fails in many ways it starts looking for the next wearer.
en_grezzo: "The cursed armor has forcefully possessed a human being. It has a body that allows it to move powerfully. When the person inside fails in many ways it starts looking for the next wearer."
it: È un'armatura maledetta che si è impossessata a forza di un essere umano. Siccome ha un corpo, può muoversi con grande potenza. Quando la persona dentro comincia a cedere da tutte le parti, si mette a cercare chi la indosserà dopo.

jp: 異国の戦士である落ち武者の魂が、その装備に宿って生まれた。性質の悪い妖怪であり、あちこちを徘徊して刀を振り回す。全身の青い炎はまったく熱くない。
jp_grezzo: "異国の戦士である落ち武者の魂が、その装備に宿って生まれた。性質の悪い妖怪であり、あちこちを徘徊して刀を振り回す。全身の青い炎はまったく熱くない。"
en: The spirit of a fallen warrior a warrior of a foreign land was reborned into his equipment. It is a demon with a bad nature roaming around and wielding a sword. The blue flame on his entire body is not hot at all.
en_grezzo: "The spirit of a fallen warrior a warrior of a foreign land was reborned into his equipment. It is a demon with a bad nature roaming around and wielding a sword. The blue flame on his entire body is not hot at all."
it: È nata quando l'anima di un guerriero sconfitto, venuto da una terra straniera, è andata ad abitare nel suo equipaggiamento. È uno spiritello di pessima indole: gira di qua e di là menando fendenti. Le fiamme azzurre che ha su tutto il corpo non scottano affatto.

jp: 常闇の眼から得た知識を使って、念のためゼームが生み出した番兵。レシマス最深層からの呪術で、別階層の鎧が再構築されたもの。そんな経緯なので親であるゼームには会ったことがない。封印を破りに来た者を感知して排除するのが仕事。
jp_grezzo: "常闇の眼から得た知識を使って、念のためゼームが生み出した番兵。レシマス最深層からの呪術で、別階層の鎧が再構築されたもの。そんな経緯なので親であるゼームには会ったことがない。封印を破りに来た者を感知して排除するのが仕事。"
en: Using the knowledge gained from the Eye of Everlasting Darkness the watchman was created by Zeome just in case. A spell from the deepest layer of Lesimas with the armor built on another level. That's why he' s never met his parent Zeome. His job is to sense and eliminate those who have come to break the seal.
en_grezzo: "Using the knowledge gained from the Eye of Everlasting Darkness the watchman was created by Zeome just in case. A spell from the deepest layer of Lesimas with the armor built on another level. That's why he' s never met his parent Zeome. His job is to sense and eliminate those who have come to break the seal."
it: La sentinella che Zeome ha creato per prudenza, servendosi del sapere ricavato dall'occhio delle tenebre eterne. È un'armatura di un altro piano, ricomposta con una stregoneria che viene dal fondo di Lesimas. Per come è andata, Zeome, che le fa da genitore, non l'ha mai incontrata. Il suo mestiere è accorgersi di chi viene a spezzare il sigillo, ed eliminarlo.

jp: 魔鋼の番兵『ギルフェム』
自分を虐待していた両親を暗殺したことがきっかけで、この道に入った。奇怪な恰好でわざと目立ち、注意を惹いている間に仲間に攻撃させる。仮面を被るのは人を殺す際の表情を見られたくないため。プライベートでは外している。
jp_grezzo: "自分を虐待していた両親を暗殺したことがきっかけで、この道に入った。奇怪な恰好でわざと目立ち、注意を惹いている間に仲間に攻撃させる。仮面を被るのは人を殺す際の表情を見られたくないため。プライベートでは外している。"
en: She entered this path after the assassination of her own abusive parents. She deliberately stands out with her strange appearance allowing her companions to attack while she attracts attention. She wears a mask because she doesn't want people to see the look on her face when she kills someone. In private it is removed.
en_grezzo: "She entered this path after the assassination of her own abusive parents. She deliberately stands out with her strange appearance allowing her companions to attack while she attracts attention. She wears a mask because she doesn't want people to see the look on her face when she kills someone. In private it is removed."
it: Ha imboccato questa strada dopo aver assassinato i genitori che la maltrattavano. Si fa notare apposta con un abbigliamento bizzarro, e mentre attira l'attenzione lascia attaccare i compagni. La maschera la porta perché non vuole che le si veda la faccia mentre uccide. In privato la toglie.

jp: 古くからザナンで秘密裏に組織されていた部隊。サイモアが実権を握ってからは規模が大きくなったらしい。短剣で致命傷を与えられない相手に対しては、ブチ切れて鋭い眼光を浴びせる。
jp_grezzo: "古くからザナンで秘密裏に組織されていた部隊。サイモアが実権を握ってからは規模が大きくなったらしい。短剣で致命傷を与えられない相手に対しては、ブチ切れて鋭い眼光を浴びせる。"
en: A unit that has been secretly organized in Zanan since ancient times. Apparently it has grown in size since Saimore took over the reigns. When the dagger can't inflict a fatal wound on an opponent it breaks off and flashes a sharp light.
en_grezzo: "A unit that has been secretly organized in Zanan since ancient times. Apparently it has grown in size since Saimore took over the reigns. When the dagger can't inflict a fatal wound on an opponent it breaks off and flashes a sharp light."
it: Un reparto che a Zanan si organizzava in segreto fin dai tempi antichi. Pare che da quando Saimore ha preso il potere si sia molto ingrandito. Con chi non riesce a ferire a morte col pugnale, sbotta e lo trafigge con uno sguardo tagliente.

jp: もう一人のソピアー。娼婦として下界を彷徨ううちに何度も人間の子を身ごもったが、全て流産に終わった。白と黒の羽は男女の胎児の魂が集まり具現化したもの。精神は壊れており、父の情報を求めてあらゆる生命を取り込もうとする。
jp_grezzo: "もう一人のソピアー。娼婦として下界を彷徨ううちに何度も人間の子を身ごもったが、全て流産に終わった。白と黒の羽は男女の胎児の魂が集まり具現化したもの。精神は壊れており、父の情報を求めてあらゆる生命を取り込もうとする。"
en: Another Sophia. While wandering the lower world as a prostitute she was pregnant with human children many times but all of them ended in miscarriage. The white and black feathers are the embodiment of the souls of male and female fetuses. Her mind is broken and she tries to take in every life in search of information about her father.
en_grezzo: "Another Sophia. While wandering the lower world as a prostitute she was pregnant with human children many times but all of them ended in miscarriage. The white and black feathers are the embodiment of the souls of male and female fetuses. Her mind is broken and she tries to take in every life in search of information about her father."
it: L'altra Sophia. Vagando per il mondo di sotto come prostituta rimase incinta di figli umani più volte, ma tutte le gravidanze finirono in un aborto. Le ali bianche e nere sono le anime dei feti maschi e femmine, raccolte e fatte corpo. Ha la mente spezzata, e per cercare notizie del padre prova ad assorbire dentro di sé ogni forma di vita.

jp: あなたの血の繋がらない兄。ローランの雄はひどく病弱で大抵子供のうちに死ぬのだが、「弟妹たちを守る」という使命感のみで奇跡的に病魔に抗っている。本来なら今すぐ全身から血を吹きだして爆発四散するほどの重体。
jp_grezzo: "あなたの血の繋がらない兄。ローランの雄はひどく病弱で大抵子供のうちに死ぬのだが、「弟妹たちを守る」という使命感のみで奇跡的に病魔に抗っている。本来なら今すぐ全身から血を吹きだして爆発四散するほどの重体。"
en: A brother with whom you are not related. Roran's males are so sickly that they usually die as children but he miraculously resists the disease with only his sense of duty to protect his brothers and sisters. Normally he would be in such serious condition that he would have bled out his entire body and exploded into four pieces right now.
en_grezzo: "A brother with whom you are not related. Roran's males are so sickly that they usually die as children but he miraculously resists the disease with only his sense of duty to protect his brothers and sisters. Normally he would be in such serious condition that he would have bled out his entire body and exploded into four pieces right now."
it: Il tuo fratello maggiore, che non ha il tuo sangue. I maschi di Roran sono tanto malaticci che di solito muoiono da bambini, ma lui resiste per miracolo al morbo tenendosi in piedi solo sul senso del dovere di proteggere i fratelli minori. A rigore dovrebbe essere così grave da schizzare sangue da tutto il corpo ed esplodere in quattro pezzi all'istante.

jp: 弟狐のメイルーンでの姿。寒冷地に適応して耳や尻尾が小さくなり、表面積と体積の比が低くなっている。しかし小さくなっても狐耳が邪魔で防寒着のフードが被れない。クールな人に憧れて真似しているが根は寂しがり屋。
jp_grezzo: "弟狐のメイルーンでの姿。寒冷地に適応して耳や尻尾が小さくなり、表面積と体積の比が低くなっている。しかし小さくなっても狐耳が邪魔で防寒着のフードが被れない。クールな人に憧れて真似しているが根は寂しがり屋。"
en: The brother fox in Mayroon. They are adapted to cold climates with smaller ears and tails and a lower ratio of surface area to volume. However even though he is smaller his fox ears are in the way and he can't cover the hood of his winter clothing. He admires and imitates cool people but he is lonely at heart.
en_grezzo: "The brother fox in Mayroon. They are adapted to cold climates with smaller ears and tails and a lower ratio of surface area to volume. However even though he is smaller his fox ears are in the way and he can't cover the hood of his winter clothing. He admires and imitates cool people but he is lonely at heart."
it: Il fratello volpe come si presenta a Mayroon. Adattandosi al freddo ha orecchie e coda più piccole, e un rapporto più basso fra superficie e volume. Ma anche rimpicciolite, le orecchie da volpe danno fastidio e non gli lasciano mettere il cappuccio della giacca invernale. Ammira i tipi impassibili e li imita, ma in fondo soffre la solitudine.

jp: 人間が変身した泡はきドラゴンの出した泡に邪気が宿って生まれた、というややこしい生い立ちを持つ。ぽんぽん泡を吐きつつ、敵を格闘攻撃で粉砕する。パズルに対して複雑な感情を抱いている。
jp_grezzo: "人間が変身した泡はきドラゴンの出した泡に邪気が宿って生まれた、というややこしい生い立ちを持つ。ぽんぽん泡を吐きつつ、敵を格闘攻撃で粉砕する。パズルに対して複雑な感情を抱いている。"
en: His origins are complicated given that he was born with evil energy dwelling in the bubbles emitted by his foam-eating dragon form that was transformed by humans. While spitting bubbles he smashes his enemies with fighting techniques. I have mixed feelings about the puzzle.
en_grezzo: "His origins are complicated given that he was born with evil energy dwelling in the bubbles emitted by his foam-eating dragon form that was transformed by humans. While spitting bubbles he smashes his enemies with fighting techniques. I have mixed feelings about the puzzle."
it: Ha una nascita complicata: è nato quando il male è andato ad abitare in una bolla emessa dal drago sputabolle, che a sua volta era un uomo trasformato. Sputa bolle a raffica e intanto stritola i nemici a mani nude. Verso i giochi di puzzle nutre sentimenti complicati.

jp: 人並の知能を持つ。どこぞの異星主に大量に産み落とされた無形の怪物。親に捨てられて死にかけていたところをツァトゥグァに拾われ、恩義から長い間奉公していた。今は親に文句を言おうと手分けして探している。
jp_grezzo: "人並の知能を持つ。どこぞの異星主に大量に産み落とされた無形の怪物。親に捨てられて死にかけていたところをツァトゥグァに拾われ、恩義から長い間奉公していた。今は親に文句を言おうと手分けして探している。"
en: He has the intelligence of a human being. A formless monster that was spawned in large numbers by an alien overlord somewhere. He was abandoned by his parents and was dying when he was picked up by Tsathoggua and out of gratitude he served them for many years. Now he' s looking for a way to complain to his parents.
en_grezzo: "He has the intelligence of a human being. A formless monster that was spawned in large numbers by an alien overlord somewhere. He was abandoned by his parents and was dying when he was picked up by Tsathoggua and out of gratitude he served them for many years. Now he' s looking for a way to complain to his parents."
it: Ha un'intelligenza pari a quella di un uomo. È un mostro senza forma, messo al mondo in gran quantità da qualche Yith. Abbandonato dai genitori, stava per morire quando il Tsathoggua lo raccolse, e per riconoscenza restò a lungo al suo servizio. Adesso, per andare a lamentarsi con i genitori, li cerca insieme agli altri dividendosi il lavoro.

jp: 邪悪な魔法使いが自分の血液を混ぜて作った魔法生物。獲物を捕らえて血液を吸い尽くす。サラサラの血液よりも脂っこくてドロドロの血液のほうが好き。
jp_grezzo: "邪悪な魔法使いが自分の血液を混ぜて作った魔法生物。獲物を捕らえて血液を吸い尽くす。サラサラの血液よりも脂っこくてドロドロの血液のほうが好き。"
en: A magical creature created by an evil wizard by mixing his own blood. They capture their prey and suck the blood out of it. It prefers greasy and muddy blood to slippery blood.
en_grezzo: "A magical creature created by an evil wizard by mixing his own blood. They capture their prey and suck the blood out of it. It prefers greasy and muddy blood to slippery blood."
it: Una creatura magica che un mago malvagio ha fatto mescolandoci il proprio sangue. Cattura la preda e le succhia il sangue fino all'ultima goccia. Al sangue fluido preferisce quello grasso e denso.

jp: ロープのような細い触手をいくつも持っている。触手の表面はぬめぬめしており、これで獲物を絡めとる。全身をまさぐりつくし、獲物が無駄に抵抗して体力を消耗した後に絞め殺す。
jp_grezzo: "ロープのような細い触手をいくつも持っている。触手の表面はぬめぬめしており、これで獲物を絡めとる。全身をまさぐりつくし、獲物が無駄に抵抗して体力を消耗した後に絞め殺す。"
en: It has a number of rope-like thin tentacles. The surface of the tentacles is slimy and they entangle their prey with them. It strangles its prey after the prey has exhausted its strength by resisting in vain.
en_grezzo: "It has a number of rope-like thin tentacles. The surface of the tentacles is slimy and they entangle their prey with them. It strangles its prey after the prey has exhausted its strength by resisting in vain."
it: Ha parecchi tentacoli sottili come corde. La loro superficie è viscida, e con quella avviluppa la preda. La palpa da cima a fondo, e la strangola dopo che si è sfinita a resistere inutilmente.

jp: 体内に天然の核ジェネレーターを持つ巨大ゴリラ。生化学文明時代に生み出され封印されていた。あふれ出るエネルギーを発散するために破壊の限りを尽くす。
jp_grezzo: "体内に天然の核ジェネレーターを持つ巨大ゴリラ。生化学文明時代に生み出され封印されていた。あふれ出るエネルギーを発散するために破壊の限りを尽くす。"
en: A giant gorilla with a natural nuclear generator in its body. It was created and sealed in the biochemical civilization. They go to the limit of destruction to vent their overflowing energy.
en_grezzo: "A giant gorilla with a natural nuclear generator in its body. It was created and sealed in the biochemical civilization. They go to the limit of destruction to vent their overflowing energy."
it: Un gorilla gigantesco che ha in corpo un generatore nucleare naturale. Fu creato ai tempi della civiltà biochimica e poi sigillato. Distrugge tutto quello che può per sfogare l'energia che gli trabocca.

jp: 神の欠片を得て神化したインド象。現存するインド象たちは、軽傷の自然回復に数週間かかるほど脆弱で力もかたつむりより弱いので、こいつに匿われてやっと生きている。そんな有象無象を守る必要があるのか？とガネーシャは最近疑問に思い始めているらしい。
jp_grezzo: "神の欠片を得て神化したインド象。現存するインド象たちは、軽傷の自然回復に数週間かかるほど脆弱で力もかたつむりより弱いので、こいつに匿われてやっと生きている。そんな有象無象を守る必要があるのか？とガネーシャは最近疑問に思い始めているらしい。"
en: An Indian elephant that has obtained a piece of God and become a deity. The existing Indian elephants are so fragile and weak that it takes weeks to recover from a minor injury and they are weaker than the Snail so they are sheltered by this one. Do I really need to protect such an assortment of creatures? Ganesha has been wondering about this lately.
en_grezzo: "An Indian elephant that has obtained a piece of God and become a deity. The existing Indian elephants are so fragile and weak that it takes weeks to recover from a minor injury and they are weaker than the Snail so they are sheltered by this one. Do I really need to protect such an assortment of creatures? Ganesha has been wondering about this lately."
it: Un elefante indiano che, ottenuta una scheggia di divinità, si è fatto dio. Gli elefanti indiani rimasti sono così fragili che per rimettersi da una ferita leggera ci mettono settimane, e sono più deboli di una lumaca: se campano ancora è solo perché lui li tiene al riparo. Ma vale la pena proteggere quella marmaglia? Pare che il Ganesha, di recente, abbia cominciato a chiederselo.

jp: 硬い皮膚と鋭い角で戦う、重戦士な獣戦士。その巨体での突進は強烈。こいつの角を切り取って、ユニコーンの角として売る詐欺が一時期発生したが、大きさと形状が違いすぎてすぐにバレた。
jp_grezzo: "硬い皮膚と鋭い角で戦う、重戦士な獣戦士。その巨体での突進は強烈。こいつの角を切り取って、ユニコーンの角として売る詐欺が一時期発生したが、大きさと形状が違いすぎてすぐにバレた。"
en: A heavy beast warrior who fights with hard skin and sharp horns. The charge with its huge body is intense. There was a scam for a while where the horn was cut off and sold as a unicorn horn but it was soon discovered that the size and shape were too different.
en_grezzo: "A heavy beast warrior who fights with hard skin and sharp horns. The charge with its huge body is intense. There was a scam for a while where the horn was cut off and sold as a unicorn horn but it was soon discovered that the size and shape were too different."
it: Un guerriero bestia dalla corazza pesante, che combatte con la pelle dura e le corna aguzze. La carica di quel corpo enorme è tremenda. Per un po' andò di moda una truffa che gli tagliava il corno e lo vendeva per corno di unicorno, ma la scoprirono subito: misura e forma erano troppo diverse.

jp: 乗り物としてサイボーグ化されたカバ。セルロースを分解して電気に変えて動く。なかなかの速度と安定感を持つが、旧式だと制御が難しいことがある。
jp_grezzo: "乗り物としてサイボーグ化されたカバ。セルロースを分解して電気に変えて動く。なかなかの速度と安定感を持つが、旧式だと制御が難しいことがある。"
en: The hippo is cyborgized as a vehicle. It works by breaking down cellulose and turning it into electricity. It has a good speed and stability but it can be difficult to control if it's an older model.
en_grezzo: "The hippo is cyborgized as a vehicle. It works by breaking down cellulose and turning it into electricity. It has a good speed and stability but it can be difficult to control if it's an older model."
it: Un ippopotamo reso cyborg per servire da cavalcatura. Funziona scomponendo la cellulosa e trasformandola in elettricità. Ha una discreta velocità e una buona stabilità, ma i modelli vecchi possono essere difficili da governare.

jp: 危険を感じると鋭い爪を振り回すが、それはとても臆病なため。闇の組織のボスが愛玩用で欲しがっており、裏で捕獲依頼が出ている。挑戦した出稼ぎ労働者が翌日まっぷたつになって見つかるケースが多い。
jp_grezzo: "危険を感じると鋭い爪を振り回すが、それはとても臆病なため。闇の組織のボスが愛玩用で欲しがっており、裏で捕獲依頼が出ている。挑戦した出稼ぎ労働者が翌日まっぷたつになって見つかるケースが多い。"
en: When it senses danger it swings its sharp claws but it's very timid. The boss of the dark organization wants it as a lapdog and there is a request to capture it behind the scenes. There are many cases where the migrant workers who tried to work for the organization were found dead the next day.
en_grezzo: "When it senses danger it swings its sharp claws but it's very timid. The boss of the dark organization wants it as a lapdog and there is a request to capture it behind the scenes. There are many cases where the migrant workers who tried to work for the organization were found dead the next day."
it: Quando fiuta il pericolo mena gli artigli aguzzi, ma è perché è paurosissimo. Il capo di un'organizzazione oscura lo vuole come animale da compagnia, e c'è una richiesta di cattura che gira sottobanco. Capita spesso che i braccianti che ci provano si ritrovino, il giorno dopo, tagliati in due.

jp: 主人殺しのオオアリクイ
ジャガーを使役する、夜と煙と戦の神。昔は強者との戦いを楽しむためだけに大暴れしていたが、今は大戦での罪を自覚し裏方として真面目に働いている。手下のジャガーをエヘカトルに猫扱いされると途端に機嫌が悪くなる。
jp_grezzo: "ジャガーを使役する、夜と煙と戦の神。昔は強者との戦いを楽しむためだけに大暴れしていたが、今は大戦での罪を自覚し裏方として真面目に働いている。手下のジャガーをエヘカトルに猫扱いされると途端に機嫌が悪くなる。"
en: The God of Night Smoke and War who uses the Jaguar. He used to go on a rampage just for the fun of fighting the strong but now he is aware of his sins in the Great War and works diligently behind the scenes. When his minion Jaguar is treated as a cat by Ehekatl he immediately gets in a bad mood.
en_grezzo: "The God of Night Smoke and War who uses the Jaguar. He used to go on a rampage just for the fun of fighting the strong but now he is aware of his sins in the Great War and works diligently behind the scenes. When his minion Jaguar is treated as a cat by Ehekatl he immediately gets in a bad mood."
it: Il dio della notte, del fumo e della guerra, che si serve del giaguaro. Un tempo si scatenava solo per il gusto di battersi con i forti; adesso è consapevole delle sue colpe nella grande guerra e lavora sul serio dietro le quinte. Se Ehekatl tratta da gatto il giaguaro che ha ai suoi ordini, gli si guasta subito l'umore.

jp: ところどころに魚のようなヒレを持つワニ。その正体は初代エヘカトルとテスカトリポカが殺してしまった女神の末裔。罪滅ぼしとして代々面倒を見ることになっているが、最近は個体数が増えすぎて大変らしい。
jp_grezzo: "ところどころに魚のようなヒレを持つワニ。その正体は初代エヘカトルとテスカトリポカが殺してしまった女神の末裔。罪滅ぼしとして代々面倒を見ることになっているが、最近は個体数が増えすぎて大変らしい。"
en: This crocodile with fish-like fins throughout its body. Its identity is a descendant of the goddess that was once killed by Ehekatl and Tezcatlipoca. They are supposed to be taken care of them generation to generation as atonement for their sins but it seems that the number of them has increased too much recently.
en_grezzo: "This crocodile with fish-like fins throughout its body. Its identity is a descendant of the goddess that was once killed by Ehekatl and Tezcatlipoca. They are supposed to be taken care of them generation to generation as atonement for their sins but it seems that the number of them has increased too much recently."
it: Un coccodrillo che qua e là ha pinne da pesce. In verità è il discendente della dea che la prima Ehekatl e Tezcatlipoca uccisero. Per espiare, di generazione in generazione se ne devono prendere cura, ma di recente pare che gli esemplari siano cresciuti troppo e la cosa sia diventata dura.

jp: ジャガーを模した毛皮と爪で武装した兵士。テスカトリポカが配下の神の一柱をモデルにして大戦時に作り出したらしい。好戦的でプライドが強いため、オセロメーとはどっちが格上なのかでよくケンカになる。
jp_grezzo: "ジャガーを模した毛皮と爪で武装した兵士。テスカトリポカが配下の神の一柱をモデルにして大戦時に作り出したらしい。好戦的でプライドが強いため、オセロメーとはどっちが格上なのかでよくケンカになる。"
en: A soldier armed with fur and claws in the likeness of a jaguar. It was apparently created during the Great War by Tezcatlipoca using one of the gods under his control as a model. Due to his competitive nature and pride he often gets into fights with his rival over who is better.
en_grezzo: "A soldier armed with fur and claws in the likeness of a jaguar. It was apparently created during the Great War by Tezcatlipoca using one of the gods under his control as a model. Due to his competitive nature and pride he often gets into fights with his rival over who is better."
it: Un soldato armato di pelliccia e artigli fatti a somiglianza del giaguaro. Pare che Tezcatlipoca l'abbia creato durante la grande guerra prendendo a modello una delle divinità ai suoi ordini. È attaccabrighe e pieno d'orgoglio, e con l'ocelome finisce spesso a litigare su chi dei due valga di più.

jp: 相変異によって変身したバッタの皇子。身体が黒くなり各種能力が上昇。さらに、多少の傷を負っても光を吸収することで再生できる。集団で飛び回り、いろんなものを食い散らかす様はもはや悪夢。
jp_grezzo: "相変異によって変身したバッタの皇子。身体が黒くなり各種能力が上昇。さらに、多少の傷を負っても光を吸収することで再生できる。集団で飛び回り、いろんなものを食い散らかす様はもはや悪夢。"
en: A grasshopper prince transformed by a phase mutation. His body turns black and his abilities increase. What's more it can regenerate by absorbing light even if it is slightly damaged. They're a nightmare as they fly around in groups and eat everything.
en_grezzo: "A grasshopper prince transformed by a phase mutation. His body turns black and his abilities increase. What's more it can regenerate by absorbing light even if it is slightly damaged. They're a nightmare as they fly around in groups and eat everything."
it: Il principe delle locuste, trasformato per mutamento di fase. Il corpo gli è diventato nero e tutte le capacità gli sono cresciute. E per giunta, anche se si ferisce un poco, si rigenera assorbendo la luce. Vederlo volare in gruppo e divorare ogni cosa è ormai un incubo.

jp: レッドドラゴンの遺伝子を組み込まれた昆虫兵器。狂暴化しており、破壊できそうなものがあれば群れで捨て身の突撃をしてくる困ったやつ。身体はそんなに丈夫ではないので、さっさと撃ち落としてしまいたい。
jp_grezzo: "レッドドラゴンの遺伝子を組み込まれた昆虫兵器。狂暴化しており、破壊できそうなものがあれば群れで捨て身の突撃をしてくる困ったやつ。身体はそんなに丈夫ではないので、さっさと撃ち落としてしまいたい。"
en: An insect weapon with the Red Dragon's genes embedded in it. They have become frenzied and if there is anything that can be destroyed they will attack in packs with a desperate charge. Their bodies aren't that strong so shoot them down quickly.
en_grezzo: "An insect weapon with the Red Dragon's genes embedded in it. They have become frenzied and if there is anything that can be destroyed they will attack in packs with a desperate charge. Their bodies aren't that strong so shoot them down quickly."
it: Un'arma insetto in cui hanno innestato i geni del drago rosso. È imbestialita, e se vede qualcosa che potrebbe distruggere si lancia in branco in una carica suicida: una gran seccatura. Il corpo non è poi così robusto, quindi conviene abbatterla subito.

jp: 元はザナンの秘密研究所で改造手術を受けたでかいバッタ。兵器として洗脳される前に脱走し、大繁殖した。バッタの自由を守るため人類相手に戦いを挑んでいる。
jp_grezzo: "元はザナンの秘密研究所で改造手術を受けたでかいバッタ。兵器として洗脳される前に脱走し、大繁殖した。バッタの自由を守るため人類相手に戦いを挑んでいる。"
