en: Formerly a big grasshopper who underwent alteration surgery at Zanan's secret laboratory. They escaped before being brainwashed as a weapon and bred en masse. The grasshoppers are fighting against the humans to protect their freedom.
en_grezzo: "Formerly a big grasshopper who underwent alteration surgery at Zanan's secret laboratory. They escaped before being brainwashed as a weapon and bred en masse. The grasshoppers are fighting against the humans to protect their freedom."
it: Era una locusta enorme, operata e modificata nel laboratorio segreto di Zanan. È fuggita prima che le lavassero il cervello per farne un'arma, e si è riprodotta a dismisura. Per difendere la libertà delle locuste, sfida il genere umano.

jp: 蛾の一種だが、蛾らしくない透けた羽とエビフライのような胴体が特徴。可愛い可愛いともてはやされ、昆虫アイドル界の魔王として君臨している。ホバリングダンスが持ち芸。
jp_grezzo: "蛾の一種だが、蛾らしくない透けた羽とエビフライのような胴体が特徴。可愛い可愛いともてはやされ、昆虫アイドル界の魔王として君臨している。ホバリングダンスが持ち芸。"
en: A type of moth it is characterized by transparent wings and a body that looks like a shrimp fly. They are loved as cute and cuddly and reign as the demon king of the insect idol world. A hovering dance is their specialty.
en_grezzo: "A type of moth it is characterized by transparent wings and a body that looks like a shrimp fly. They are loved as cute and cuddly and reign as the demon king of the insect idol world. A hovering dance is their specialty."
it: È una specie di falena, ma si riconosce per le ali trasparenti, poco da falena, e per il corpo che pare un gambero fritto. La celebrano come carinissima e regna come sovrana dei demoni nel mondo degli idoli fra gli insetti. Il suo numero è la danza a mezz'aria.

jp: 人間に介護されなければまともに生きられない貧弱ドジっ子だったが、品種改良によって逆に人間を介護できるくらいには健康に。恩返しをしようと懸命に羽をパタパタさせて近寄ってくる。元々、自力で生きられない身体にしたのは人間なのだが知らぬが仏。
jp_grezzo: "人間に介護されなければまともに生きられない貧弱ドジっ子だったが、品種改良によって逆に人間を介護できるくらいには健康に。恩返しをしようと懸命に羽をパタパタさせて近寄ってくる。元々、自力で生きられない身体にしたのは人間なのだが知らぬが仏。"
en: They were weak and unfit to live without being cared for but through breeding they became healthy enough to take care of humans. They come closer fluttering their wings as hard as they can to return the favor. Originally it was human beings who made them unable to live on their own but they don't know this.
en_grezzo: "They were weak and unfit to live without being cared for but through breeding they became healthy enough to take care of humans. They come closer fluttering their wings as hard as they can to return the favor. Originally it was human beings who made them unable to live on their own but they don't know this."
it: Era una creatura gracile e imbranata che senza le cure degli umani non sapeva campare, ma la selezione della specie ha rovesciato la faccenda: adesso sta così bene in salute da poter assistere lei gli umani. Per sdebitarsi ti viene incontro sbattendo le ali con tutta la forza che ha. A ridurla a un corpo che da solo non stava in piedi erano stati proprio gli umani, ma lei non lo sa, e beata lei.

jp: 他力本願な芋虫。狙われないように伏せたままほとんど動かず、誰かが敵を倒してくれるのを待っている。敵が近づくと慌てて応戦する。他の昆虫兵器たちからの評判も悪く、ちゃんと働いてくれと怒られている。
jp_grezzo: "他力本願な芋虫。狙われないように伏せたままほとんど動かず、誰かが敵を倒してくれるのを待っている。敵が近づくと慌てて応戦する。他の昆虫兵器たちからの評判も悪く、ちゃんと働いてくれと怒られている。"
en: A self sufficient caterpillar. He stayed prone almost motionless to avoid being targeted and waits for someone to take down the enemy. When the enemy approaches it fights back in a flurry. The other insect weapons have a poor opinion of him and he is scolded for doing his job properly.
en_grezzo: "A self sufficient caterpillar. He stayed prone almost motionless to avoid being targeted and waits for someone to take down the enemy. When the enemy approaches it fights back in a flurry. The other insect weapons have a poor opinion of him and he is scolded for doing his job properly."
it: Un bruco che campa sul lavoro degli altri. Sta disteso e quasi immobile per non farsi prendere di mira, e aspetta che sia qualcun altro ad abbattere il nemico. Se il nemico gli arriva addosso, si mette a rispondere al fuoco tutto trafelato. Anche fra le altre armi-insetto ha pessima fama, e lo sgridano perché faccia la sua parte.

jp: 中身だけ抜き取られて放置された宝箱に、自我が芽生えた。空っぽな自分を埋めるために人を食らい続け、小さな村を２つ壊滅させた過去を持つ。ゼミ創始者に敗れて無理やりマスコットにされたが、今は結構満たされた日々を送っているらしい。
jp_grezzo: "中身だけ抜き取られて放置された宝箱に、自我が芽生えた。空っぽな自分を埋めるために人を食らい続け、小さな村を２つ壊滅させた過去を持つ。ゼミ創始者に敗れて無理やりマスコットにされたが、今は結構満たされた日々を送っているらしい。"
en: His soul was caught up by a treasure chest that had been plucked clean of its contents and abandoned. He has a history of devouring people to fill his empty self and destroying two small villages. He was defeated by the founder of the seminar and was made a mascot forcibly but now he seems to be living a pretty fulfilling life.
en_grezzo: "His soul was caught up by a treasure chest that had been plucked clean of its contents and abandoned. He has a history of devouring people to fill his empty self and destroying two small villages. He was defeated by the founder of the seminar and was made a mascot forcibly but now he seems to be living a pretty fulfilling life."
it: In uno scrigno a cui avevano portato via solo il contenuto, e che poi era stato abbandonato lì, germogliò una coscienza. Per riempire il proprio vuoto andò avanti a divorare gente, e ha alle spalle due piccoli villaggi rasi al suolo. Sconfitto dalla fondatrice del Seminario, fu fatto mascotte a forza, ma pare che oggi passi giornate abbastanza appagate.

jp: 冒険者生活が面白いと聞き自分もなってみたのはいいが、色々と複雑で混乱している。注意力が散漫で、体調の悪さに気が付かなかったり説明を読み飛ばしたり注釈を見落としたり固有名詞を間違えて覚えたりする。
jp_grezzo: "冒険者生活が面白いと聞き自分もなってみたのはいいが、色々と複雑で混乱している。注意力が散漫で、体調の悪さに気が付かなかったり説明を読み飛ばしたり注釈を見落としたり固有名詞を間違えて覚えたりする。"
en: They heard that the adventurer life is interesting so they tried it but it's complicated and confusing. they have a distracted attention span failing to notice how unwell they are skimming descriptions missing annotations and memorizing proper nouns incorrectly.
en_grezzo: "They heard that the adventurer life is interesting so they tried it but it's complicated and confusing. they have a distracted attention span failing to notice how unwell they are skimming descriptions missing annotations and memorizing proper nouns incorrectly."
it: Ha sentito dire che la vita dell'avventuriero è divertente e ha voluto provarci anche lui, il che va benissimo, se non fosse che è tutto complicato e lui ci si perde. Ha l'attenzione che gli va dove vuole: non si accorge di stare male, salta le spiegazioni, si lascia sfuggire le note e i nomi propri se li impara sbagliati.

jp: 赤い剣を携えたアルバイト。ちゃんと研修やマニュアルがあるらしい。報酬は歩合制。この先生に指導を受けた者たちの中には、後でバイトと知ってびっくりする者も多い。
jp_grezzo: "赤い剣を携えたアルバイト。ちゃんと研修やマニュアルがあるらしい。報酬は歩合制。この先生に指導を受けた者たちの中には、後でバイトと知ってびっくりする者も多い。"
en: A part-time job with a red sword. Apparently there's proper training and manuals. Compensation is commission-based. Many of those who were instructed by this teacher were surprised to learn later that they were part-time workers.
en_grezzo: "A part-time job with a red sword. Apparently there's proper training and manuals. Compensation is commission-based. Many of those who were instructed by this teacher were surprised to learn later that they were part-time workers."
it: Un lavoratore a ore, con la spada rossa in dotazione. Pare che ci siano davvero un periodo di addestramento e un manuale. Il compenso è a provvigione. Fra quelli che hanno ricevuto la lezione da questo maestro, in molti restano di sasso quando poi scoprono che era un ragazzo a ore.
l'aiutante a ore del maestro Spada Rossa

jp: 昔、赤剣先生のバイトをしていた経験があり、そこから興味を持ってゼミ講師になった。他の講師と互いにあだ名で呼び合うことを提唱し、結構馴染んでいる。密かに同じ講師のアジタリオのことが気になっている。
jp_grezzo: "昔、赤剣先生のバイトをしていた経験があり、そこから興味を持ってゼミ講師になった。他の講師と互いにあだ名で呼び合うことを提唱し、結構馴染んでいる。密かに同じ講師のアジタリオのことが気になっている。"
en: She used to work as a part-time teacher for Red Sword Sensei and that's when she became interested in becoming a seminar teacher. She advocates calling each other by nicknames with other instructors and they are quite familiar with each other. She is secretly concerned about a fellow lecturer Ajetalio.
en_grezzo: "She used to work as a part-time teacher for Red Sword Sensei and that's when she became interested in becoming a seminar teacher. She advocates calling each other by nicknames with other instructors and they are quite familiar with each other. She is secretly concerned about a fellow lecturer Ajetalio."
it: Un tempo ha fatto l'aiutante a ore del maestro Spada Rossa, e da lì le è venuta la voglia di insegnare al Seminario. È stata lei a proporre che i docenti si chiamassero per soprannome, e la cosa ha attecchito parecchio. Di nascosto le interessa Ajetalio, che insegna lì come lei.

jp: 現役時代から、戦士たちの質の低下を憂いていた。娘が一人前になったのをきっかけに実家の道場を継がせて、自分は根本的なところから指導を行うべくゼミ講師となった。
jp_grezzo: "現役時代から、戦士たちの質の低下を憂いていた。娘が一人前になったのをきっかけに実家の道場を継がせて、自分は根本的なところから指導を行うべくゼミ講師となった。"
en: Even while on active duty he was concerned about the declining quality of warriors. When his daughter became a full-fledged member of the family he let her take over his family's dojo and I became a seminar instructor to teach her from a fundamental point of view.
en_grezzo: "Even while on active duty he was concerned about the declining quality of warriors. When his daughter became a full-fledged member of the family he let her take over his family's dojo and I became a seminar instructor to teach her from a fundamental point of view."
it: Già ai tempi in cui era in attività si rammaricava di come calasse la qualità dei guerrieri. Quando la figlia si è fatta adulta le ha lasciato il dojo di famiglia, e lui si è messo a insegnare al Seminario per prendere la faccenda dalle fondamenta.

jp: 昔はザナン軍で広報担当をしていたが、自分に合わないと思いゼミ講師に転職。アイテムマニアで、自宅には様々なコレクションがあるとの噂。ただの散歩のつもりが、アイテム収集に発展することが多々ある。
jp_grezzo: "昔はザナン軍で広報担当をしていたが、自分に合わないと思いゼミ講師に転職。アイテムマニアで、自宅には様々なコレクションがあるとの噂。ただの散歩のつもりが、アイテム収集に発展することが多々ある。"
en: He used to work as a communications officer for the Zanan Army but decided it wasn't the right fit for him so he became a seminar instructor. He is an item enthusiast and is rumored to have a variety of collections at home. What was meant to be just a walk often turned into a collection of items.
en_grezzo: "He used to work as a communications officer for the Zanan Army but decided it wasn't the right fit for him so he became a seminar instructor. He is an item enthusiast and is rumored to have a variety of collections at home. What was meant to be just a walk often turned into a collection of items."
it: Prima si occupava di comunicazione nell'esercito di Zanan, poi ha deciso che non faceva per lei ed è passata a insegnare al Seminario. È una maniaca di oggetti, e si dice che in casa abbia collezioni d'ogni genere. Capita spesso che quella che doveva essere una passeggiata e basta finisca in una raccolta di oggetti.

jp: ゼミ講師の『クレッシェ』
かつて冒険ゼミにお世話になった、いわば元卒業者。同じ講師のミトに不信感を持っており、いつ騙されて身ぐるみ剥がされるかわからない、と戦々恐々する毎日。一応、付けられたあだ名は気に入っている。
jp_grezzo: "かつて冒険ゼミにお世話になった、いわば元卒業者。同じ講師のミトに不信感を持っており、いつ騙されて身ぐるみ剥がされるかわからない、と戦々恐々する毎日。一応、付けられたあだ名は気に入っている。"
en: He is a former graduate of the Adventure Seminar so to speak. He has a distrust of a fellow lecturer Mito and every day he is torn between fear and fear that he will be duped and stripped to the ground at any moment. He likes the nicknames he's been given.
en_grezzo: "He is a former graduate of the Adventure Seminar so to speak. He has a distrust of a fellow lecturer Mito and every day he is torn between fear and fear that he will be duped and stripped to the ground at any moment. He likes the nicknames he's been given."
it: A suo tempo il Seminario d'Avventura lo ha avuto come allievo: insomma, è un ex diplomato. Non si fida di Mito, che insegna lì come lui, e passa le giornate col batticuore, aspettandosi da un momento all'altro di essere raggirato e ripulito di tutto. Il soprannome che gli hanno messo, a dire il vero, gli piace.

jp: ゼミ講師の『アジタリオ』
成長したカオス・スピリットが合体して半獣半蛇の魔物となった。製造プラントとしての役割を持ち、各部の球体は熟すと地面に落ちて無数のカオス・シードを生成する。嫌いなものはユニコーン。
jp_grezzo: "成長したカオス・スピリットが合体して半獣半蛇の魔物となった。製造プラントとしての役割を持ち、各部の球体は熟すと地面に落ちて無数のカオス・シードを生成する。嫌いなものはユニコーン。"
en: The chaos spirit that had grown up merged into a half-beast half-snake demon. Serving as a production base the spheres in each part fall to the ground as they ripen producing countless chaos seeds. What they hate are unicorns.
en_grezzo: "The chaos spirit that had grown up merged into a half-beast half-snake demon. Serving as a production base the spheres in each part fall to the ground as they ripen producing countless chaos seeds. What they hate are unicorns."
it: Nasce dagli spiriti del caos che, una volta cresciuti, si fondono in un mostro metà bestia e metà serpente. Ha il compito di fare da impianto di produzione: le sfere che porta sulle varie parti del corpo, quando maturano, cadono a terra e generano semi del caos a non finire. Quello che proprio non sopporta sono gli unicorni.

jp: 邪悪な神が、封印される間際に世界中にばら撒いた悪意の種。人間をマナごと取り込んで人型に成長していく。根絶やしにしようと神々が頑張っているが、潜伏するうえに増殖力が高いのでなかなか数が減らない。
jp_grezzo: "邪悪な神が、封印される間際に世界中にばら撒いた悪意の種。人間をマナごと取り込んで人型に成長していく。根絶やしにしようと神々が頑張っているが、潜伏するうえに増殖力が高いのでなかなか数が減らない。"
en: The seeds of malice that an evil god scattered throughout the world on the verge of being sealed. It takes in humans with mana and grows into a humanoid. The gods are working hard to eradicate them but their numbers don't decrease easily because they have a high ability to multiply in addition to hiding.
en_grezzo: "The seeds of malice that an evil god scattered throughout the world on the verge of being sealed. It takes in humans with mana and grows into a humanoid. The gods are working hard to eradicate them but their numbers don't decrease easily because they have a high ability to multiply in addition to hiding."
it: I semi di malanimo che un dio malvagio sparse per il mondo un attimo prima di essere sigillato. Si prende gli umani, mana compreso, e cresce fino alla forma umana. Gli dei si danno da fare per estirparli, ma stanno acquattati e si moltiplicano in fretta, così il loro numero non cala tanto facilmente.

jp: 世界一のプラチナ鉱山の持ち主。自分の鉱山から出たものが原型をとどめないほどに加工され、よく知らない人たちの手に渡り、使われるということに興奮する変人。自宅に趣味で大量のガチョウを飼っている。
jp_grezzo: "世界一のプラチナ鉱山の持ち主。自分の鉱山から出たものが原型をとどめないほどに加工され、よく知らない人たちの手に渡り、使われるということに興奮する変人。自宅に趣味で大量のガチョウを飼っている。"
en: The owner of the world's largest platinum mine. An eccentric who gets excited about the fact that something from his own mine has been processed to such an extent that it no longer resembles its original form and is now in the hands of people he doesn't know well. He keeps a large number of geese at home as a hobby.
en_grezzo: "The owner of the world's largest platinum mine. An eccentric who gets excited about the fact that something from his own mine has been processed to such an extent that it no longer resembles its original form and is now in the hands of people he doesn't know well. He keeps a large number of geese at home as a hobby."
it: Il padrone della più grande miniera di platino del mondo. Un tipo strambo che si entusiasma all'idea che quel che esce dalla sua miniera venga lavorato fino a non somigliare più a niente, passi in mano a gente che lui non conosce e finisca in uso da qualche parte. In casa alleva per passatempo una quantità di oche.

jp: 有閑鉱山王『ジシリオン』
多くの死者を出した戦場などに生えた木が、死者の肉体、マナ、魂を余すところなく吸収した結果、強大な妖異と化した。怨念の集合体にして呪われた存在。
jp_grezzo: "多くの死者を出した戦場などに生えた木が、死者の肉体、マナ、魂を余すところなく吸収した結果、強大な妖異と化した。怨念の集合体にして呪われた存在。"
en: The trees that grew on the battlefields where many died absorbing the bodies mana and souls of the dead in their entirety became powerful demons. A cursed being made into a collection of grudges.
en_grezzo: "The trees that grew on the battlefields where many died absorbing the bodies mana and souls of the dead in their entirety became powerful demons. A cursed being made into a collection of grudges."
it: Gli alberi cresciuti sui campi di battaglia dove i morti si contavano a mucchi hanno assorbito dei caduti il corpo, il mana e l'anima senza lasciarne niente, e a furia di assorbire sono diventati una creatura mostruosa e potentissima. Un ammasso di rancore, e un essere maledetto.

jp: ドラゴンの格好よさに憧れた霊樹が、長年かけて自らの身体を変化させたもの。体表の緑色のコケに魔力を蓄えており、飛行も可能。長時間飛行する際は根の部分で土を掴んで持っていく。
jp_grezzo: "ドラゴンの格好よさに憧れた霊樹が、長年かけて自らの身体を変化させたもの。体表の緑色のコケに魔力を蓄えており、飛行も可能。長時間飛行する際は根の部分で土を掴んで持っていく。"
en: Having who longed for the good looks of a dragon it transformed its own body over the years. The green moss on its body surface stores magical power and it can also fly. When flying for long periods of time it holds on to soil by the roots and carries it along.
en_grezzo: "Having who longed for the good looks of a dragon it transformed its own body over the years. The green moss on its body surface stores magical power and it can also fly. When flying for long periods of time it holds on to soil by the roots and carries it along."
it: Un albero sacro che, ammirato da quanto sono belli i draghi, si è trasformato il corpo nel giro di lunghissimi anni. Nel muschio verde che ha in superficie accumula potere magico, e sa anche volare. Quando il volo si fa lungo, afferra un po' di terra con le radici e se la porta dietro.

jp: 争いの果てに木に変えられてしまった女神が、気の遠くなるほどの年月を経てどうにかほぼ人型にまで戻ってきた姿。もはや信仰心を集めるほどの力はなく、光合成しながら世間に八つ当たりする毎日。
jp_grezzo: "争いの果てに木に変えられてしまった女神が、気の遠くなるほどの年月を経てどうにかほぼ人型にまで戻ってきた姿。もはや信仰心を集めるほどの力はなく、光合成しながら世間に八つ当たりする毎日。"
en: A goddess who was transformed into a tree after a conflict but somehow managed to return to almost humanoid form after an unbearable number of years. She is no longer powerful enough to gather religious beliefs and every day she takes it out on the world while photosynthesizing.
en_grezzo: "A goddess who was transformed into a tree after a conflict but somehow managed to return to almost humanoid form after an unbearable number of years. She is no longer powerful enough to gather religious beliefs and every day she takes it out on the world while photosynthesizing."
it: Una dea che alla fine di una contesa fu ridotta ad albero, e che dopo un numero di anni da far girare la testa è in qualche modo tornata quasi alla forma umana. Non ha più la forza di raccogliere fede intorno a sé, e passa le giornate a prendersela col mondo mentre fa la fotosintesi.

jp: ハンノキの王。性格は邪悪そのものであり、人間を惑わして破滅へと導く。具体的には、馬で運ばれている最中の病気の子供に魔王として語りかけ、恐ろしい幻影を見せてショック死させるとか。
jp_grezzo: "ハンノキの王。性格は邪悪そのものであり、人間を惑わして破滅へと導く。具体的には、馬で運ばれている最中の病気の子供に魔王として語りかけ、恐ろしい幻影を見せてショック死させるとか。"
en: King of the ents. His personality is evil itself and he misleads and guides humans to their destruction. Specifically he talks to a sick child who is being carried on a horse as a demon king and gives him a terrifying vision and shocks him to death.
en_grezzo: "King of the ents. His personality is evil itself and he misleads and guides humans to their destruction. Specifically he talks to a sick child who is being carried on a horse as a demon king and gives him a terrifying vision and shocks him to death."
it: Il re degli ontani. Il carattere è la malvagità in persona: confonde gli uomini e li porta alla rovina. In concreto, per dire, parla come un re dei demoni al bambino malato che stanno portando via a cavallo, gli mostra visioni da far paura e lo fa morire di spavento.

jp: うねった複数の幹を持つ。幹を伸ばして歩き、その進路上にいるものを生きたまま取り込んで成長する。別名絞め殺しの木。幹がうねっているのは、取り込まれたものが最期に暴れるからだという。
jp_grezzo: "うねった複数の幹を持つ。幹を伸ばして歩き、その進路上にいるものを生きたまま取り込んで成長する。別名絞め殺しの木。幹がうねっているのは、取り込まれたものが最期に暴れるからだという。"
en: It has multiple trunks that are undulating. It walks with an outstretched trunk and grows by taking in the living in its path. Also known as the tree of strangulation. It is said that the reason the trunk is undulating is because the thing that has been taken in is violently struggling until the very end.
en_grezzo: "It has multiple trunks that are undulating. It walks with an outstretched trunk and grows by taking in the living in its path. Also known as the tree of strangulation. It is said that the reason the trunk is undulating is because the thing that has been taken in is violently struggling until the very end."
it: Ha più tronchi, tutti contorti. Cammina allungando i tronchi, e cresce inghiottendo vivo quello che gli capita sul percorso. Lo chiamano anche l'albero che strangola. Si dice che i tronchi siano contorti perché quel che ha inghiottito si dibatte fino all'ultimo.

jp: 人間に擬態した妖木。長髪で誤魔化しているが、化け切れておらず背中が完全に木。抱き寄せた時に背中が尋常じゃなくごつごつしていたり、木の枝が背中からはみ出している自称森ガールがいたら大体こいつ。
jp_grezzo: "人間に擬態した妖木。長髪で誤魔化しているが、化け切れておらず背中が完全に木。抱き寄せた時に背中が尋常じゃなくごつごつしていたり、木の枝が背中からはみ出している自称森ガールがいたら大体こいつ。"
en: A tree mimicking a human. Don't be misguided by her long hair she is not disfigured but her back is completely wooden. If there's a self-proclaimed forest girl whose back is unusually rough and branches are protruding from her back when she hugs you she' s usually this thing.
en_grezzo: "A tree mimicking a human. Don't be misguided by her long hair she is not disfigured but her back is completely wooden. If there's a self-proclaimed forest girl whose back is unusually rough and branches are protruding from her back when she hugs you she' s usually this thing."
it: Un albero-spettro che si finge donna. Si copre con i capelli lunghi, ma la trasformazione non le è riuscita fino in fondo e la schiena è rimasta tutta di legno. Se abbracciandola le senti la schiena ruvida in modo sospetto, o se ti capita una sedicente ragazza dei boschi a cui spuntano rami dalla schiena, quella nove volte su dieci è lei.

jp: 戦争に巻き込まれて妻を失ったため、戦争を根絶する手段を求め故郷を出奔。娘を連れて各地を放浪している最中、ヴァリウスと出会いその思想に共感した。娘と歩いていて兄妹に間違えられるのがちょっと嬉しい。
jp_grezzo: "戦争に巻き込まれて妻を失ったため、戦争を根絶する手段を求め故郷を出奔。娘を連れて各地を放浪している最中、ヴァリウスと出会いその思想に共感した。娘と歩いていて兄妹に間違えられるのがちょっと嬉しい。"
en: After losing his wife in the war he fled his hometown in search of a way to end the conflict. While wandering around the country with his daughter he met Vallius and sympathized with his ideas. I'm a little glad I'm walking with my daughter and being mistaken for a brother.
en_grezzo: "After losing his wife in the war he fled his hometown in search of a way to end the conflict. While wandering around the country with his daughter he met Vallius and sympathized with his ideas. I'm a little glad I'm walking with my daughter and being mistaken for a brother."
it: Perse la moglie travolto dalla guerra, e per questo lasciò il paese natale in cerca di un modo per sradicarla. Mentre girava di terra in terra con la figlia incontrò Barius, e ne condivise il pensiero. Quando cammina con la figlia e li scambiano per fratello e sorella, un po' gli fa piacere.

jp: ロスリアの蒼風『アルフレド』
jp_grezzo: "ロスリアの蒼風『アルフレド』"

jp: 機械文明の最終戦争で使われた戦車。猫を思わせる程に運動性が高く、戦闘機や人型兵器を震え上がらせた。後継機は更なる超運動性を目指したが、敵への印象操作のためあえてマンモスと名付けられた。
jp_grezzo: "機械文明の最終戦争で使われた戦車。猫を思わせる程に運動性が高く、戦闘機や人型兵器を震え上がらせた。後継機は更なる超運動性を目指したが、敵への印象操作のためあえてマンモスと名付けられた。"
en: A tank used in the final war of a mechanical civilization. It was so agile that it reminded me of a cat and it made fighters and humanoid weapons tremble. Its successor aimed to be even more mobile but was purposely named Mammoth in order to fool the enemy.
en_grezzo: "A tank used in the final war of a mechanical civilization. It was so agile that it reminded me of a cat and it made fighters and humanoid weapons tremble. Its successor aimed to be even more mobile but was purposely named Mammoth in order to fool the enemy."
it: Un carro armato usato nella guerra finale della civiltà meccanica. Aveva una mobilità così alta da far pensare a un gatto, e faceva tremare i caccia e le armi dalla forma umana. Il modello che venne dopo puntava a una mobilità ancora più spinta, ma lo chiamarono apposta Mammut per far credere al nemico il contrario.

jp: 当初はペットロボットとして造られたが、やがて大型化され戦闘機獣として用いられるようになった。他の星から輸入された機械犬とこの星の機械犬の雑種がルーツ。激しく動くので性能を引き出すのは大変。
jp_grezzo: "当初はペットロボットとして造られたが、やがて大型化され戦闘機獣として用いられるようになった。他の星から輸入された機械犬とこの星の機械犬の雑種がルーツ。激しく動くので性能を引き出すのは大変。"
en: Initially built as a pet robot it was eventually enlarged to be used as a fighter beast. Rooted in machine dogs imported from other planets and a hybrid of machine dogs from this planet. It's hard to get the best performance out of it because it moves so violently.
en_grezzo: "Initially built as a pet robot it was eventually enlarged to be used as a fighter beast. Rooted in machine dogs imported from other planets and a hybrid of machine dogs from this planet. It's hard to get the best performance out of it because it moves so violently."
it: All'inizio fu costruito come robot da compagnia, poi lo ingrandirono e lo impiegarono come bestia da combattimento. Alla radice c'è l'incrocio fra i cani meccanici importati da altri pianeti e quelli di questo. Si muove in modo scomposto, e tirargli fuori tutto quello che sa fare è un'impresa.

jp: パワー・スピード・テクニックに優れ、自律行動で破壊と創造を繰り返す古代のモンスターマシン。当時の戦闘車両を真っ向から撃破したという記録も残っている。環境適応機能を持ち、劣悪な現場でもへっちゃら。
jp_grezzo: "パワー・スピード・テクニックに優れ、自律行動で破壊と創造を繰り返す古代のモンスターマシン。当時の戦闘車両を真っ向から撃破したという記録も残っている。環境適応機能を持ち、劣悪な現場でもへっちゃら。"
en: An ancient monster machine with superior power speed and technique it acts autonomously to destroy and reproduce repeatedly. It is also recorded that it defeated the fighting vehicles of the time head-on. It has an environment-adaptive function and can be used even in poor conditions.
en_grezzo: "An ancient monster machine with superior power speed and technique it acts autonomously to destroy and reproduce repeatedly. It is also recorded that it defeated the fighting vehicles of the time head-on. It has an environment-adaptive function and can be used even in poor conditions."
it: Un antico mostro-macchina che eccelle in potenza, velocità e tecnica, e che di sua iniziativa non fa che distruggere e ricostruire. Resta agli atti che sconfisse a viso aperto i veicoli da combattimento dell'epoca. Ha una funzione di adattamento all'ambiente, e anche nel peggiore dei cantieri non si scompone.

jp: 機械文明中期の量産型歩行マシン。頭部に人が乗り込める。機械信仰の素晴らしさを広めるプロパガンダに使われていたが、地味に軍用機並の頑丈さとアームの強さを誇る。
jp_grezzo: "機械文明中期の量産型歩行マシン。頭部に人が乗り込める。機械信仰の素晴らしさを広めるプロパガンダに使われていたが、地味に軍用機並の頑丈さとアームの強さを誇る。"
en: A mass-produced walking machine in the heights of a mechanical civilization. A person can get in the head. It was used for propaganda to spread the splendor of the machine but it also boasted the sturdiness and limb strength of a military-grade aircraft.
en_grezzo: "A mass-produced walking machine in the heights of a mechanical civilization. A person can get in the head. It was used for propaganda to spread the splendor of the machine but it also boasted the sturdiness and limb strength of a military-grade aircraft."
it: Macchina camminante di serie, della metà della civiltà meccanica. Nella testa ci sale una persona. La usavano per la propaganda che diffondeva le meraviglie del culto della macchina, ma vanta in sordina una robustezza da mezzo militare e braccia che non scherzano.

jp: 機械文明初期に使われていた主力兵器。装甲は薄いが軽量で小回りが利き、悪路にも強い。他の戦闘兵器が発達した後でも、かなりの数が自律回路を更新して長く運用されていたらしい。
jp_grezzo: "機械文明初期に使われていた主力兵器。装甲は薄いが軽量で小回りが利き、悪路にも強い。他の戦闘兵器が発達した後でも、かなりの数が自律回路を更新して長く運用されていたらしい。"
en: The main weapon used in the early days of mechanical civilization. Due to its thin armor it is lightweight and can be used for small turns and is reliable on rough roads. Apparently quite a few had been operating long after other combat weapons had been developed with updated autonomous circuits.
en_grezzo: "The main weapon used in the early days of mechanical civilization. Due to its thin armor it is lightweight and can be used for small turns and is reliable on rough roads. Apparently quite a few had been operating long after other combat weapons had been developed with updated autonomous circuits."
it: L'arma principale dei primi tempi della civiltà meccanica. La corazza è sottile, ma in cambio è leggero, gira stretto e se la cava anche sulle strade rotte. Pare che, anche molto dopo che le altre armi da combattimento si erano evolute, parecchi esemplari abbiano aggiornato i circuiti autonomi e siano rimasti in servizio a lungo.

jp: カブの仲間だが、大型でかなりの速度を出せる。カブと比べると寿命が短く、気難しくて荒っぽい。比較的手がかかるが、カブに慣れていてスピードを求めているのなら飼ってみてもいいだろう。
jp_grezzo: "カブの仲間だが、大型でかなりの速度を出せる。カブと比べると寿命が短く、気難しくて荒っぽい。比較的手がかかるが、カブに慣れていてスピードを求めているのなら飼ってみてもいいだろう。"
en: It's a member of the cubs but it's large and capable of considerable speed. It has a shorter lifespan than a cub and is grumpy and rough. It's a relative pain in the ass but if you're used to cubs and are looking for speed it's a good idea to keep one.
en_grezzo: "It's a member of the cubs but it's large and capable of considerable speed. It has a shorter lifespan than a cub and is grumpy and rough. It's a relative pain in the ass but if you're used to cubs and are looking for speed it's a good idea to keep one."
it: È della famiglia del Cub, ma è grossa e sa tirare fuori una bella velocità. Rispetto al Cub ha vita più breve, ed è permalosa e ruvida. Dà il suo daffare, ma se sei abituato al Cub e quello che cerchi è la velocità, tenerne una può valere la pena.

jp: 良くも悪くもまっすぐなエレアの青年。正義感の強かった亡き父に憧れ、森の自警団に所属していた。かつて各国の軍が森へ侵攻してきた際には、即席の妨害部隊を結成し最後まで地味に抵抗を続けていたらしい。
jp_grezzo: "良くも悪くもまっすぐなエレアの青年。正義感の強かった亡き父に憧れ、森の自警団に所属していた。かつて各国の軍が森へ侵攻してきた際には、即席の妨害部隊を結成し最後まで地味に抵抗を続けていたらしい。"
en: For better or worse this young man is a straightforward Elean. Admiring his late father who had a strong sense of justice he was a member of the forest vigilante group. In the past when armies from various countries invaded the forest they formed an impromptu interdiction squad and steadfastly resisted until the end.
en_grezzo: "For better or worse this young man is a straightforward Elean. Admiring his late father who had a strong sense of justice he was a member of the forest vigilante group. In the past when armies from various countries invaded the forest they formed an impromptu interdiction squad and steadfastly resisted until the end."
it: Un giovane Elea tutto d'un pezzo, nel bene e nel male. Ammirava il padre morto, che aveva un forte senso della giustizia, e stava nella ronda del bosco. Quando in passato gli eserciti di più paesi entrarono nel bosco, pare che abbia messo insieme su due piedi un reparto di disturbo e abbia continuato a resistere in sordina fino all'ultimo.

jp: 生化学文明期に使われていた最上級アンデッド兵器。現存しないものと思われていたが、最近エウダーナの古代遺跡から他の兵器を伴い現れた。ある女性が制御に成功するまで破壊の限りを尽くしたという。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明期に使われていた最上級アンデッド兵器。現存しないものと思われていたが、最近エウダーナの古代遺跡から他の兵器を伴い現れた。ある女性が制御に成功するまで破壊の限りを尽くしたという。"
en: A superlative undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. It was thought to be extinct but it recently emerged from the ancient ruins of Eulderna accompanied by other weapons. It is said that one woman went to great lengths to destroy it until she managed to get it under control.
en_grezzo: "A superlative undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. It was thought to be extinct but it recently emerged from the ancient ruins of Eulderna accompanied by other weapons. It is said that one woman went to great lengths to destroy it until she managed to get it under control."
it: L'arma non morta di grado più alto in uso ai tempi della civiltà biochimica. Si credeva che non ne esistessero più, ma di recente ne è comparsa una dalle rovine antiche di Eulderna, insieme ad altre armi. Si dice che abbia distrutto tutto quello che poteva finché una donna non è riuscita a tenerla a freno.

jp: ユナイデッド・キング
生化学文明期に使われていた上級アンデッド兵器。単純戦闘力を重視したキングタイプと違い、後方支援を重視して造られた。知能がなかなか高く、サヴァントクイーンをライバル視して張り合う。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明期に使われていた上級アンデッド兵器。単純戦闘力を重視したキングタイプと違い、後方支援を重視して造られた。知能がなかなか高く、サヴァントクイーンをライバル視して張り合う。"
en: An advanced undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. Unlike the King type which emphasized simple combat power the Queen type was built with an emphasis on logistical support. Her intelligence is quite high and she rivals the Savant Queen.
en_grezzo: "An advanced undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. Unlike the King type which emphasized simple combat power the Queen type was built with an emphasis on logistical support. Her intelligence is quite high and she rivals the Savant Queen."
it: Arma non morta di grado alto, in uso ai tempi della civiltà biochimica. A differenza del tipo re, tutto puntato sulla forza di combattimento pura, questa fu costruita puntando sul sostegno alle retrovie. È parecchio intelligente, e nella regina savant vede una rivale con cui misurarsi.

jp: ユナイデッド・クイーン
生化学文明期に使われていた上級アンデッド兵器。人骨部分は近接武装をしているが、竜骨の背中にくっついている関係上格闘戦は苦手。どちらかというと制御ユニットとしての役割が大きいらしい。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明期に使われていた上級アンデッド兵器。人骨部分は近接武装をしているが、竜骨の背中にくっついている関係上格闘戦は苦手。どちらかというと制御ユニットとしての役割が大きいらしい。"
en: An advanced undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. The skeleton is armed with melee weapons but it is not good at fighting because it is attached to the back of a dragon skeleton. If anything it seems to play a larger role as a control unit.
en_grezzo: "An advanced undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. The skeleton is armed with melee weapons but it is not good at fighting because it is attached to the back of a dragon skeleton. If anything it seems to play a larger role as a control unit."
it: Arma non morta di grado alto, in uso ai tempi della civiltà biochimica. La parte di ossa umane porta armi da mischia, ma stando attaccata alla schiena di uno scheletro di drago nel corpo a corpo se la cava male. Semmai, pare che conti soprattutto come unità di controllo.

jp: ユナイデッド・ジャック
生化学文明期に使われていた特殊アンデッド兵器。半霊体を無理やり屍人形に憑依させたもの。気味の悪い声で笑いながら戦場を滅茶苦茶にひっかき回す道化。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明期に使われていた特殊アンデッド兵器。半霊体を無理やり屍人形に憑依させたもの。気味の悪い声で笑いながら戦場を滅茶苦茶にひっかき回す道化。"
en: A special undead weapon that was used during the biochemical civilization. A half-spirit body is forcibly possessed by a corpse doll. A clown who scrambles around the battlefield laughing in a creepy voice.
en_grezzo: "A special undead weapon that was used during the biochemical civilization. A half-spirit body is forcibly possessed by a corpse doll. A clown who scrambles around the battlefield laughing in a creepy voice."
it: Arma non morta speciale, in uso ai tempi della civiltà biochimica. È un mezzo spirito costretto a impossessarsi di una bambola fatta di cadaveri. Un buffone che ride con una voce da far accapponare la pelle e mette il campo di battaglia sottosopra.

jp: ユナイデッド・ジョーカー
jp_grezzo: "ユナイデッド・ジョーカー"

jp: イークの割には強い力と立派な勇気を持ち、イークの中でも英雄とされている者たち。集落を襲った猪を倒したり、腕試しに来た騎士と真っ向から戦ったりする。
jp_grezzo: "イークの割には強い力と立派な勇気を持ち、イークの中でも英雄とされている者たち。集落を襲った猪を倒したり、腕試しに来た騎士と真っ向から戦ったりする。"
en: They are considered heroes among the yeeks having strong power and admirable courage for a yeek. He defeats a boar that has attacked his village or fights head-on with a knight who has come to test his skills.
en_grezzo: "They are considered heroes among the yeeks having strong power and admirable courage for a yeek. He defeats a boar that has attacked his village or fights head-on with a knight who has come to test his skills."
it: Per essere uno yeek ha una forza notevole e un coraggio ammirevole, e fra gli yeek passa per eroe. Abbatte il cinghiale che ha assalito il villaggio, oppure affronta a viso aperto il cavaliere venuto a misurarsi con lui.

jp: 事故で人間並みの知性を手に入れたが、代償に理性が欠如したイーク。それゆえに悪魔や邪神の強大さに簡単に魅入られてしまった。他のイークたちからは、近寄るとヤバイやつだと認識されている。
jp_grezzo: "事故で人間並みの知性を手に入れたが、代償に理性が欠如したイーク。それゆえに悪魔や邪神の強大さに簡単に魅入られてしまった。他のイークたちからは、近寄るとヤバイやつだと認識されている。"
en: In an accident he gains human-level intelligence but at the cost of his mind losing his reason. That's why he was so easily enchanted by the mighty power of demons and evil gods. The other yeeks recognize him as a dangerous individual if he gets close to them.
en_grezzo: "In an accident he gains human-level intelligence but at the cost of his mind losing his reason. That's why he was so easily enchanted by the mighty power of demons and evil gods. The other yeeks recognize him as a dangerous individual if he gets close to them."
it: Uno yeek che per un incidente si è ritrovato un'intelligenza pari a quella umana, ma in cambio ci ha rimesso la ragione. Per questo si è lasciato incantare senza fatica dalla potenza dei demoni e degli dei malvagi. Gli altri yeek lo tengono per uno a cui è meglio non avvicinarsi.

jp: イークの古代種。種類関係なくイーク族を使役する能力を持つ。イークのイークによるイークのための国家を創る、という大層な野望を持っているが、具体的にどうすればいいのかまでは考えていない。
jp_grezzo: "イークの古代種。種類関係なくイーク族を使役する能力を持つ。イークのイークによるイークのための国家を創る、という大層な野望を持っているが、具体的にどうすればいいのかまでは考えていない。"
en: An ancient species of yeeks. It has the ability to employ yeek tribes regardless of type. He has grand ambitions to create a nation of yeeks by yeeks for yeeks but he doesn't even think about how to go about it concretely.
en_grezzo: "An ancient species of yeeks. It has the ability to employ yeek tribes regardless of type. He has grand ambitions to create a nation of yeeks by yeeks for yeeks but he doesn't even think about how to go about it concretely."
it: Specie antica degli yeek. Ha il potere di comandare la stirpe degli yeek, di qualunque tipo siano. Coltiva l'ambizione solenne di fondare uno stato degli yeek, per opera degli yeek e a vantaggio degli yeek, ma su come farlo davvero non ci ha ancora pensato.

jp: マスター・アルカイーク
イークの古代種。拳銃が大好きであり、よくノリノリで人間のガンマンの真似をしている。拳銃は拾いもの。自分たちで作るほどの技術は持っていない。
jp_grezzo: "イークの古代種。拳銃が大好きであり、よくノリノリで人間のガンマンの真似をしている。拳銃は拾いもの。自分たちで作るほどの技術は持っていない。"
en: An ancient species of yeek. He loves guns and often imitates a human gunman. A handgun is scavenged. They don't have the skills to make it themselves.
en_grezzo: "An ancient species of yeek. He loves guns and often imitates a human gunman. A handgun is scavenged. They don't have the skills to make it themselves."
it: Specie antica degli yeek. Va matto per le pistole, e spesso, tutto entusiasta, fa il verso ai pistoleri umani. La pistola l'ha trovata per terra: la tecnica per costruirsela da solo non ce l'ha.

jp: イークの古代種。体が頑丈で力も強いが、他の生物に比べるとやはり劣る。そのためか現代では繁殖力が高く小型の種類のイークが台頭している。あまり群れようとしないが仲間意識は強い。
jp_grezzo: "イークの古代種。体が頑丈で力も強いが、他の生物に比べるとやはり劣る。そのためか現代では繁殖力が高く小型の種類のイークが台頭している。あまり群れようとしないが仲間意識は強い。"
en: An ancient species of yeek. Their bodies are strong and sturdy but they are not as strong as other creatures. Perhaps because of this small highly fertile species of yeek have emerged in modern times. They don't try to flock but they have a strong sense of camaraderie.
en_grezzo: "An ancient species of yeek. Their bodies are strong and sturdy but they are not as strong as other creatures. Perhaps because of this small highly fertile species of yeek have emerged in modern times. They don't try to flock but they have a strong sense of camaraderie."
it: Specie antica degli yeek. Ha il corpo robusto e anche la sua forza, ma messo accanto alle altre creature resta comunque indietro. Sarà per questo che oggi hanno preso il sopravvento le specie di yeek piccole e molto prolifiche. Non è tipo da branco, ma tiene molto ai suoi.

jp: 昔は酷いなまけものだった。しかし命がけでネフィアをひとつ攻略してから心機一転。冒険の楽しさに目覚め、今日も遺跡荒らしとして働いている。
jp_grezzo: "昔は酷いなまけものだった。しかし命がけでネフィアをひとつ攻略してから心機一転。冒険の楽しさに目覚め、今日も遺跡荒らしとして働いている。"
en: He used to be a terrible slob. However after risking his life to conquer one of the Nefian dungeons he had a change of heart. He has awakened to the joy of adventure and is still working as a ruins vandal today.
en_grezzo: "He used to be a terrible slob. However after risking his life to conquer one of the Nefian dungeons he had a change of heart. He has awakened to the joy of adventure and is still working as a ruins vandal today."
it: Un tempo era un pigrone da manuale. Poi ha conquistato una Nefia rischiando la pelle, e da lì ha cambiato registro. Si è risvegliato al piacere dell'avventura, e anche oggi è lì che lavora a saccheggiare rovine.

jp: 実家に縛られるのを嫌い幼い頃に家出。放浪中に誤って裏の業界へ踏み入ってしまうが、記憶力と洞察力で賭博に逆転勝利し生き残った。その後スリルを求めて裏の仕事に携わる中、一人の行き倒れに出会う。
jp_grezzo: "実家に縛られるのを嫌い幼い頃に家出。放浪中に誤って裏の業界へ踏み入ってしまうが、記憶力と洞察力で賭博に逆転勝利し生き残った。その後スリルを求めて裏の仕事に携わる中、一人の行き倒れに出会う。"
en: She ran away from home at an early age because she hated being tied to her parents' home. While wandering she accidentally ventured into the underworld but survived by winning the gamble to regain her memory and insight. Later while working behind the scenes in search of thrills he meets a man who has fallen.
en_grezzo: "She ran away from home at an early age because she hated being tied to her parents' home. While wandering she accidentally ventured into the underworld but survived by winning the gamble to regain her memory and insight. Later while working behind the scenes in search of thrills he meets a man who has fallen."
it: Non sopportava di stare legata alla casa di famiglia, e da piccola scappò via. Mentre girava senza meta mise per sbaglio piede nel giro losco, ma con la memoria e l'intuito ribaltò la partita al gioco d'azzardo e ne uscì viva. Poi, mentre si dava ai lavori sporchi per il gusto del rischio, si imbatté in una persona stramazzata per strada.

jp: 別名、クイックリングの仕事人。小さい体を活かして闇に紛れ、標的を待ち伏せする。そして糸を自在に操って目にもとまらぬ速さで標的を惨殺するのだ。その腕前は鮮やか。
jp_grezzo: "別名、クイックリングの仕事人。小さい体を活かして闇に紛れ、標的を待ち伏せする。そして糸を自在に操って目にもとまらぬ速さで標的を惨殺するのだ。その腕前は鮮やか。"
en: Also known as a quickling workman. He uses his small body to blend in with the darkness and ambush his targets. He then manipulates the string to slaughter the target with uncanny speed. His skills are superb.
en_grezzo: "Also known as a quickling workman. He uses his small body to blend in with the darkness and ambush his targets. He then manipulates the string to slaughter the target with uncanny speed. His skills are superb."
it: Lo chiamano anche il professionista dei quickling. Sfrutta il corpo piccolo per confondersi col buio e aspetta il bersaglio all'agguato. Poi manovra i fili come vuole e lo fa a pezzi a una velocità che l'occhio non segue. Un lavoro pulito.

jp: 冥界の僻地に吹きすさぶという、瘴気の嵐の中で生まれる特殊なクイックリング。風の噂でストームブリンガーとかいう黒い剣があると聞いてから、運命めいたものを感じている。
jp_grezzo: "冥界の僻地に吹きすさぶという、瘴気の嵐の中で生まれる特殊なクイックリング。風の噂でストームブリンガーとかいう黒い剣があると聞いてから、運命めいたものを感じている。"
en: This special quickling is created by a storm of miasma that blew into a remote area of the underworld. They've felt a sense of destiny after hearing that there was a black sword called Stormbringer from rumors in the wind.
en_grezzo: "This special quickling is created by a storm of miasma that blew into a remote area of the underworld. They've felt a sense of destiny after hearing that there was a black sword called Stormbringer from rumors in the wind."
it: Un quickling speciale, che nasce dentro le tempeste di miasma che si dice infurino nelle terre remote dell'oltretomba. Da quando il vento gli ha portato la voce che esiste una spada nera chiamata Stormbringer, si sente addosso qualcosa che somiglia a un destino.

jp: 草原を駆ける小人。尋常でない脚力を持ち、足を一振りするだけで衝撃波が発生する。代償として生まれつき膝に爆弾を抱えており、全力で走ったり蹴ったりすると反動に耐え切れずに破裂してしまう難儀な生物。
jp_grezzo: "草原を駆ける小人。尋常でない脚力を持ち、足を一振りするだけで衝撃波が発生する。代償として生まれつき膝に爆弾を抱えており、全力で走ったり蹴ったりすると反動に耐え切れずに破裂してしまう難儀な生物。"
en: A midget running through a meadow. It has extraordinary leg strength and a shockwave is generated with a single swing of the leg. As a quid pro quo it was born with a charge in its knee and if it runs or kicks with all its might it will be unable to withstand the recoil and explode.
en_grezzo: "A midget running through a meadow. It has extraordinary leg strength and a shockwave is generated with a single swing of the leg. As a quid pro quo it was born with a charge in its knee and if it runs or kicks with all its might it will be unable to withstand the recoil and explode."
it: Un ometto che corre per le praterie. Ha nelle gambe una forza fuori dal comune, e gli basta un colpo di piede per sollevare un'onda d'urto. Il prezzo lo paga alla nascita: ha una carica esplosiva nel ginocchio, e se corre o calcia a tutta forza non regge il contraccolpo e scoppia. Una creatura scomoda.

jp: クイックリングの近縁種。草原で踊り狂う小人。手先が器用で陽気な性格。普段はステップが速すぎてどんな踊りなのかよくわからないが、時折見せる魅力的な動作と妖しい視線は、観客の心を一瞬で惑わす。
jp_grezzo: "クイックリングの近縁種。草原で踊り狂う小人。手先が器用で陽気な性格。普段はステップが速すぎてどんな踊りなのかよくわからないが、時折見せる魅力的な動作と妖しい視線は、観客の心を一瞬で惑わす。"
en: A close relative of Quickling. A midget dancing in the meadow. He has a dexterous hand and a cheerful personality. Usually the steps are too fast to know what kind of dance they are doing but sometimes their charming movements and mysterious gazes will bewitch the audience in an instant.
en_grezzo: "A close relative of Quickling. A midget dancing in the meadow. He has a dexterous hand and a cheerful personality. Usually the steps are too fast to know what kind of dance they are doing but sometimes their charming movements and mysterious gazes will bewitch the audience in an instant."
it: Parente stretto del quickling. Un ometto che balla come un forsennato nelle praterie. Ha le mani abili e il carattere allegro. Di solito i passi vanno troppo veloci per capire che ballo sia, ma i gesti pieni di grazia che si lascia sfuggire ogni tanto, e quello sguardo ambiguo, confondono il pubblico in un istante.

jp: ザナンの秘密実験施設で酷使されていた兵士。脱出・亡命できたのはいいが身体の異状に悩まされていた。ロスリアで最近開発された緩和薬によって、能力はやや落ちるものの安定性を手に入れた模様。
jp_grezzo: "ザナンの秘密実験施設で酷使されていた兵士。脱出・亡命できたのはいいが身体の異状に悩まされていた。ロスリアで最近開発された緩和薬によって、能力はやや落ちるものの安定性を手に入れた模様。"
en: A soldier who has been subjected to harsh treatment at a secret experimental facility in Zanan. He was able to flee and defect but he was suffering from a physical disorder. With the recent development of a palliative in Lothria he seems to have gained stability although his abilities are slightly less.
en_grezzo: "A soldier who has been subjected to harsh treatment at a secret experimental facility in Zanan. He was able to flee and defect but he was suffering from a physical disorder. With the recent development of a palliative in Lothria he seems to have gained stability although his abilities are slightly less."
it: Un soldato sfruttato fino all'osso nel centro sperimentale segreto di Zanan. Fuggire e passare dall'altra parte gli è riuscito, ma il corpo gli è rimasto guasto e non gli dava pace. Pare che con il farmaco lenitivo messo a punto di recente a Lothria abbia guadagnato stabilità, in cambio di un po' di quello che sa fare.

jp: 熟練した兵士だったが寄る年波には勝てないと判断され、とっくの昔に軍を強制引退させられている。血で汚れすぎた自分は戦場でしか生きられないと悟り、他国へ亡命。経験を買われ再就職できた。
jp_grezzo: "熟練した兵士だったが寄る年波には勝てないと判断され、とっくの昔に軍を強制引退させられている。血で汚れすぎた自分は戦場でしか生きられないと悟り、他国へ亡命。経験を買われ再就職できた。"
en: He was a skilled soldier but he was forced out of the army long ago when it was decided that he was no match given to his age. He realizes that he has become too stained with blood and can only live on the battlefield so he goes into exile in another country. He was able to re-enter the workforce because of his experience.
en_grezzo: "He was a skilled soldier but he was forced out of the army long ago when it was decided that he was no match given to his age. He realizes that he has become too stained with blood and can only live on the battlefield so he goes into exile in another country. He was able to re-enter the workforce because of his experience."
it: Era un soldato provetto, ma decisero che contro il peso degli anni non c'era niente da fare e da un pezzo lo misero in congedo a forza. Capito che ormai si era sporcato di troppo sangue e che vivere poteva solo sul campo di battaglia, se n'è andato in un altro paese. L'esperienza gliel'hanno comprata volentieri, e ha trovato un altro ingaggio.

jp: 看護疲れをこじらせ、殺人の快楽に目覚めたナース。機関銃を乱射して連続殺人を繰り返す。殺した後に慈愛の心が一瞬だけ蘇り、死体に優しく接する。
jp_grezzo: "看護疲れをこじらせ、殺人の快楽に目覚めたナース。機関銃を乱射して連続殺人を繰り返す。殺した後に慈愛の心が一瞬だけ蘇り、死体に優しく接する。"
en: The nurses tire of nursing and awaken to the pleasures of murder. They fire a machine gun and go on a series of murders. Their compassionate hearts revived for a moment after the killing and they treat the corpse gently.
en_grezzo: "The nurses tire of nursing and awaken to the pleasures of murder. They fire a machine gun and go on a series of murders. Their compassionate hearts revived for a moment after the killing and they treat the corpse gently."
it: Un'infermiera che, a furia di stancarsi nel curare, si è risvegliata al piacere di uccidere. Spara raffiche di mitragliatrice e ammazza a ripetizione. Dopo il colpo, per un istante, il cuore pietoso le torna: e allora tratta il cadavere con dolcezza.

jp: 前ロスリア騎士団長の実娘。父に戦いから遠ざけられていたが、本人の強い希望で衛生兵に。父が任務で出払っている間に高い戦闘才能が開花し、団長代理にまでに登りつめた。親譲りのクセ毛が悩み。
jp_grezzo: "前ロスリア騎士団長の実娘。父に戦いから遠ざけられていたが、本人の強い希望で衛生兵に。父が任務で出払っている間に高い戦闘才能が開花し、団長代理にまでに登りつめた。親譲りのクセ毛が悩み。"
en: Daughter of the former Commander of the Knights of Lothria. Although her father kept her from fighting she became a corpsman at her own insistence. While her father was away on a mission her high fighting talent blossomed and she rose to the rank of Acting Commander. The spiky hair that is inherited from her parents bothers her.
en_grezzo: "Daughter of the former Commander of the Knights of Lothria. Although her father kept her from fighting she became a corpsman at her own insistence. While her father was away on a mission her high fighting talent blossomed and she rose to the rank of Acting Commander. The spiky hair that is inherited from her parents bothers her."
it: Figlia del precedente comandante dell'ordine cavalleresco di Lothria. Il padre la teneva lontana dai combattimenti, ma lei ha voluto a tutti i costi fare almeno l'infermiera di reparto. Mentre lui era via in missione le è sbocciato un talento notevole per la battaglia, e si è arrampicata fino a comandante facente funzione. I capelli ribelli, quelli sì, li ha presi in famiglia, e le danno pensiero.

jp: 蒼天の稲妻『ランカータ』
ヴァリウスが失脚した際に解体された、ロスリア騎士団が母体。ヴァリウスの復権に伴って密かに再招集され、影で様々な任務を遂行していた。エウダーナから流入した魔鎧を改良した物を着用している。
jp_grezzo: "ヴァリウスが失脚した際に解体された、ロスリア騎士団が母体。ヴァリウスの復権に伴って密かに再招集され、影で様々な任務を遂行していた。エウダーナから流入した魔鎧を改良した物を着用している。"
en: The parent company is the Knights of Lothria which was disbanded when Vallius was deposed. He was secretly recalled with the return of Vallius and carried out various missions in the shadows. He wears a modified version of the magical armor that came in from Eulderna.
en_grezzo: "The parent company is the Knights of Lothria which was disbanded when Vallius was deposed. He was secretly recalled with the return of Vallius and carried out various missions in the shadows. He wears a modified version of the magical armor that came in from Eulderna."
it: Nasce dall'ordine cavalleresco di Lothria, sciolto quando Barius cadde in disgrazia. Con il ritorno di Barius al potere il reparto fu richiamato di nascosto, e ha portato a termine ogni sorta di missione restando nell'ombra. Indossa una versione rimaneggiata dell'armatura magica arrivata da Eulderna.

jp: 普通のエレアとは同じルーツを持つが、異形の森の外での暮らしに適応した亜種。強い魔力と褐色の肌を持ち、群れを作りたがらないのが特徴。性格面では普通のエレアに比べて好戦的で世俗的。
jp_grezzo: "普通のエレアとは同じルーツを持つが、異形の森の外での暮らしに適応した亜種。強い魔力と褐色の肌を持ち、群れを作りたがらないのが特徴。性格面では普通のエレアに比べて好戦的で世俗的。"
en: A subspecies that has the same roots as a normal Elea but has adapted to life outside the strange forest. They have strong magical powers dark skin and are reluctant to form groups. In terms of personality they are more warlike and worldly than normal Elea.
en_grezzo: "A subspecies that has the same roots as a normal Elea but has adapted to life outside the strange forest. They have strong magical powers dark skin and are reluctant to form groups. In terms of personality they are more warlike and worldly than normal Elea."
it: Ha le stesse radici degli Elea comuni, ma è la sottospecie che si è adattata alla vita fuori dal bosco di Vindale. Ha un forte potere magico e la pelle scura, e non ama mettersi in gruppo. Di carattere, rispetto agli Elea comuni, è più bellicoso e più attaccato alle cose del mondo.

jp: キッカス-ニーサの国境付近で商売をしていた丘の民。冒険商人を自称しており、戦場などの危険な場所で商品を売りさばく。需要のある場所で物を高く売るのがスタイルらしく、扱う商品を場所によって変える。
jp_grezzo: "キッカス-ニーサの国境付近で商売をしていた丘の民。冒険商人を自称しており、戦場などの危険な場所で商品を売りさばく。需要のある場所で物を高く売るのがスタイルらしく、扱う商品を場所によって変える。"
en: Hillfolk who traded near the border of Kikkas. A self-proclaimed adventurer she sells her wares on the battlefield and in other dangerous places. It seems that her style is to sell things at high prices where there is a high demand so she changes the products she deals with from place to place.
en_grezzo: "Hillfolk who traded near the border of Kikkas. A self-proclaimed adventurer she sells her wares on the battlefield and in other dangerous places. It seems that her style is to sell things at high prices where there is a high demand so she changes the products she deals with from place to place."
it: Viene dal popolo delle colline, e commerciava dalle parti del confine fra Kikkas e Niesa. Si proclama mercante avventuriera, e smercia la sua roba nei campi di battaglia e in altri posti pericolosi. Il suo stile pare essere vendere caro dove c'è richiesta, e infatti cambia merce a seconda del posto.

jp: ブラックホールに生息していた宇宙蟹。異星種に捕獲され、侵略用に品種改良された。主にハサミと溶解液で戦う。可愛らしい鳴き声と動きから、近年では宇宙ペットとして飼われているケースもある。
jp_grezzo: "ブラックホールに生息していた宇宙蟹。異星種に捕獲され、侵略用に品種改良された。主にハサミと溶解液で戦う。可愛らしい鳴き声と動きから、近年では宇宙ペットとして飼われているケースもある。"
en: A space crab that inhabited a black hole. It was captured by an alien species and bred for use in invasions. Mainly fighting with scissors and liquid solvents. In recent years some of them have been kept as space pets because of their adorable calls and movements.
en_grezzo: "A space crab that inhabited a black hole. It was captured by an alien species and bred for use in invasions. Mainly fighting with scissors and liquid solvents. In recent years some of them have been kept as space pets because of their adorable calls and movements."
it: Un granchio spaziale che viveva dentro un buco nero. Una specie aliena lo catturò e lo selezionò per usarlo nelle invasioni. Combatte soprattutto con le chele e con un liquido che scioglie. Il verso e i movimenti sono così graziosi che negli ultimi tempi c'è chi lo tiene come animale da compagnia spaziale.

jp: 異形の森に住んでいた巨大ダンゴムシ。人間以上の知性と寛大な心を持ち、森の王者として君臨。エレアとも共生しており、森が焼かれた際には炎に囲まれた人々を身を挺して導いた。正体は生化学文明の遺産。
jp_grezzo: "異形の森に住んでいた巨大ダンゴムシ。人間以上の知性と寛大な心を持ち、森の王者として君臨。エレアとも共生しており、森が焼かれた際には炎に囲まれた人々を身を挺して導いた。正体は生化学文明の遺産。"
en: A giant sowbug that lived in a bizarre forest. He reigns as the king of the forest with an intelligence beyond that of humans and a generous heart. He also lives in symbiosis with Elea and when the forest was burned he led the people amidst the flames with his strength. In reality he is a relic of a biochemical civilization.
en_grezzo: "A giant sowbug that lived in a bizarre forest. He reigns as the king of the forest with an intelligence beyond that of humans and a generous heart. He also lives in symbiosis with Elea and when the forest was burned he led the people amidst the flames with his strength. In reality he is a relic of a biochemical civilization."
it: Un porcellino di terra gigantesco che viveva nel bosco di Vindale. Ha un'intelligenza superiore a quella degli uomini e un cuore magnanimo, e regna sul bosco come suo sovrano. Vive in simbiosi anche con gli Elea, e quando il bosco fu dato alle fiamme fece scudo col proprio corpo per guidare fuori la gente circondata dal fuoco. In verità è un lascito della civiltà biochimica.

jp: 甲殻王者『キングダンゴムシ』
jp_grezzo: "甲殻王者『キングダンゴムシ』"

jp: 冥界蟹の近縁種。三途の川の河川敷から、冥海の海岸まで幅広く分布しており、あちら側では冥界蟹よりもポピュラーな存在。発達した片腕で死者を導く習性があるが、生者は魂ごと引っ張られるので危険。
jp_grezzo: "冥界蟹の近縁種。三途の川の河川敷から、冥海の海岸まで幅広く分布しており、あちら側では冥界蟹よりもポピュラーな存在。発達した片腕で死者を導く習性があるが、生者は魂ごと引っ張られるので危険。"
en: A close relative of the underworld crab. It is widely found from the riverbed of the Sanzu River to the shore of the Underworld and is more popular than the Underworld crab on the other side. It has a habit of guiding the dead with one arm but it is dangerous to the living because their souls will be pulled away.
en_grezzo: "A close relative of the underworld crab. It is widely found from the riverbed of the Sanzu River to the shore of the Underworld and is more popular than the Underworld crab on the other side. It has a habit of guiding the dead with one arm but it is dangerous to the living because their souls will be pulled away."
it: Parente stretto del granchio dell'oltretomba. È diffuso su un tratto largo, dalle golene del fiume Sanzu fino alle coste del mare dei morti, e di là è più comune del granchio dell'oltretomba. Ha l'abitudine di guidare i defunti con la chela che ha sviluppato, ma per un vivo è pericoloso: verrebbe tirato via con tutta l'anima.

jp: 重なり合った王冠のような形の外殻を持つ。その見た目から古代サイロニアでは王の資質を見定める存在とされ、背中に登るのが王位継承の儀式となっていた。現代でも祭りにその儀式の名残が見られる。
jp_grezzo: "重なり合った王冠のような形の外殻を持つ。その見た目から古代サイロニアでは王の資質を見定める存在とされ、背中に登るのが王位継承の儀式となっていた。現代でも祭りにその儀式の名残が見られる。"
en: It has an outer shell that is shaped like an overlapping crown. Because of its appearance it was regarded as the judge of kingly qualities in ancient Cyronia and climbing on its back was a ritual of succession to the throne. Remnants of the ritual can still be seen in festivals today.
en_grezzo: "It has an outer shell that is shaped like an overlapping crown. Because of its appearance it was regarded as the judge of kingly qualities in ancient Cyronia and climbing on its back was a ritual of succession to the throne. Remnants of the ritual can still be seen in festivals today."
it: Ha il guscio fatto a corone sovrapposte. Per quell'aspetto, nell'antica Cyronia lo tenevano per il giudice che riconosceva la stoffa di un re, e salirgli in groppa era il rito con cui si saliva al trono. Ancora oggi, nelle feste, di quel rito si vede qualche residuo.

jp: 超古代に絶滅したと思われていた海洋生物が、地中での暮らしに適応進化して生き延びていた。雌が植物の根を摂取して体内で精油を作り、フェロモンとして求愛行動に用いることからこの名がついた。
jp_grezzo: "超古代に絶滅したと思われていた海洋生物が、地中での暮らしに適応進化して生き延びていた。雌が植物の根を摂取して体内で精油を作り、フェロモンとして求愛行動に用いることからこの名がついた。"
en: Marine life thought to have gone extinct in extreme antiquity survived by adapting and evolving to live underground. It got its name from the fact that the female ingests the roots of the plant and produces essential oil in her body which she uses as a pheromone in her courtship behavior.
en_grezzo: "Marine life thought to have gone extinct in extreme antiquity survived by adapting and evolving to live underground. It got its name from the fact that the female ingests the roots of the plant and produces essential oil in her body which she uses as a pheromone in her courtship behavior."
it: Una creatura marina che si credeva estinta in un'antichità remotissima, e che invece era sopravvissuta adattandosi alla vita sottoterra. Il nome le viene dal fatto che la femmina si nutre di radici di piante, se ne ricava dentro il corpo un olio essenziale e lo usa come feromone nel corteggiamento.

jp: 狙撃銃を殻に仕込んだやどかり。殻の丈夫さから、足を止めての撃ちあいに強い。足が遅いため、狙撃に耐えられる生物相手には簡単に捕食されてしまう。
jp_grezzo: "狙撃銃を殻に仕込んだやどかり。殻の丈夫さから、足を止めての撃ちあいに強い。足が遅いため、狙撃に耐えられる生物相手には簡単に捕食されてしまう。"
en: They have a sniper rifle on their shells. Due to the strength of the shell it is strong enough to shoot at a standstill. Because of its slow legs it is easily preyed upon by creatures that can withstand the sniping.
en_grezzo: "They have a sniper rifle on their shells. Due to the strength of the shell it is strong enough to shoot at a standstill. Because of its slow legs it is easily preyed upon by creatures that can withstand the sniping."
it: Un paguro che si è montato un fucile di precisione dentro il guscio. Il guscio è robusto, e quindi nello scambio di colpi a piede fermo se la cava bene. Ma le zampe sono lente: chi regge il tiro di precisione se lo mangia senza fatica.

jp: 人に似た上半身を持ち、ニンゲンやヒトガタなどと呼ばれるが、巻貝の仲間。古代から陸上にも生息していたが透明なので気づかれなかったし、海で発見されても海洋哺乳類の見間違いだとされていた。
jp_grezzo: "人に似た上半身を持ち、ニンゲンやヒトガタなどと呼ばれるが、巻貝の仲間。古代から陸上にも生息していたが透明なので気づかれなかったし、海で発見されても海洋哺乳類の見間違いだとされていた。"
en: It has an upper body that resembles a human and is called a ningen or hitokata but it is a member of the snail family. They've lived on land since ancient times but have gone unnoticed because they're so transparent and when they're found in the ocean they've been misidentified as marine mammals.
en_grezzo: "It has an upper body that resembles a human and is called a ningen or hitokata but it is a member of the snail family. They've lived on land since ancient times but have gone unnoticed because they're so transparent and when they're found in the ocean they've been misidentified as marine mammals."
it: Ha il busto simile a quello di una persona, e infatti lo chiamano Ningen o Hitogata, ma è parente delle chiocciole. Fin dall'antichità viveva anche sulla terraferma, solo che nessuno se n'era accorto perché è trasparente; e quando qualcuno lo avvistava in mare, si diceva che avesse scambiato per altro un mammifero marino.

jp: 高速で突進し、鋭い顎を突き刺してくる魚。人の頭蓋骨を余裕で貫通する。鋭い歯を持っておりインド象の鼻を食いちぎったケースも。完璧主義者であり、相手を仕留められないと刺さったまま回転して大暴れする。
jp_grezzo: "高速で突進し、鋭い顎を突き刺してくる魚。人の頭蓋骨を余裕で貫通する。鋭い歯を持っておりインド象の鼻を食いちぎったケースも。完璧主義者であり、相手を仕留められないと刺さったまま回転して大暴れする。"
en: A fish that rushes at high speed and pierces you with its sharp maw. It can penetrate a person's skull at will. It has sharp teeth and in some cases it has bitten off the nose of an Indian elephant. They're perfectionists and if they can't finish off their opponents they'll go on a rampage stabbing and spinning.
en_grezzo: "A fish that rushes at high speed and pierces you with its sharp maw. It can penetrate a person's skull at will. It has sharp teeth and in some cases it has bitten off the nose of an Indian elephant. They're perfectionists and if they can't finish off their opponents they'll go on a rampage stabbing and spinning."
it: Un pesce che carica ad alta velocità e infilza con le mascelle affilate. Un cranio umano lo passa da parte a parte senza sforzo. Ha i denti aguzzi, e si sono visti casi in cui ha staccato con un morso la proboscide a un elefante indiano. È perfezionista: se non riesce a finire l'avversario, resta infilzato e si mette a girare su se stesso come un ossesso.

jp: ナインダツフィッシュ
三途の川の終着点である、「冥海」出身。好奇心が強く、見知らぬ相手にも無邪気にジャレつくのだがそれがシャレにならない。巨体によるおふざけ突進や、鎧を圧砕する甘噛みに耐えられる者は少ないだろう。
jp_grezzo: "三途の川の終着点である、「冥海」出身。好奇心が強く、見知らぬ相手にも無邪気にジャレつくのだがそれがシャレにならない。巨体によるおふざけ突進や、鎧を圧砕する甘噛みに耐えられる者は少ないだろう。"
en: He is from the Land of the Dead the terminus of the Sanzu River. He has a strong curiosity and innocently plays games with strangers but is no joke. Few would be able to withstand the goofy rush of a huge body and the sweet bite that crushes armor.
en_grezzo: "He is from the Land of the Dead the terminus of the Sanzu River. He has a strong curiosity and innocently plays games with strangers but is no joke. Few would be able to withstand the goofy rush of a huge body and the sweet bite that crushes armor."
it: Viene dal mare dei morti, il capolinea del fiume Sanzu. È di una curiosità insaziabile, e fa festa con innocenza anche a chi non conosce, solo che di festoso ha poco. Alla carica per gioco di quel corpaccione, e al morsetto affettuoso che sfonda un'armatura, resiste poca gente.

jp: 温厚な性格で、毒針もないエイ。普段はエーテルの風に乗り低空を遊泳しながら空気中のマナや羽虫を食って生きているが、肉も食えないことはない。戦闘になると糸を撒いて敵の動きを止め、放電を行う。
jp_grezzo: "温厚な性格で、毒針もないエイ。普段はエーテルの風に乗り低空を遊泳しながら空気中のマナや羽虫を食って生きているが、肉も食えないことはない。戦闘になると糸を撒いて敵の動きを止め、放電を行う。"
en: They are mild-mannered and have no poisonous needles. Normally they live off of mana and winged insects in the air as they swim low in the etheric winds but they are not incapable of eating meat either. When it comes to combat it stops the enemy's movement by scattering threads and discharging them.
en_grezzo: "They are mild-mannered and have no poisonous needles. Normally they live off of mana and winged insects in the air as they swim low in the etheric winds but they are not incapable of eating meat either. When it comes to combat it stops the enemy's movement by scattering threads and discharging them."
it: Una razza di indole mite, e per giunta senza aculeo velenoso. Di solito vive nuotando bassa sul vento d'etere e mangiando il mana e i moscerini che trova nell'aria, ma la carne non è che non la mangi. Se si arriva alle mani, sparge fili per bloccare il nemico sul posto e poi scarica la corrente.

jp: 海底にたたずむ一輪の花。実際は珊瑚虫の群体である。藻類と共生しており、光合成も可能。色とりどりの外骨格を形成するが、生息しやすいようにと周囲に海水を撒きちらすので、あまり観賞には向かない。
jp_grezzo: "海底にたたずむ一輪の花。実際は珊瑚虫の群体である。藻類と共生しており、光合成も可能。色とりどりの外骨格を形成するが、生息しやすいようにと周囲に海水を撒きちらすので、あまり観賞には向かない。"
en: A single flower resting on the sea floor. In fact it is a group of coral worms. It lives in symbiosis with algae and is also capable of photosynthesis. It forms a multi-colored exoskeleton but it is not easily seen because it sprays seawater around it to make it habitable.
en_grezzo: "A single flower resting on the sea floor. In fact it is a group of coral worms. It lives in symbiosis with algae and is also capable of photosynthesis. It forms a multi-colored exoskeleton but it is not easily seen because it sprays seawater around it to make it habitable."
it: Un fiore solitario che se ne sta in fondo al mare. In realtà è una colonia di polipi di corallo. Vive in simbiosi con le alghe e sa anche fare la fotosintesi. Costruisce uno scheletro esterno di tutti i colori, ma come ornamento non vale molto: per stare comodo sparge acqua di mare tutt'intorno.

jp: 海のビッグスターを自称する巨大なヒトデ。最近、陸にはハムスターという人気者がいると聞いて、負けじと陸に上がってきた。手裏剣のことを寡黙な同族だと思い込んでいる。
jp_grezzo: "海のビッグスターを自称する巨大なヒトデ。最近、陸にはハムスターという人気者がいると聞いて、負けじと陸に上がってきた。手裏剣のことを寡黙な同族だと思い込んでいる。"
en: A giant starfish that calls itself the Big Star of the Sea. Recently it heard that there was a popular creature so he came up to not be outdone. He thinks of shuriken as a taciturn kindred spirit.
en_grezzo: "A giant starfish that calls itself the Big Star of the Sea. Recently it heard that there was a popular creature so he came up to not be outdone. He thinks of shuriken as a taciturn kindred spirit."
it: Una stella marina enorme che si proclama la grande stella del mare. Di recente ha sentito dire che sulla terraferma c'è un beniamino di nome criceto, e per non essere da meno è salita anche lei all'asciutto. È convinta che gli shuriken siano parenti suoi, solo un po' taciturni.

jp: 海の犯罪者と呼ばれる。スリや食い逃げがメインだが、ある日やばすぎる犯罪を行ってしまい、現在は陸へ高飛び中。ほとぼりが冷めた頃に海に帰ろうと考えている。
jp_grezzo: "海の犯罪者と呼ばれる。スリや食い逃げがメインだが、ある日やばすぎる犯罪を行ってしまい、現在は陸へ高飛び中。ほとぼりが冷めた頃に海に帰ろうと考えている。"
en: They are called the Criminals of the Sea. They''re mainly pickpockets and food runners but one day they commit a terrible crime and are now flying overland. They are thinking of returning to the sea when the heat has cooled down.
en_grezzo: "They are called the Criminals of the Sea. They''re mainly pickpockets and food runners but one day they commit a terrible crime and are now flying overland. They are thinking of returning to the sea when the heat has cooled down."
it: Lo chiamano il delinquente del mare. Di mestiere fa il borseggiatore e mangia senza pagare, ma un giorno ha combinato un guaio troppo grosso, e adesso è alla macchia sulla terraferma. Conta di tornarsene in mare quando le acque si saranno calmate.

jp: 波の向くまま、気の向くままにさすらう海のガンマン。日光浴が大好きで、わざわざショートテレポートを連打して陸の岩の上まで寝そべりに行く。そして帰りに苦労する。
jp_grezzo: "波の向くまま、気の向くままにさすらう海のガンマン。日光浴が大好きで、わざわざショートテレポートを連打して陸の岩の上まで寝そべりに行く。そして帰りに苦労する。"
en: A sea gunslinger who wanders at the direction of the waves and at his own whim. He loves to soak up the sun and deliberately goes to lie down on the rocks on the land with a series of short teleports. And struggle on the way home.
en_grezzo: "A sea gunslinger who wanders at the direction of the waves and at his own whim. He loves to soak up the sun and deliberately goes to lie down on the rocks on the land with a series of short teleports. And struggle on the way home."
it: Un pistolero del mare che vaga dove lo portano le onde e dove gli gira. Va matto per il bagno di sole, e per andare a sdraiarsi sugli scogli a riva si spara una raffica di teletrasporti corti. Poi, al ritorno, sono guai.

jp: 既存の忍術に縛られなくなったことで天性の才能が開花。よくわからないコードネームを名乗ってノリノリで活動している。…後年、クッションに顔を埋めて手足をバタバタさせてのた打ち回ることになりそうである。
jp_grezzo: "既存の忍術に縛られなくなったことで天性の才能が開花。よくわからないコードネームを名乗ってノリノリで活動している。…後年、クッションに顔を埋めて手足をバタバタさせてのた打ち回ることになりそうである。"
en: Her natural talent blossomed when she was no longer bound by existing ninjutsu. She goes by a code name that nobody understands and is in high spirits. ...In later years she's going to be burying her face in the cushion and lazing around.
en_grezzo: "Her natural talent blossomed when she was no longer bound by existing ninjutsu. She goes by a code name that nobody understands and is in high spirits. ...In later years she's going to be burying her face in the cushion and lazing around."
it: Il talento naturale le è sbocciato quando ha smesso di stare legata alle arti ninja come si erano sempre fatte. Adesso si presenta con un nome in codice che non si capisce bene e si diverte un mondo. ...C'è da scommettere che fra qualche anno finirà a ficcare la faccia in un cuscino e a sbattere braccia e gambe per la vergogna.

jp: 謎のお洒落忍者『シャドウシスター』
jp_grezzo: "謎のお洒落忍者『シャドウシスター』"

jp: 人間に友好的な犬の神。人間嫌いの弟と喧嘩になり、森を出て彷徨った結果メイルーンへ辿り着いた。吹雪で遭難した旅人を導いている内に一部地域で信仰されるようになったが、まだまだマイナーな神らしい。
jp_grezzo: "人間に友好的な犬の神。人間嫌いの弟と喧嘩になり、森を出て彷徨った結果メイルーンへ辿り着いた。吹雪で遭難した旅人を導いている内に一部地域で信仰されるようになったが、まだまだマイナーな神らしい。"
en: A dog god who is friendly to humans. He got into a fight with his brother who hates humans and wandered out of the forest resulting in his arrival in Mayroon. While guiding travelers who were lost in a blizzard the god came to be worshipped in some areas but it seems that it is still a minor god.
en_grezzo: "A dog god who is friendly to humans. He got into a fight with his brother who hates humans and wandered out of the forest resulting in his arrival in Mayroon. While guiding travelers who were lost in a blizzard the god came to be worshipped in some areas but it seems that it is still a minor god."
it: Un dio cane, e in buoni rapporti con gli uomini. Litigò con il fratello minore, che gli uomini invece li detesta, e uscì dal bosco: girovagando finì a Mayroon. A furia di guidare i viaggiatori sperduti nella tormenta si è guadagnato il culto di qualche zona, ma resta un dio piuttosto minore.

jp: 神の欠片を宿す巨大なムカデ。欠片は毒と死者の守護神のものだったらしいが、そんなことはお構いなしに力に溺れて暴れまわる。人間にチヤホヤされている白銀龍蟲のことが嫌い。
jp_grezzo: "神の欠片を宿す巨大なムカデ。欠片は毒と死者の守護神のものだったらしいが、そんなことはお構いなしに力に溺れて暴れまわる。人間にチヤホヤされている白銀龍蟲のことが嫌い。"
en: A giant centipede that harbors a piece of God. Apparently the pieces belonged to the guardian gods of venom and the dead but they don't care about that and go on a rampage drowning in power. It dislikes the white silver dragon bugs that are being flattered by humans.
en_grezzo: "A giant centipede that harbors a piece of God. Apparently the pieces belonged to the guardian gods of venom and the dead but they don't care about that and go on a rampage drowning in power. It dislikes the white silver dragon bugs that are being flattered by humans."
it: Un millepiedi gigantesco che porta in sé una scheggia di divinità. La scheggia pare fosse del nume che protegge i veleni e i morti, ma di questo a lui non importa niente: si ubriaca della forza e mette tutto a soqquadro. Non sopporta il millepiedi drago argenteo, che gli uomini si tengono caro.

jp: 束縛の悪魔から生まれたとされるワーム。ほぼ子供みたいなもの。特技は焦らしプレイであり、身動きの取れない獲物を少しずつ弱らせ、衰弱したところを頭から丸呑みにする。
jp_grezzo: "束縛の悪魔から生まれたとされるワーム。ほぼ子供みたいなもの。特技は焦らしプレイであり、身動きの取れない獲物を少しずつ弱らせ、衰弱したところを頭から丸呑みにする。"
en: The worm is said to have been born from the demons of bondage. It's almost like a child. Their specialty is playing with impatience weakening their sluggish prey bit by bit and swallowing them head first when they are exhausted.
en_grezzo: "The worm is said to have been born from the demons of bondage. It's almost like a child. Their specialty is playing with impatience weakening their sluggish prey bit by bit and swallowing them head first when they are exhausted."
it: Un verme che si dice nato dal demone dei vincoli. È poco più che un bambino. La specialità è farla lunga: prende la preda che non riesce a muoversi, la indebolisce un po' alla volta e, quando è allo stremo, se la inghiotte cominciando dalla testa.

jp: 遠目では丘と間違えられることもある、巨大なヒル。その巨躯のほとんどが吸った血なので、干からびるとかなり小さくなる。体型を維持するため必死に吸血する。
jp_grezzo: "遠目では丘と間違えられることもある、巨大なヒル。その巨躯のほとんどが吸った血なので、干からびるとかなり小さくなる。体型を維持するため必死に吸血する。"
en: A huge leech that could be mistaken for a hill at a distance. Since most of its massive frame is sucked blood it becomes quite small when it dries up. They desperately suck blood to maintain their body shape.
en_grezzo: "A huge leech that could be mistaken for a hill at a distance. Since most of its massive frame is sucked blood it becomes quite small when it dries up. They desperately suck blood to maintain their body shape."
it: Una sanguisuga gigantesca, che da lontano capita di scambiare per una collina. Quel corpaccione è quasi tutto sangue succhiato, e infatti quando si secca diventa piuttosto piccola. Per tenersi la linea succhia sangue con accanimento.

jp: 巨大な触手のような姿のワーム。側面から生えているのは伸縮自在の副触手であり、脚ではない。粘着質の副触手で獲物の身体をまさぐりつつ、じっくりと生き血を吸って殺す。
jp_grezzo: "巨大な触手のような姿のワーム。側面から生えているのは伸縮自在の副触手であり、脚ではない。粘着質の副触手で獲物の身体をまさぐりつつ、じっくりと生き血を吸って殺す。"
en: A worm that looks like a giant tentacle. Growing out of the sides are the elastic sub-tentacles not legs. They kill their prey with their sticky sub-tentacles slowly and deliberately sucking their lifeblood while pecking at their prey's body.
en_grezzo: "A worm that looks like a giant tentacle. Growing out of the sides are the elastic sub-tentacles not legs. They kill their prey with their sticky sub-tentacles slowly and deliberately sucking their lifeblood while pecking at their prey's body."
it: Un verme che ha l'aspetto di un tentacolo enorme. Quelli che gli spuntano ai fianchi sono tentacoli secondari, che si allungano e si accorciano a piacere, e non zampe. Con quei tentacoli appiccicosi palpa il corpo della preda e intanto, con tutta calma, le succhia il sangue fino a ucciderla.

jp: 自称、夜のエンターテイナー。仕える相手を次々に変え、骨抜きにして魔力を奪い取っていく悪魔のメイド。他のメイドたちに嫌われており、嫌味混じりに「魔女」と呼ばれている。チビなことが最大の悩み。
jp_grezzo: "自称、夜のエンターテイナー。仕える相手を次々に変え、骨抜きにして魔力を奪い取っていく悪魔のメイド。他のメイドたちに嫌われており、嫌味混じりに「魔女」と呼ばれている。チビなことが最大の悩み。"
en: She is a self-proclaimed night entertainer. A demon maid who transforms the partners she works with one after another stripping them of their bones and taking away their magical power. She is disliked by the other maids and is derisively referred to as a witch. Being small is her biggest annoyance.
en_grezzo: "She is a self-proclaimed night entertainer. A demon maid who transforms the partners she works with one after another stripping them of their bones and taking away their magical power. She is disliked by the other maids and is derisively referred to as a witch. Being small is her biggest annoyance."
it: Si presenta da sé come intrattenitrice della notte. È una cameriera demoniaca che cambia padrone uno dopo l'altro, lo riduce senza più volontà e gli porta via il potere magico. Le altre cameriere non la sopportano e la chiamano la strega, con tutto il veleno che ci sta dentro. Il suo cruccio più grande è essere bassa.

jp: エンタメイド・ウィッチビッチ
jp_grezzo: "エンタメイド・ウィッチビッチ"

jp: 悪魔のメイドたちを束ねる存在。いつも退屈している主人を楽しませるため、残虐ショーを披露する。特に拷問が得意で、人をさらってきてはペンチで爪や指や××や×××を容赦なくねじり切る。
jp_grezzo: "悪魔のメイドたちを束ねる存在。いつも退屈している主人を楽しませるため、残虐ショーを披露する。特に拷問が得意で、人をさらってきてはペンチで爪や指や××や×××を容赦なくねじり切る。"
en: She is the one who binds the demon maids. She puts on a savage show to entertain her master who is always bored. She is particularly good at torture and when she snatches people up she uses pliers to twist their nails fingers x's and x's without mercy.
en_grezzo: "She is the one who binds the demon maids. She puts on a savage show to entertain her master who is always bored. She is particularly good at torture and when she snatches people up she uses pliers to twist their nails fingers x's and x's without mercy."
it: È lei che tiene insieme le cameriere demoniache. Per divertire il padrone, che si annoia sempre, mette in scena spettacoli di crudeltà. La tortura in particolare le riesce benissimo: rapisce qualcuno e poi, con le pinze, gli stritola senza pietà le unghie, le dita, il xx e il xxx.

jp: エンタメイド・ペンチーフ
jp_grezzo: "エンタメイド・ペンチーフ"

jp: 料理を担当する悪魔のメイド。いつも退屈している主人を楽しませるため、残虐ショーを披露する。獲物を生きたまま惨たらしく解体調理してしまう。暇な時は活きのいい獲物を探している。
jp_grezzo: "料理を担当する悪魔のメイド。いつも退屈している主人を楽しませるため、残虐ショーを披露する。獲物を生きたまま惨たらしく解体調理してしまう。暇な時は活きのいい獲物を探している。"
en: A demon maid in charge of cooking. They put on a gruesome show to entertain their master who is always bored. They savagely butcher and cook their prey alive. In their spare time they are looking for a lively prey.
en_grezzo: "A demon maid in charge of cooking. They put on a gruesome show to entertain their master who is always bored. They savagely butcher and cook their prey alive. In their spare time they are looking for a lively prey."
it: La cameriera demoniaca che si occupa della cucina. Per divertire il padrone, che si annoia sempre, mette in scena spettacoli di crudeltà. La preda la fa a pezzi e la cucina viva, e nel modo più atroce che sa. Quando non ha da fare, va in giro a cercare prede belle vispe.

jp: エンタメイド・ザンコック
jp_grezzo: "エンタメイド・ザンコック"

jp: 掃除を担当する悪魔のメイド。いつも退屈している主人を楽しませるため、残虐ショーを披露する。掃除は掃除でも、「侵入者の掃除」のほうも担当している。
jp_grezzo: "掃除を担当する悪魔のメイド。いつも退屈している主人を楽しませるため、残虐ショーを披露する。掃除は掃除でも、「侵入者の掃除」のほうも担当している。"
en: A demon maid who is in charge of cleaning. She puts on a gruesome show to entertain her master who is always bored. I'm also in charge of cleaning up the intruders.
en_grezzo: "A demon maid who is in charge of cleaning. She puts on a gruesome show to entertain her master who is always bored. I'm also in charge of cleaning up the intruders."
it: La cameriera demoniaca che si occupa delle pulizie. Per divertire il padrone, che si annoia sempre, mette in scena spettacoli di crudeltà. Pulizie sì, ma si occupa anche di quell'altra pulizia: quella degli intrusi.

jp: エンタメイド・デスイーパー
jp_grezzo: "エンタメイド・デスイーパー"

jp: 洗濯を担当する悪魔のメイド。いつも退屈している主人を楽しませるため、残虐ショーを披露する。衣服を洗うよりも、血で血を洗うことのほうが多い。
jp_grezzo: "洗濯を担当する悪魔のメイド。いつも退屈している主人を楽しませるため、残虐ショーを披露する。衣服を洗うよりも、血で血を洗うことのほうが多い。"
en: A demon maid who is in charge of the laundry. They put on a gruesome show to entertain their master who is always bored. It is more about washing blood with blood than it is washing clothes.
en_grezzo: "A demon maid who is in charge of the laundry. They put on a gruesome show to entertain their master who is always bored. It is more about washing blood with blood than it is washing clothes."
it: La cameriera demoniaca che si occupa del bucato. Per divertire il padrone, che si annoia sempre, mette in scena spettacoli di crudeltà. Più che lavare i panni, però, le capita di lavare il sangue col sangue.

jp: エンタメイド・ブラッドレス
jp_grezzo: "エンタメイド・ブラッドレス"

jp: 魔王に仕えるインプの兵士。忠実で従順だが、面白みがない堅物ぞろいなので扱いは不遇。本人たちも気にしているのだが、不器用なのでどうしようもないらしい。
jp_grezzo: "魔王に仕えるインプの兵士。忠実で従順だが、面白みがない堅物ぞろいなので扱いは不遇。本人たちも気にしているのだが、不器用なのでどうしようもないらしい。"
en: An imp soldier in the service of the Demon King. They are loyal and obedient but they don't deserve to be treated well because they are an uninteresting bunch of stiffs. They are concerned about it but they are awkward and can't do anything about it.
en_grezzo: "An imp soldier in the service of the Demon King. They are loyal and obedient but they don't deserve to be treated well because they are an uninteresting bunch of stiffs. They are concerned about it but they are awkward and can't do anything about it."
it: Un soldato folletto al servizio del re dei demoni. È fedele e obbediente, ma di trattamento ne riceve poco: sono tutti tipi rigidi e senza un briciolo di spirito. Anche a loro la cosa pesa, solo che sono impacciati e non ci sanno fare niente.

jp: 弱ったヴァンパイアを身体ごと養分として吸収した結果、生物の血を啜る快楽に目覚めた南瓜の怪物。取り入れた血により自らを異常成長させ、さらなる獲物を狙う。
jp_grezzo: "弱ったヴァンパイアを身体ごと養分として吸収した結果、生物の血を啜る快楽に目覚めた南瓜の怪物。取り入れた血により自らを異常成長させ、さらなる獲物を狙う。"
en: As a result of absorbing the weakened vampire's entire body as nourishment the pumpkin monster has awakened to the pleasure of drinking a creature's blood. The blood he has taken in causes him to grow abnormally and he targets more prey.
en_grezzo: "As a result of absorbing the weakened vampire's entire body as nourishment the pumpkin monster has awakened to the pleasure of drinking a creature's blood. The blood he has taken in causes him to grow abnormally and he targets more prey."
it: Un mostro di zucca che, avendo assorbito come nutrimento un vampiro indebolito, corpo compreso, si è risvegliato al piacere di succhiare il sangue delle creature. Con il sangue che si prende si fa crescere in modo abnorme, e poi punta la preda successiva.

jp: キャロットに似たマンドレイクの一種。どこで習得したのか忍の技を身に着けているが、忍ぶつもりはさらさらない。後先考えず突っ走る癖がある。
jp_grezzo: "キャロットに似たマンドレイクの一種。どこで習得したのか忍の技を身に着けているが、忍ぶつもりはさらさらない。後先考えず突っ走る癖がある。"
en: A type of mandrake that resembles a carrot. He is armed with ninja skills which he learned at some point but he has no intention of becoming a ninja. He has a habit of going ahead and not thinking ahead.
