en_grezzo: "A type of mandrake that resembles a carrot. He is armed with ninja skills which he learned at some point but he has no intention of becoming a ninja. He has a habit of going ahead and not thinking ahead."
it: Una specie di mandragora che somiglia a una carota. Le arti ninja le ha addosso, anche se non si sa dove le abbia imparate, ma di nascondersi non ha la minima intenzione. Ha il vizio di partire in quarta senza pensare a quel che viene dopo.

jp: 武人の魂を宿した勇猛なキュウリ。伝説生物カッパはこのキュウリの抵抗にあい滅んだことにされている。だが実際は食料不足で人里を荒らすようになったため人間に滅ぼされたのである。
jp_grezzo: "武人の魂を宿した勇猛なキュウリ。伝説生物カッパはこのキュウリの抵抗にあい滅んだことにされている。だが実際は食料不足で人里を荒らすようになったため人間に滅ぼされたのである。"
en: A brave cucumber with the soul of a warrior. It is believed that the legendary creature Kappa perished due to the resistance of these cucumber species. In reality however they were destroyed by humans because of a shortage of food which caused them to wreak havoc in the countryside.
en_grezzo: "A brave cucumber with the soul of a warrior. It is believed that the legendary creature Kappa perished due to the resistance of these cucumber species. In reality however they were destroyed by humans because of a shortage of food which caused them to wreak havoc in the countryside."
it: Un cetriolo valoroso, con dentro l'anima di un guerriero. Si racconta che il kappa, creatura leggendaria, si sia estinto per la resistenza di questi cetrioli. In verità furono gli uomini a sterminarlo: mancava il cibo, e il kappa aveva preso a devastare i villaggi.

jp: キュウリに自我が宿ったモンスター。夏になると亡霊を乗せて冥界からやってくるとされる。関節のない短い脚を懸命に動かして走る。走り続けると、汗で水分がどんどん抜けていく。
jp_grezzo: "キュウリに自我が宿ったモンスター。夏になると亡霊を乗せて冥界からやってくるとされる。関節のない短い脚を懸命に動かして走る。走り続けると、汗で水分がどんどん抜けていく。"
en: A monster with an ego in a cucumber. It comes from the underworld with a ghost on its back in the summer. It runs with its short legs moving hard.
en_grezzo: "A monster with an ego in a cucumber. It comes from the underworld with a ghost on its back in the summer. It runs with its short legs moving hard."
it: Un mostro nato quando in un cetriolo è germogliata una coscienza. Si dice che d'estate arrivi dall'oltretomba portando in groppa un'anima. Corre agitando con accanimento le zampe corte, che non hanno articolazioni. E se corre a lungo, il sudore gli porta via l'acqua un po' alla volta.

jp: 皮を剥いたゴボウで生物の太ももあたりを叩く習性がある、意味不明な魔物。ゴボウの恨みを晴らすための儀式だとも、「お前の足ゴボウみたいだな」という挑発だとも言われているが、真相は不明。
jp_grezzo: "皮を剥いたゴボウで生物の太ももあたりを叩く習性がある、意味不明な魔物。ゴボウの恨みを晴らすための儀式だとも、「お前の足ゴボウみたいだな」という挑発だとも言われているが、真相は不明。"
en: A monster with its soul in a cucumber. It is said that they come from the underworld in the summer with ghosts. They run hard on their short arthritic legs. If they keep running they''ll lose more and more water through sweat.
en_grezzo: "A monster with its soul in a cucumber. It is said that they come from the underworld in the summer with ghosts. They run hard on their short arthritic legs. If they keep running they''ll lose more and more water through sweat."
it: Un mostro dal senso oscuro, che ha l'abitudine di picchiare le creature all'altezza della coscia con una bardana sbucciata. C'è chi dice che sia un rito per vendicare le bardane e chi dice che sia una provocazione, come a dire: le tue gambe sembrano due bardane. Come stiano davvero le cose, non si sa.

jp: 個人の記憶も、他人からの記憶も全て失った者の末路。彼らが何者だったのか、もうこの世界の誰にもわからない。本人の思考力が生まれたての赤ん坊と変わらないのがせめてもの救い。
jp_grezzo: "個人の記憶も、他人からの記憶も全て失った者の末路。彼らが何者だったのか、もうこの世界の誰にもわからない。本人の思考力が生まれたての赤ん坊と変わらないのがせめてもの救い。"
en: The end of a person who has lost all of his or her personal memories and those of others. Who they were no one in this world knows anymore. The only thing I can say is that his thinking ability is the same as that of a newborn baby.
en_grezzo: "The end of a person who has lost all of his or her personal memories and those of others. Who they were no one in this world knows anymore. The only thing I can say is that his thinking ability is the same as that of a newborn baby."
it: È il punto d'arrivo di chi ha perso tutto: la memoria propria e la memoria che gli altri avevano di lui. Chi fosse, ormai in questo mondo non lo sa più nessuno. L'unica consolazione è che la sua testa non ragiona più di quella di un neonato.

jp: 嫌な記憶を自他ともに消せる、その魅力に憑りつかれてしまった人々。少しでも苦しみや煩わしさを感じれば消してしまうのだとか。そんな生き方には、破滅しか待っていないような気がする。
jp_grezzo: "嫌な記憶を自他ともに消せる、その魅力に憑りつかれてしまった人々。少しでも苦しみや煩わしさを感じれば消してしまうのだとか。そんな生き方には、破滅しか待っていないような気がする。"
en: People who have become obsessed with the allure of being able to erase unpleasant memories of themselves and others. He said that if he feels even the slightest bit of pain or annoyance he will turn it off. I feel that there is nothing but ruin awaiting them in such a way of life.
en_grezzo: "People who have become obsessed with the allure of being able to erase unpleasant memories of themselves and others. He said that if he feels even the slightest bit of pain or annoyance he will turn it off. I feel that there is nothing but ruin awaiting them in such a way of life."
it: Gente rimasta invischiata nel fascino di poter cancellare i ricordi sgradevoli, i propri e quelli altrui. Pare che basti un filo di sofferenza o di fastidio perché lo cancellino. A vivere così, viene da pensare che non ci sia in serbo altro che la rovina.

jp: あふれ出る狂気を抑えられず、絶えず顔面を掻き毟り、髪を振り乱し、獣のようにうめき声を発する。人としての知性は残っておらず、とある富豪にはライオンのようだとまで言われた。
jp_grezzo: "あふれ出る狂気を抑えられず、絶えず顔面を掻き毟り、髪を振り乱し、獣のようにうめき声を発する。人としての知性は残っておらず、とある富豪にはライオンのようだとまで言われた。"
en: Unable to contain the overflowing madness he constantly scratches his face shakes his hair and moans like a beast. He had no human intelligence left and was even described by some affluent people as being like a lion.
en_grezzo: "Unable to contain the overflowing madness he constantly scratches his face shakes his hair and moans like a beast. He had no human intelligence left and was even described by some affluent people as being like a lion."
it: Non riesce a trattenere la follia che gli trabocca fuori: si gratta la faccia fino a scorticarsela, si scompiglia i capelli e geme come una bestia. Di intelligenza umana non gliene resta, e un certo riccone arrivò a dire che sembrava un leone.

jp: 瀕死の魔獣が、その辺にいた婦人に勝手に憑りついた姿。記憶を消去して人格を乗っ取っている。この世界の記憶を全て消すのが任務であり、そのためにも失った力を取り戻そうと暗躍している。
jp_grezzo: "瀕死の魔獣が、その辺にいた婦人に勝手に憑りついた姿。記憶を消去して人格を乗っ取っている。この世界の記憶を全て消すのが任務であり、そのためにも失った力を取り戻そうと暗躍している。"
en: A dying monster possessed a woman who was nearby. They are erasing memories and hijacking personalities. She is on a mission to erase all memories of this world and to do so she is plotting to regain her lost power.
en_grezzo: "A dying monster possessed a woman who was nearby. They are erasing memories and hijacking personalities. She is on a mission to erase all memories of this world and to do so she is plotting to regain her lost power."
it: È una belva magica in fin di vita che si è impossessata, senza chiedere permesso, di una signora che passava di lì. Le ha cancellato la memoria e le ha preso il posto. La sua missione è cancellare tutti i ricordi di questo mondo, e per riuscirci trama nell'ombra per riprendersi la forza che ha perduto.

jp: 蒼い鎧を身に着けた鳥人。鎧には鳥の神の力を宿しているらしい。高速接近し、破壊の光を放ち、舞うように剣で敵を切り裂く。その猛々しさから、一部の地域では神同然の扱いを受けている。
jp_grezzo: "蒼い鎧を身に着けた鳥人。鎧には鳥の神の力を宿しているらしい。高速接近し、破壊の光を放ち、舞うように剣で敵を切り裂く。その猛々しさから、一部の地域では神同然の扱いを受けている。"
en: A bird-man wearing blue armor. It seems that the armor contains the power of the bird deity. Approaching at high speed it unleashes a destructive beam of light slashing through the enemy with its sword as it soars. Because of its ferocity it has been called a god in some parts of the world.
en_grezzo: "A bird-man wearing blue armor. It seems that the armor contains the power of the bird deity. Approaching at high speed it unleashes a destructive beam of light slashing through the enemy with its sword as it soars. Because of its ferocity it has been called a god in some parts of the world."
it: Un uomo uccello che porta un'armatura azzurra. Nell'armatura, a quanto pare, abita la forza del dio degli uccelli. Si avvicina a gran velocità, scaglia una luce che distrugge e squarcia il nemico con la spada come se danzasse. Per quanto è fiero, in certe zone lo trattano alla pari di un dio.

jp: 天上に住む半人半鳥の魔物。情緒不安定で、嫌なことがあると泣きながら恐ろしい歌を歌い、八つ当たりで地獄に堕ちた魂に永遠の罰を与える。カラヴィカより自分の方が歌が上手いと思っている。
jp_grezzo: "天上に住む半人半鳥の魔物。情緒不安定で、嫌なことがあると泣きながら恐ろしい歌を歌い、八つ当たりで地獄に堕ちた魂に永遠の罰を与える。カラヴィカより自分の方が歌が上手いと思っている。"
en: A half-human half-bird demon that dwells in the sky. They''re emotionally unstable crying and singing horrible songs when they don't want to and inflicting eternal punishment on souls damned to hell to vent. They think they can sing better than Karavika.
en_grezzo: "A half-human half-bird demon that dwells in the sky. They''re emotionally unstable crying and singing horrible songs when they don't want to and inflicting eternal punishment on souls damned to hell to vent. They think they can sing better than Karavika."
it: Un mostro metà uomo e metà uccello che abita nei cieli. Ha l'umore instabile: se qualcosa non le va, piange e intanto canta canzoni spaventose, e per sfogarsi infligge alle anime cadute all'inferno un castigo eterno. È convinta di cantare meglio di Karavika.

jp: 翼までも覆う黒い鎧を身に着けた鳥人の拳闘士。自分の拳にやたら自信があるようで、自分より強い相手にも平気で殴りかかる。戦闘で破壊されないような、もっと強固な鎧が欲しいと思っている。
jp_grezzo: "翼までも覆う黒い鎧を身に着けた鳥人の拳闘士。自分の拳にやたら自信があるようで、自分より強い相手にも平気で殴りかかる。戦闘で破壊されないような、もっと強固な鎧が欲しいと思っている。"
en: A bird-man brawler wearing black armor that covers even his wings. He seems to have a lot of confidence in his fists and he doesn't mind striking out at opponents stronger than him. He wants more solid armor that won't be destroyed in battle.
en_grezzo: "A bird-man brawler wearing black armor that covers even his wings. He seems to have a lot of confidence in his fists and he doesn't mind striking out at opponents stronger than him. He wants more solid armor that won't be destroyed in battle."
it: Un pugile uomo uccello, con addosso un'armatura nera che gli copre perfino le ali. Nei propri pugni ha una fiducia smisurata, e mena le mani senza battere ciglio anche contro chi è più forte di lui. Vorrebbe un'armatura più solida, di quelle che in battaglia non si sfasciano.

jp: 恋も知らずに幼くして死んだ少女の魂が転生したもの。獲物を誘惑し、油断したところを攻撃する。頭部を砕いて脳髄を吸うのが好き、となかなかにアグレッシブ。
jp_grezzo: "恋も知らずに幼くして死んだ少女の魂が転生したもの。獲物を誘惑し、油断したところを攻撃する。頭部を砕いて脳髄を吸うのが好き、となかなかにアグレッシブ。"
en: The reincarnation of the soul of a girl who died at an early age without knowing love. They lure their prey and attack them when they are caught off guard. They like to crush the head and suck the brain tissue and they are quite aggressive.
en_grezzo: "The reincarnation of the soul of a girl who died at an early age without knowing love. They lure their prey and attack them when they are caught off guard. They like to crush the head and suck the brain tissue and they are quite aggressive."
it: È l'anima di una ragazza morta da piccola senza aver conosciuto l'amore, tornata al mondo in un altro corpo. Seduce la preda e la colpisce appena abbassa la guardia. Le piace fracassare la testa e succhiarne il midollo: piuttosto aggressiva, insomma.

jp: 食べ歩きと剣客商売をしながら様々な星を渡り歩く剣士。普通の腕の他に、肩から伸びる２本の触手を用いて戦う。根っからの戦闘種族なのだが、性格は呑気。胃酸が特殊で、幻覚成分を含むゲップが出る。
jp_grezzo: "食べ歩きと剣客商売をしながら様々な星を渡り歩く剣士。普通の腕の他に、肩から伸びる２本の触手を用いて戦う。根っからの戦闘種族なのだが、性格は呑気。胃酸が特殊で、幻覚成分を含むゲップが出る。"
en: A swordsman who travels the various stars while eating and peddling swords. In addition to his normal arms he fights with two tentacles that extend from his shoulders. He is a warrior at heart but his personality is a bit of a drinker. Stomach acid is special and burps with a hallucinogenic component.
en_grezzo: "A swordsman who travels the various stars while eating and peddling swords. In addition to his normal arms he fights with two tentacles that extend from his shoulders. He is a warrior at heart but his personality is a bit of a drinker. Stomach acid is special and burps with a hallucinogenic component."
it: Uno spadaccino che gira di stella in stella mangiando dove capita e vendendo la lama a chi paga. Oltre alle braccia normali combatte con due tentacoli che gli escono dalle spalle. È di stirpe guerriera fino al midollo, ma di carattere se la prende con calma. Ha i succhi gastrici particolari, e i rutti gli vengono con dentro una sostanza che dà allucinazioni.

jp: 宇宙剣客『ベルファート』
波動を操る力を身に着けた竜人の戦士。すさまじい戦闘力を誇るが、なぜそんな力が身についたのか、そもそも何の波動なのか、本人もよくわかっていない。
jp_grezzo: "波動を操る力を身に着けた竜人の戦士。すさまじい戦闘力を誇るが、なぜそんな力が身についたのか、そもそも何の波動なのか、本人もよくわかっていない。"
en: A dragon warrior who has acquired the power to manipulate wave motion. He boasts tremendous fighting power but even he doesn't know how he got this power or what the waves are in the first place.
en_grezzo: "A dragon warrior who has acquired the power to manipulate wave motion. He boasts tremendous fighting power but even he doesn't know how he got this power or what the waves are in the first place."
it: Un guerriero uomo lucertola che ha imparato a manovrare le onde. Vanta una potenza di combattimento spaventosa, ma come gli sia venuta quella forza, e soprattutto onde di che cosa siano, non l'ha capito bene nemmeno lui.

jp: 体温が上がらないとテンションが上がらないので、周囲の熱を吸収して冷気に変えて放出する。複数体集まれば熱い地域にも吹雪を起こせるほどになる。
jp_grezzo: "体温が上がらないとテンションが上がらないので、周囲の熱を吸収して冷気に変えて放出する。複数体集まれば熱い地域にも吹雪を起こせるほどになる。"
en: When their body temperature doesn't rise their tension doesn't rise so they absorb the heat around them turn it into cold air and release it. If you collect more than one of them it's enough to cause a blizzard in a hot area.
en_grezzo: "When their body temperature doesn't rise their tension doesn't rise so they absorb the heat around them turn it into cold air and release it. If you collect more than one of them it's enough to cause a blizzard in a hot area."
it: Se non le sale la temperatura del corpo non le sale nemmeno l'umore, e allora assorbe il calore che ha intorno, lo trasforma in aria gelida e la butta fuori. Se se ne mettono insieme parecchie, arrivano a scatenare una tormenta perfino in una regione calda.

jp: 大剣を振るうパワフルな竜人。大剣のずっしりとした重さが好き。自分の腕に自信を持っており、ドラゴンと戦ったりドラゴンハンターと戦ったりと見境がない。
jp_grezzo: "大剣を振るうパワフルな竜人。大剣のずっしりとした重さが好き。自分の腕に自信を持っており、ドラゴンと戦ったりドラゴンハンターと戦ったりと見境がない。"
en: A powerful dragon man wielding a greatsword. He likes the sturdy weight of the greatsword. He is confident in his skills and has no reservations when it comes to fighting dragons and dragon hunters.
en_grezzo: "A powerful dragon man wielding a greatsword. He likes the sturdy weight of the greatsword. He is confident in his skills and has no reservations when it comes to fighting dragons and dragon hunters."
it: Un uomo lucertola pieno di forza, che maneggia uno spadone. Gli piace il peso pieno che ha lo spadone. Del proprio braccio è sicuro, e non fa distinzioni: se la prende con i draghi come con i cacciatori di draghi.

jp: 竜人の暗殺者。竜人限定の暗殺者ギルドを作り、一族の脅威となる者を暗殺して回っている。シッポが邪魔で群衆に紛れることができないため、ステルス能力のある服を愛用している。
jp_grezzo: "竜人の暗殺者。竜人限定の暗殺者ギルドを作り、一族の脅威となる者を暗殺して回っている。シッポが邪魔で群衆に紛れることができないため、ステルス能力のある服を愛用している。"
en: Assassin of the Dragon Man. They have formed an assassin's guild for dragon people only and they go around assassinating those who pose a threat to the clan. Their tails are in the way and they can't blend in with the crowd so they prefer clothes with stealthy abilities.
en_grezzo: "Assassin of the Dragon Man. They have formed an assassin's guild for dragon people only and they go around assassinating those who pose a threat to the clan. Their tails are in the way and they can't blend in with the crowd so they prefer clothes with stealthy abilities."
it: L'assassino degli uomini lucertola. Hanno messo su una gilda di assassini riservata alla loro gente, e vanno in giro a togliere di mezzo chi minaccia la stirpe. La coda è ingombrante e non permette di confondersi nella folla, e per questo portano volentieri abiti che aiutano a non farsi vedere.

jp: 火を吐くことに憧れ、火炎の力を身に着けようとして全身の鱗が熱で焦げるほどの修行をした。結局ダメだったことに絶望して性格が歪んでしまい、結果的に吐けるようになったのは毒だけだった。
jp_grezzo: "火を吐くことに憧れ、火炎の力を身に着けようとして全身の鱗が熱で焦げるほどの修行をした。結局ダメだったことに絶望して性格が歪んでしまい、結果的に吐けるようになったのは毒だけだった。"
en: He longed to breathe fire and cultivated so much that the scales on his entire body burned with heat in an attempt to acquire the power of the flame. In the end his personality was warped in despair that it didn't work and the only thing that resulted in him being able to throw up was poison.
en_grezzo: "He longed to breathe fire and cultivated so much that the scales on his entire body burned with heat in an attempt to acquire the power of the flame. In the end his personality was warped in despair that it didn't work and the only thing that resulted in him being able to throw up was poison."
it: Sognava di sputare fuoco, e per impadronirsi della forza della fiamma si sottopose a un tirocinio tale che il calore gli bruciacchiò le scaglie su tutto il corpo. Alla fine non ci riuscì, la disperazione gli storse il carattere, e l'unica cosa che ha finito per saper sputare è il veleno.
il drago velenoso dalle scaglie nere

jp: 頑張って魔法を身に着けた竜人。とはいえ肉体がもともと強靭なので、魔法攻撃よりも物理攻撃のほうが強い。そのことに長い間葛藤した結果、補助魔法を使う形に落ち着いた。
jp_grezzo: "頑張って魔法を身に着けた竜人。とはいえ肉体がもともと強靭なので、魔法攻撃よりも物理攻撃のほうが強い。そのことに長い間葛藤した結果、補助魔法を使う形に落ち着いた。"
en: The dragon man has worked hard to acquire magic. However since his body is strong to begin with his physical attacks are more powerful than his magical attacks. After struggling with that for a long time he settled on using auxiliary magic.
en_grezzo: "The dragon man has worked hard to acquire magic. However since his body is strong to begin with his physical attacks are more powerful than his magical attacks. After struggling with that for a long time he settled on using auxiliary magic."
it: Un uomo lucertola che a furia di impegnarsi si è impadronito della magia. Solo che il corpo ce l'ha robusto in partenza, e quindi gli attacchi fisici gli riescono meglio di quelli magici. Dopo essersi tormentato a lungo sulla faccenda, si è accomodato sulle magie di sostegno.

jp: 妖精族に危機迫る時、光の衣を纏って泉から生まれるという伝説の妖精。ただし他種族の台頭により、ここ数百年断続的に生まれてきている。本人たちは希少性の低下に悩んでいる模様。
jp_grezzo: "妖精族に危機迫る時、光の衣を纏って泉から生まれるという伝説の妖精。ただし他種族の台頭により、ここ数百年断続的に生まれてきている。本人たちは希少性の低下に悩んでいる模様。"
en: Legend has it that when a fairy tribe was threatened she was born from a spring clothed in a robe of light. However due to the rise of other races they have been born sporadically over the past few hundred years. They are suffering from diminishing numbers.
en_grezzo: "Legend has it that when a fairy tribe was threatened she was born from a spring clothed in a robe of light. However due to the rise of other races they have been born sporadically over the past few hundred years. They are suffering from diminishing numbers."
it: La fata leggendaria che, quando sul popolo delle fate incombe il pericolo, nasce dalla sorgente avvolta in una veste di luce. Solo che, con le altre stirpi che avanzano, negli ultimi secoli continua a nascerne una ogni tanto senza mai smettere. Pare che a loro dispiaccia parecchio essere diventate meno rare.

jp: 赤く燃えているくらいで、見た目こそ普通の妖精とそう変わらないが、通常の妖精の6000倍以上の質量を持つ。ものすごい勢いで特攻してくるので、頑張って避けよう。
jp_grezzo: "赤く燃えているくらいで、見た目こそ普通の妖精とそう変わらないが、通常の妖精の6000倍以上の質量を持つ。ものすごい勢いで特攻してくるので、頑張って避けよう。"
en: It burns red and although it looks no different from a normal fairy it has more than 6000 times the mass of a normal fairy. It attacks with great force so try your best to avoid it.
en_grezzo: "It burns red and although it looks no different from a normal fairy it has more than 6000 times the mass of a normal fairy. It attacks with great force so try your best to avoid it."
it: A parte il fatto che brucia di rosso, all'aspetto non è tanto diversa da una fata comune; solo che ha una massa oltre seimila volte quella di una fata normale. Ti si butta addosso con una violenza tremenda, quindi mettici tutto l'impegno che hai per schivarla.

jp: 火の元素から生まれた妖精。その証拠に火の魔法が使える。男は威厳があり、女は美しいとされる。ほぼ人間と同じサイズであり、人間と結婚することも珍しくない。
jp_grezzo: "火の元素から生まれた妖精。その証拠に火の魔法が使える。男は威厳があり、女は美しいとされる。ほぼ人間と同じサイズであり、人間と結婚することも珍しくない。"
en: A fairy born of the fire element. To prove it it will use fire magic. Men are said to be dignified and women are said to be beautiful. They are almost the same size as humans and it is not uncommon for them to marry humans.
en_grezzo: "A fairy born of the fire element. To prove it it will use fire magic. Men are said to be dignified and women are said to be beautiful. They are almost the same size as humans and it is not uncommon for them to marry humans."
it: Una fata nata dall'elemento del fuoco. La prova è che sa usare la magia del fuoco. I maschi passano per solenni, le femmine per bellissime. Sono grandi pressappoco come una persona, e non è raro che sposino un umano.

jp: 先天的な病気で、成長抑制因子が正常に機能しなかった妖精。人間大にまで成長してしまい、やむなく妖精の里から出るはめになった。魔法も上手く使えないので、専ら人間用の弓などで戦う。
jp_grezzo: "先天的な病気で、成長抑制因子が正常に機能しなかった妖精。人間大にまで成長してしまい、やむなく妖精の里から出るはめになった。魔法も上手く使えないので、専ら人間用の弓などで戦う。"
en: A fairy with a congenital disease that prevented its growth inhibitors from functioning properly. They have grown to the size of a human and have had to leave the fairy home. They can''t use magic very well so they fight with human bows.
en_grezzo: "A fairy with a congenital disease that prevented its growth inhibitors from functioning properly. They have grown to the size of a human and have had to leave the fairy home. They can''t use magic very well so they fight with human bows."
it: Una fata a cui, per una malattia di nascita, il fattore che frena la crescita non ha funzionato come doveva. È cresciuta fino alla taglia di una persona, e si è vista costretta ad andarsene dal villaggio delle fate. La magia le riesce male, e perciò combatte con archi e simili, di quelli fatti per gli uomini.

jp: 洗礼を受けずに死んだ子供の魂が転生したものとされる。人間にいたずらをするのが大好きだが、義理堅く仕事熱心な性格。月光を浴びながら集団で踊る。
jp_grezzo: "洗礼を受けずに死んだ子供の魂が転生したものとされる。人間にいたずらをするのが大好きだが、義理堅く仕事熱心な性格。月光を浴びながら集団で踊る。"
en: It is said to be the reincarnation of the soul of an unbaptized and dead child. They love to play pranks on humans but they are loyal and hardworking. They dance in groups while basking in the moonlight.
en_grezzo: "It is said to be the reincarnation of the soul of an unbaptized and dead child. They love to play pranks on humans but they are loyal and hardworking. They dance in groups while basking in the moonlight."
it: Si dice che sia l'anima di un bambino morto senza battesimo, tornata al mondo in un altro corpo. Adora fare scherzi agli uomini, ma è di parola e sul lavoro ci si mette d'impegno. Danza in gruppo sotto la luce della luna.

jp: 奇跡的に人格を取り戻したが、肉体的には既に人外。肉体制御によって人間だった頃の姿を再現しているにすぎない。兄による外部神経調整でメシェーラの影響をどうにか抑え込んでいる。
jp_grezzo: "奇跡的に人格を取り戻したが、肉体的には既に人外。肉体制御によって人間だった頃の姿を再現しているにすぎない。兄による外部神経調整でメシェーラの影響をどうにか抑え込んでいる。"
en: She has miraculously regained her personality but she is already physically out of her element. She is merely recreating what she looked like when she was human through bodily control. External neural adjustments by her brother somewhat suppressed Meshera's influence.
en_grezzo: "She has miraculously regained her personality but she is already physically out of her element. She is merely recreating what she looked like when she was human through bodily control. External neural adjustments by her brother somewhat suppressed Meshera's influence."
it: Per miracolo si è ripresa la propria persona, ma il corpo ormai non è più di questo mondo: la figura che aveva da umana la ricostruisce soltanto controllando la carne. L'influenza di Meshera riesce a tenerla a bada alla meglio, grazie alla regolazione nervosa che il fratello le fa dall'esterno.

jp: 抑圧されし災厄『レナイ』
階級以上の実力を持つが、上司のパワハラを受けてなかなか昇進できない。現在は労働環境の改善を求めてストライキ中。最近はいっそ悪魔陣営からのスカウトに応じようかなとも考えている。
jp_grezzo: "階級以上の実力を持つが、上司のパワハラを受けてなかなか昇進できない。現在は労働環境の改善を求めてストライキ中。最近はいっそ悪魔陣営からのスカウトに応じようかなとも考えている。"
en: He has the ability to be above his rank but is unable to get promoted due to power harassment from his boss. They are currently on strike for better working conditions. Recently he's been thinking about accepting scouts from the Demon Squad.
en_grezzo: "He has the ability to be above his rank but is unable to get promoted due to power harassment from his boss. They are currently on strike for better working conditions. Recently he's been thinking about accepting scouts from the Demon Squad."
it: Ha una forza superiore al suo grado, ma il capo lo vessa e la promozione non arriva mai. Al momento è in sciopero per ottenere condizioni di lavoro migliori. Negli ultimi tempi va pensando che tanto vale accettare l'offerta che gli è arrivata dalla parte dei demoni.

jp: キューピッドたちが適正な恋愛成就活動をしているか、監督査察するのが役目。昔は割となあなあでやっていたが、近年はトラブルが表面化してきたため、厳しくなりつつある。
jp_grezzo: "キューピッドたちが適正な恋愛成就活動をしているか、監督査察するのが役目。昔は割となあなあでやっていたが、近年はトラブルが表面化してきたため、厳しくなりつつある。"
en: The role is to supervise Cupid and the others to make sure that they are doing their best to achieve love. In the past they used to be able to do it with ease but in recent years they have become more strict because of the troubles that have come to the surface.
en_grezzo: "The role is to supervise Cupid and the others to make sure that they are doing their best to achieve love. In the past they used to be able to do it with ease but in recent years they have become more strict because of the troubles that have come to the surface."
it: Il suo compito è sorvegliare e ispezionare i cupidi, per controllare che facciano nascere gli amori come si deve. Un tempo la cosa si faceva alla buona, ma negli ultimi anni sono venuti a galla dei guai e la mano si è fatta più dura.

jp: 一人前の天使を目指している。競争社会に放り込まれ、勝ち抜いたエリートだけが正天使になれるのだが、その先にも辛いことや苦しいことやとても辛いことや死ぬほど苦しいことが待っていることを知らない。
jp_grezzo: "一人前の天使を目指している。競争社会に放り込まれ、勝ち抜いたエリートだけが正天使になれるのだが、その先にも辛いことや苦しいことやとても辛いことや死ぬほど苦しいことが待っていることを知らない。"
en: He aims to be a full-fledged angel. Only the elite who are thrown into a competitive society and win out can become true angels but they don't know that there will be pain hardship extreme hardship and even deathly hardship ahead.
en_grezzo: "He aims to be a full-fledged angel. Only the elite who are thrown into a competitive society and win out can become true angels but they don't know that there will be pain hardship extreme hardship and even deathly hardship ahead."
it: Punta a diventare un angelo fatto e finito. Lo hanno buttato in una società di concorrenza, e angelo vero diventa solo chi la spunta e arriva in cima; ma quello che lo aspetta dopo non lo sa ancora: dolori, pene, dolori grossi e pene da morire.

jp: 蛙の神。戦闘力は大したことないのだが、天災を予知する天才と呼ばれ近年まで崇められてきた。あまりに心配性なため、自分の身に危険が迫ると発狂して暴れだす。
jp_grezzo: "蛙の神。戦闘力は大したことないのだが、天災を予知する天才と呼ばれ近年まで崇められてきた。あまりに心配性なため、自分の身に危険が迫ると発狂して暴れだす。"
en: God of frogs. Although he is not a great fighter he has been called a genius at predicting natural disasters and has been revered until recently. He is so anxious that when he is in danger he goes crazy and goes on a rampage.
en_grezzo: "God of frogs. Although he is not a great fighter he has been called a genius at predicting natural disasters and has been revered until recently. He is so anxious that when he is in danger he goes crazy and goes on a rampage."
it: Il dio delle rane. Come forza di combattimento non vale granché, ma lo chiamavano il genio che prevede le calamità naturali e fino a poco tempo fa lo veneravano. È così apprensivo che, appena si sente il pericolo addosso, dà di matto e comincia a devastare tutto.

jp: 熱利用攻撃を得意とするが、非戦闘時には身体に熱がこもってしまう。普段は当たりかまわず熱を発散し、寝る時は冷却のため水中の巣に帰る。見た目のせいで溶岩の中に住んでいるとよく誤解される。
jp_grezzo: "熱利用攻撃を得意とするが、非戦闘時には身体に熱がこもってしまう。普段は当たりかまわず熱を発散し、寝る時は冷却のため水中の巣に帰る。見た目のせいで溶岩の中に住んでいるとよく誤解される。"
en: It specializes in using heat to attack but when it is not in combat its body becomes feverish. Normally they radiate heat without incident and when they sleep they return to their underwater nests for cooling. It is often misunderstood that they live in lava because of their appearance.
en_grezzo: "It specializes in using heat to attack but when it is not in combat its body becomes feverish. Normally they radiate heat without incident and when they sleep they return to their underwater nests for cooling. It is often misunderstood that they live in lava because of their appearance."
it: È bravissima ad attaccare sfruttando il calore, ma quando non combatte il calore le resta chiuso dentro il corpo. Di solito lo sfoga addosso a chiunque le capiti a tiro, e per dormire torna nella tana sott'acqua a raffreddarsi. Per via dell'aspetto, spesso si crede per sbaglio che viva dentro la lava.

jp: 沼の王と呼ばれる巨大生物。その正体はメルカサラマンダーが先祖帰りを起こした姿。ぬおーっとした雰囲気に似合わず、力がやたら強い。素揚げにすると結構イケるとのことで、珍味として売られる場合も。
jp_grezzo: "沼の王と呼ばれる巨大生物。その正体はメルカサラマンダーが先祖帰りを起こした姿。ぬおーっとした雰囲気に似合わず、力がやたら強い。素揚げにすると結構イケるとのことで、珍味として売られる場合も。"
en: A giant creature called the King of the Swamp. Its true identity is the shape of the Melka Salamander that caused the ancestral return. It doesn't suit the languid atmosphere but it has a lot of power. It is said that it is quite good when deep-fried without sauce and sometimes it is sold as a delicacy.
en_grezzo: "A giant creature called the King of the Swamp. Its true identity is the shape of the Melka Salamander that caused the ancestral return. It doesn't suit the languid atmosphere but it has a lot of power. It is said that it is quite good when deep-fried without sauce and sometimes it is sold as a delicacy."
it: Una creatura enorme che chiamano il re del pantano. In verità è un ambystoma che è tornato indietro ai suoi antenati. Con quell'aria da smidollato non si direbbe, ma di forza ne ha da vendere. Fritto senza pastella pare che non sia affatto male, e capita che lo vendano come leccornia.

jp: 魔力で音を操るというオタマジャクシ。空気を激しく振動させ、その衝撃を攻撃に転用する。魔力で浮遊しているが、成長しても飛び蛙になったりはしない。
jp_grezzo: "魔力で音を操るというオタマジャクシ。空気を激しく振動させ、その衝撃を攻撃に転用する。魔力で浮遊しているが、成長しても飛び蛙になったりはしない。"
en: The tadpole is said to manipulate sound by magic. It vibrates the air violently converting its force into an attack. It floats by magic but doesn't become a flying frog when it grows up.
en_grezzo: "The tadpole is said to manipulate sound by magic. It vibrates the air violently converting its force into an attack. It floats by magic but doesn't become a flying frog when it grows up."
it: Un girino che, a quanto si dice, manovra il suono con il potere magico. Fa vibrare l'aria con violenza e trasforma l'urto in un attacco. Se ne sta a mezz'aria grazie alla magia, ma crescendo non diventa una rana volante.

jp: 自身の身体から分泌される毒液を用いて狩りをする珍しい蛙。派手な体色を嫌がっているが、毒を作る過程でこういう色になってしまうので仕方がないらしい。
jp_grezzo: "自身の身体から分泌される毒液を用いて狩りをする珍しい蛙。派手な体色を嫌がっているが、毒を作る過程でこういう色になってしまうので仕方がないらしい。"
en: A rare frog that hunts using a poisonous liquid secreted by its own body. They don't like the flashy color of their bodies but apparently it can't be helped because the process of making the poison turns out to be this color.
en_grezzo: "A rare frog that hunts using a poisonous liquid secreted by its own body. They don't like the flashy color of their bodies but apparently it can't be helped because the process of making the poison turns out to be this color."
it: Una rana rara, che caccia usando il liquido velenoso che il suo corpo secerne. Quel colore vistoso non le piace per niente, ma pare non ci sia niente da fare: viene così a forza di fabbricare il veleno.

jp: エレアの母とノーランドの父を持つ。両親の才能を受け継いでいるのか、若くしてとんでもない腕っぷしを誇る。アリベル七箇条という独自のルール・心構えを持っているが、これは父親の教えを参考にしたらしい。
jp_grezzo: "エレアの母とノーランドの父を持つ。両親の才能を受け継いでいるのか、若くしてとんでもない腕っぷしを誇る。アリベル七箇条という独自のルール・心構えを持っているが、これは父親の教えを参考にしたらしい。"
en: She has a mother of Elea and a father of Norland. She may have inherited the talents of her parents but she is also proud of her skill at a young age. Aribel has her own rules and mindset called the Seven Articles which she refers to as her father's teachings.
en_grezzo: "She has a mother of Elea and a father of Norland. She may have inherited the talents of her parents but she is also proud of her skill at a young age. Aribel has her own rules and mindset called the Seven Articles which she refers to as her father's teachings."
it: Ha la madre Elea e il padre di Norland. Sarà che ha preso il talento da tutti e due, ma già in giovane età vanta un braccio da far paura. Ha regole e propositi tutti suoi, i Sette Articoli di Aribel, e pare li abbia ricavati dagli insegnamenti del padre.

jp: 肉体から分離した生霊の成れの果て。元は高貴な魔法使いだったようで、強い魔力を持つ。特に力の強い個体は君主級として区別され、アークの接頭辞をつけられる。
jp_grezzo: "肉体から分離した生霊の成れの果て。元は高貴な魔法使いだったようで、強い魔力を持つ。特に力の強い個体は君主級として区別され、アークの接頭辞をつけられる。"
en: The end of the life spirit that separated from the body. It seems he was a noble wizard in the past and has strong magical powers. Particularly powerful individuals are distinguished as monarchs and are prefixed with arch.
en_grezzo: "The end of the life spirit that separated from the body. It seems he was a noble wizard in the past and has strong magical powers. Particularly powerful individuals are distinguished as monarchs and are prefixed with arch."
it: È quel che resta di uno spirito vivente separatosi dal corpo. A quanto pare in origine era un mago di nobile stirpe, e infatti ha un forte potere magico. Gli esemplari particolarmente forti si distinguono come di grado sovrano, e ricevono il prefisso arci.

jp: 「軍団」と呼称される悪霊。群れを作って生者を襲い、新たな仲間として取り込んでいく習性がある。一定数以上になると別グループが誕生する。自我が薄れており、他の個体と自分との区別が曖昧。
jp_grezzo: "「軍団」と呼称される悪霊。群れを作って生者を襲い、新たな仲間として取り込んでいく習性がある。一定数以上になると別グループが誕生する。自我が薄れており、他の個体と自分との区別が曖昧。"
en: An evil spirit called The Legion. They have a habit of attacking the living in packs and taking them in as new companions. When there is more than a certain number another group is born. The ego is fading and the distinction between oneself and other individuals is blurred.
en_grezzo: "An evil spirit called The Legion. They have a habit of attacking the living in packs and taking them in as new companions. When there is more than a certain number another group is born. The ego is fading and the distinction between oneself and other individuals is blurred."
it: Uno spirito maligno che chiamano la legione. Ha l'abitudine di assalire i vivi in massa e di inglobarli come nuovi compagni. Superato un certo numero, ne nasce un altro gruppo. Ha l'io sbiadito, e il confine fra sé e gli altri gli è diventato incerto.

jp: 階段で死んだ者たちの思念集合体。階段から階段へと移り潜り込む。疲労した通行人を階段から突き落とすのが趣味だが、暇だと普通に襲い掛かってくることもある。
jp_grezzo: "階段で死んだ者たちの思念集合体。階段から階段へと移り潜り込む。疲労した通行人を階段から突き落とすのが趣味だが、暇だと普通に襲い掛かってくることもある。"
en: The thought-gathering of those who died on the stairs. I move from staircase to staircase and dive in. Their hobby is to push tired passersby down the stairs but when they have nothing to do they will usually pounce on them.
en_grezzo: "The thought-gathering of those who died on the stairs. I move from staircase to staircase and dive in. Their hobby is to push tired passersby down the stairs but when they have nothing to do they will usually pounce on them."
it: L'ammasso dei pensieri di chi è morto su una scala. Si sposta di scala in scala e ci si infila dentro. Il divertimento è spingere giù dai gradini il passante stanco, ma quando si annoia capita che aggredisca e basta.
lo spirito maligno del tredicesimo gradino

jp: 風のルルウィに捕獲・調教された、哀れな風の精霊。食事もろくに与えられず生かさず殺さずの状態で飼育されている。理性をほぼ失っており、食べられそうなものがあれば生きようと必死で食らいつく。
jp_grezzo: "風のルルウィに捕獲・調教された、哀れな風の精霊。食事もろくに与えられず生かさず殺さずの状態で飼育されている。理性をほぼ失っており、食べられそうなものがあれば生きようと必死で食らいつく。"
en: A pitiful wind spirit who was captured and trained by Lulwy of the Wind. They are not fed much and are kept lifeless but not dead. It has almost lost all sense of rationality and if there is anything it can be eaten it is eaten in a desperate attempt to survive.
en_grezzo: "A pitiful wind spirit who was captured and trained by Lulwy of the Wind. They are not fed much and are kept lifeless but not dead. It has almost lost all sense of rationality and if there is anything it can be eaten it is eaten in a desperate attempt to survive."
it: Un povero spirito del vento, catturato e ammaestrato da Lulwy del vento. La tengono senza darle da mangiare a sufficienza, né viva né morta. Ha perso quasi del tutto la ragione, e se le capita davanti qualcosa di commestibile ci si avventa con la disperazione di chi vuole sopravvivere.

jp: 秘術によってアンデッドとなり悠久の時を過ごす。禁忌の研究をまとめた彼女の著書は、暗号のように難解ゆえシズルコードと呼ばれている。才能ある魔法使いが読むとその内容に強く魅了されてしまうため危険。
jp_grezzo: "秘術によってアンデッドとなり悠久の時を過ごす。禁忌の研究をまとめた彼女の著書は、暗号のように難解ゆえシズルコードと呼ばれている。才能ある魔法使いが読むとその内容に強く魅了されてしまうため危険。"
en: She became an undead through mystic arts and lived for an eternity. Her book a compilation of research on abstinence is called The Ssil Code because it is as esoteric as a code. It is dangerous for a gifted wizard to read it because they will be strongly enchanted by its contents.
en_grezzo: "She became an undead through mystic arts and lived for an eternity. Her book a compilation of research on abstinence is called The Ssil Code because it is as esoteric as a code. It is dangerous for a gifted wizard to read it because they will be strongly enchanted by its contents."
it: Con le arti segrete è diventata non morta, e da allora attraversa un tempo senza fine. Il libro in cui ha raccolto le sue ricerche sul proibito è così astruso da sembrare cifrato, e per questo lo chiamano il Codice di Ssil. È pericoloso: se lo legge un mago di talento, il contenuto lo strega senza scampo.

jp: 外見こそ試作型と変わらないが、様々なパーツの互換が効くようになっている。次元歪曲ユニットを外して電子戦装備や重火器を積むことも可能であり、汎用戦闘機としても優秀。
jp_grezzo: "外見こそ試作型と変わらないが、様々なパーツの互換が効くようになっている。次元歪曲ユニットを外して電子戦装備や重火器を積むことも可能であり、汎用戦闘機としても優秀。"
en: The appearance is the same as the prototype but various parts are interchangeable. It is also possible to carry heavy weapons and electronic warfare equipment to remove the dimensional distortion unit and is also excellent as a general-purpose fighter.
en_grezzo: "The appearance is the same as the prototype but various parts are interchangeable. It is also possible to carry heavy weapons and electronic warfare equipment to remove the dimensional distortion unit and is also excellent as a general-purpose fighter."
it: All'aspetto non è diverso dal prototipo, ma i vari pezzi sono diventati intercambiabili. Si può togliere l'unità di distorsione dimensionale e caricarci al suo posto equipaggiamento per la guerra elettronica o armi pesanti, e anche come caccia per ogni impiego è ottimo.
